jobs.title: Automation Engineer PLC (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir suchen Verstärkung und Ergänzung für unser Automation-Team am Standort in Braunschweig.

Lassen Sie uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Erarbeitung und Umsetzung von anspruchsvollen Automatisierungsaufgaben (PLC Programmierung unter Berücksichtigung von Standardvorgaben) • In Projektteams Planung des zeitlichen Ablaufs, Definition des Softwarekonzepts anhand der Unterlagen und Spezifikationen sowie Koordination der relevanten Schnittstellen und Vorgaben zur Hard- und Software-Implementation • Implementieren und Testen der Software sowie eigenständige Durchführung von Inbetriebnahmen der Automationssysteme beim Kunden • Übergabe der Anlagensteuerungen an den Kunden sowie bei Bedarf Schulung des Kundenpersonals • Unterstützung des Customer Service und des Angebotswesens in Belangen der Automatisierung • Berücksichtigung der kommerziellen Konsequenzen für den ganzen Automationsumfang im Rahmen der vertragsgemäßen Lieferung von Komponenten und Dienstleistungen Anforderungen: • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Mechatronik (FH/Uni) oder eine vergleichbare Aus- und Weiterbildung (z. B. als Elektrotechniker/in mit Programmierkenntnissen) • Idealerweise mehrjährige praktische Erfahrungen der Automation • Erfahrung im Umgang mit SPS-Steuerungs- und Visualisierungssoftware (Siemens Step 7, Tia Portal) • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse • Zuverlässigkeit, Belastbarkeit und Teamfähigkeit • Bereitschaft, an unserem 24/7 Kundensupport teilzunehmen • Sicheres Zeitmanagement, flexible und selbstständige Arbeitsweise • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung • Reisebereitschaft (ca. 15-20%) im Rahmen von Inbetriebnahmen und Serviceeinsätze Wir bieten: Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge oder vermögenswirksame Leistungen Profitiere von unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge oder vermögenswirksamen Leistungen – für eine sichere Zukunft! Berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung Wir bieten ein breites Spektrum an Lernmöglichkeiten, wie Videos, Online-Schulungen, Präsenzschulungen und Webinare mit kurzen, relevanten, ansprechenden, personalisierten und mobilen Formaten. Kantine mit gesunden Mahlzeiten Geniessen Sie gesunde Mahlzeiten in unserer Kantine zu fairen Preisen. Öffentliche und private Anbindung Unser Standort bietet eine hervorragende Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel und bequeme Parkplätze, die Ihnen das tägliche Pendeln erleichtern. Vielfältiger und integrativer Arbeitsplatz Wir fördern eine inklusive Kultur, die unsere globale Vielfalt wertschätzt. Respekt und Empathie sorgen dafür, dass sich alle sicher fühlen und ihr Bestes geben können. Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden. Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen.

titleByLocale.de: Data Scientist数据工程师(谷物事业部)

jobs.description:
In 2007, Bühler (Wuxi) Commercial Co., Ltd. was established in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province. We lead the market in grain handling and processing, consumer food manufacturing, and grinding and dispersion with our advanced technology advantages. We have several independent application centers and customer service centers for milling, pasta, color sorting, consumer food, grinding and dispersion, providing integrated solutions for multiple industry chains.
With our vision of “Innovations for a better world”, we are committed to developing more innovative solutions by leveraging the global resources of the Bühler Group and taking advantage of localization. Aufgaben: • Design, develop, and maintain Python applications for IoT and Cloud projects. al teams to define, design, and ship new features. • Identify and correct bottlenecks and fix bugs. • Data mining use state of the art methods. • Enhancing data collection procedures to include relevant information • Processing, cleansing, and verifying the integrity of data used for analysis. • Assess the effectiveness and accuracy of new data sources and data gathering techniques. • Doing adhoc analysis and presenting results in a clear manner. Anforderungen: • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Software engineering or related fields with 5 years' experience or master with 3 years' experience. • Experience using statistical computer languages (Python, MATLAB, Git, Latex.) • Proven experience with Python development. • Experience working with and creating data architectures. • Previous work experience in automation, digital product is preferred. • Strong problem-solving skills with an emphasis on mill, feed or relevant industry • Strong knowledge of advanced statistical techniques and concepts, and experience with applications. • Knowledge of a variety of machine learning techniques (clustering, decision tree learning, artificial neural networks, etc.) is considered as a priority. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for coordinating across teams. • Must understand the validation requirements for software tools • Excellent English skills in speaking, reading and writing • Must be organized to effectively manage multiple projects and shifting priorities. • Maintain confidentiality as required and appropriate. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Senior Project Manager is responseible for fulfillment work related to the production of machines, tools, products and other equipment related to BuhlerPrince's product portfolio, with substantial latitude for unreviewed action or decision. These projects are large in scope and frequently involve complex engineering problems. This person is responsible for the profit and loss of the assigned project, ensuring it is delivered on time, within budget and cash targets, and to the required quality, while optimizing the project margin.

Aufgaben:
• Responsible for the project execution strategy from purchase order through final acceptance including the closure of the project and snag list items

• Leads the project team to achieve and further improve the cost, schedule, quality, & EHS targets

• Ensures that the project schedule baseline is signed by the parties involved at the start of the project

• Performs proper risk & opportunity management

• Ensure proper deviation management within the project. Assess, approve, and expedite technical aspects of change orders & defines effective claim strategies towards customers, partners, subcontractors, etc.

• Responsible for the site briefing meeting & ensures that all site relevant documents are handed over to site personnel

• Capture return of experience and best practices & apply lessons learned to future projects

Anforderungen:
Required Skill and Experience

• 4-year Engineering or Business degree or other equivalent training or experience

• Strong project management skills

• Excellent oral and written communication skills including the ability to communicate both internally & externally at all levels of an organization

• Experience working in a team environment with strong leadership, sound judgement, and decision-making skills

• Experience managing work group without having direct authority

• Ability to anticipate, identify, and manage risk

• Capable of managing customer relationships

• Highly developed computer skills in Microsoft Office Suite

Preferred Skill and Experience

• Understanding of die casting machinery specifications, automation, and die casting processes

• 5+ years of professional project management experience

• PMP certification

• German language skills a plus

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

These projects are large in scope and frequently involve complex engineering problems. This person is responsible for the profit and loss of the assigned project, ensuring it is delivered on time, within budget and cash targets, and to the required quality, while optimizing the project margin.

Aufgaben:
• Responsible for the project execution strategy from purchase order through final acceptance including the closure of the project and snag list items

• Leads the project team to achieve and further improve the cost, schedule, quality, & EHS targets

• Ensures that the project schedule baseline is signed by the parties involved at the start of the project

• Performs proper risk & opportunity management

• Ensure proper deviation management within the project. Assess, approve, and expedite technical aspects of change orders & defines effective claim strategies towards customers, partners, subcontractors, etc.

• Responsible for the site briefing meeting & ensures that all site relevant documents are handed over to site personnel

• Capture return of experience and best practices & apply lessons learned to future projects

Anforderungen:
Required Skill and Experience

• 4-year Engineering or Business degree or other equivalent training or experience

• Strong project management skills

• Excellent oral and written communication skills including the ability to communicate both internally & externally at all levels of an organization

• Experience working in a team environment with strong leadership, sound judgement, and decision-making skills

• Experience managing work group without having direct authority

• Ability to anticipate, identify, and manage risk

• Capable of managing customer relationships

• Highly developed computer skills in Microsoft Office Suite

Preferred Skill and Experience

• Understanding of die casting machinery specifications, automation, and die casting processes

• 5+ years of professional project management experience

• PMP certification

• German language skills a plus

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: Team Manager, Service Operations
jobs.description:
Aufgaben:
• Lead a team of Field Service Engineers (FSE) & Workshop Operators in providing high quality services and fostering a collaborative and productive environment.

• Calculate the annual hourly rate and manage within the cost center budget for Field Service & Workshop.

• Plan, analyze and optimize the utilization of Field Service and Workshop to ensure high productivity (positive coverage difference).

• Ensure compliance with EHS standards and regulations to maintain a safe working environment and promote safety attitude throughout the Field Service & Workshop team.

• Proactively seek feedback from customers post execution of jobs and regularly visit customers to improve quality of services provided.

• Responsible for updating the skills matrix as well as the continuous development and upskilling of Field Service Engineers & Workshop Operators.

• Support internal stakeholders, and related departments with technical and Field Service operations knowledge.

• Promote continuous improvement initiatives in Field Service & Workshop operations.

• Drive back-office function transformation and integrate the quotation and order processing functions into GBS Service Operations.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical / Process / Industrial), Business Administration or similar.

• Minimum 8 years of experience in after sales service operations in manufacturing industries.

• At least 5 years of experience management of Field Service team. Experience as Field Service Engineer is of advantage.

• Proficiency in SAP, field service management software and tools for scheduling, reporting, and resource allocation is a plus

• Regional experience of the Singapore, Malaysia and Sri Lanka markets.

• Proficient in spoken and written English and Bahasa Melayu.

• Knowledge of Chinese is of advantage.

We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.description:
Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien und stetiges Wachstum. Als Teil der Bühler Group, einem weltweit agierenden Maschinenbaukonzern mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden, sind wir einer der Marktführer im Bereich Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren bieten wir unseren Kunden ein breites Angebot an Anlagen für die Beschichtung von Brillengläsern, optischen Komponenten in Smartphones, Autos, Medizintechnik Kameras, Head Up Displays von Autos und vielem mehr. Unserem internationalen Team gelingt es tagtäglich neue Maßstäbe zu setzen und komplexe Projekte erfolgreich umzusetzen.
Wir suchen einen motivierten Werkstudenten (m/w/d), der unser Team der kaufmännischen Auftragsabwicklung in Alzenau tatkräftig unterstützt. Unser Wunschkollege (m/w/d) besticht durch Genauigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit und scheut sich nicht davor eigenständig Aufgaben zu übernehmen.

Lassen Sie uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Du unterstützt im Tagesgeschäft, u.a. bei der Erstellung von Versandpapieren, der Anlage und Betreuung von Projekten in SAP • Du betreust eigenverantwortlich Aufgabenstellungen im Rahmen der Auftragsabwicklung mit weltweitem Bezug • Du unterstützt beim Zahlungsmanagement für Leistungen externer Vertriebspartner • Du erstellst Auswertungen mit Hilfe von SAP • Du unterstützt in laufenden internen Projekten (z.B. in Bezug auf Prozessverbesserungen) Anforderungen: • Du bist immatrikulierter Student (m/w/d) in einem wirtschaftlichen Studiengang • Du hast einen sicheren Umgang mit Microsoft Office und idealerweise erste Erfahrungen mit SAP • Du hast gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift • Eine selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise vervollständigt dein Profil Wir bieten: Kantine mit gesunden Mahlzeiten Geniessen Sie gesunde Mahlzeiten in unserer Kantine zu fairen Preisen. Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit bester technischer Ausstattung Arbeiten Sie an einem modernen Arbeitsplatz, der mit den neuesten technischen Hilfsmitteln ausgestattet ist, um Ihre Produktivität und Innovation zu fördern. Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Familiäre Unternehmenskultur Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Mitarbeitendenvorteile und Rabatte Geniessen Sie eine Vielzahl von Mitarbeitendenvorteilen und Ermässigungen, die Ihren Alltag erleichtern. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und erfahren Sie mehr. jobs.title: Team Lead, CS Quotation
jobs.description:
Aufgaben:
• Lead and manage the Quotation officers for Southeast Asia, ensuring high performance and engagement.

• Oversee the customer end-to-end quotation process in contributing to sales turnover.

• Monitor team workload and allocate resources effectively to meet the order revenue and turnover of orders.

• Handle incoming customer requests professionally, ensuring prompt and thorough resolution of issues.

• Build Level 1 competency in spare parts identification for assigned BUs, supported by 2nd-level Technical Advisors and BA/BU (Global/Region) teams during the quotation process.

• Drive process improvements and implement best practices for efficiency and accuracy.

• Handle escalations and resolve complex customer issues.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless operations.

• Develop team capabilities through coaching, training and performance reviews.

• Perform additional duties and responsibilities as business needs evolve.

Anforderungen:
• Minimum 5 years experience in technical quotation environment; with 3 years in a supervisory or team lead role.

• Proven experience in managing teams and driving operational excellence.

• Mechanical, Electrical & Electronics, Mechatronics Engineering or similar education background.

• Basic knowledge machinery and familiar with MRO.

• IT savvy, proficient in MS Office, with working knowledge of SAP/ CRM platforms (e.g. Salesforce SAP (SD Module, Stock, Purchasing).

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: Sachbearbeiter Zoll / Export (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Am Standort Beilngries widmen sich rund 360 Mitarbeitende im Geschäftsbereich Grain Quality and Supply dem Anlagen- und Maschinenbau rund um die Themen Getreideverarbeitung sowie Mälzen & Brauen.
Dies umfasst die Reinigung, Trocknung, den Transport (inkl. Fördertechnik und Schiffsbeladung), die Lagerung und Digitalisierung, um Getreide vom Feld bis zum Verbraucher zu verarbeiten. Immer mit dem Fokus auf Effizienz, Produktqualität und Nachhaltigkeit.

Lassen Sie uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.

Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Überwachung von Bewilligungen • Exportkontrolle • Einreihung von Waren in den Zolltarif • Kontrolle, Prüfung und Archivierung von Zolldokumenten (Einfuhr/Ausfuhr) • Begleitung von Zollprüfungen und Überwachung der Ausgangsvermerke • Erstellung von Handlungs- und Verfahrensanweisung Außenwirtschaftsrecht/Zollrecht • Interner und externer Ansprechpartner für jegliche Zollangelegenheit inkl. Kontakt zu Behörden und Ämtern Anforderungen: • Erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung (z.B. Kaufleute für Groß- und Außenhandel, Speditions- oder Industriekaufleute oder ähnliches) • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Exportkontrolle • Ausgeprägte Kenntnisse im Außenwirtschaftsgesetz • Grundkenntnisse im Kriegswaffenkontrollgesetz, US-Exportrecht (ITAR, EAR) wünschenswert • Selbstständige und sehr sorgfältige Arbeitsweise • Teamfähige und entscheidungsfreudige Persönlichkeit mit einem hohen Maß an Lösungsorientierung • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse (B2) in Wort und Schrift • Versiert im Umgang mit SAP und dem MS Office Paket Wir bieten: Familiäre Unternehmenskultur Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. jobs.title: Mechanical Designer
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Mechanical Designer with 10+ years of experience who can lead design work from concept to execution to meet project specifications, elevate visual and interaction quality, and partner closely with cross-functional teams to deliver thoughtful, high-impact outcomes. You'll operate with strong craft, sound judgment, and the ability to mentor others while driving projects forward.

Aufgaben:
• Produce high-quality deliverables such as equipment models and manufacturing drawings using Autodesk Inventor.

• Generate sales drawings using Inventor and AutoCAD.

• Ensure technical compliance and proper fit and function.

• Present work clearly - sharing rationale, incorporating feedback, and driving toward decisions.

• Manage workload priorities to adhere to budget constraints and project timelines.

• Resolve discrepancies that occur during the design and manufacture of Buhler equipment.

• Perform inspections of components, work-in-process, and finished equipment.

• Organize information on project specific SharePoint sites.

• Actively participate in project meetings with cross-functional team members, suppliers, and/or customers.

• Complete design related tasks resulting from equipment installation issues at customer site.

• Provide mentorship and design direction to other designers through critique, coaching, and collaborative problem-solving.

Anforderungen:
Job Specifications
 (Required education and experience)

• Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent

• 10+ years of relevant work experience

PREFERRED SKILLS

• Proficient in engineering drafting/drawings and engineering principles.

• Working knowledge of manufacturing and assembly practices, e.g. welding, sheet metal forming, press operations, etc.

• Awareness of machine safety codes and designing equipment for the food industry.

• Proficient in GD&T

• Autodesk Inventor and AutoCAD

• PTC Windchill

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Managing and leading the project team including internal partners, engineering subcontractors as well as external interfaces. (Type C and D projects)
Profit and loss responsibility for the allocated project by delivering the project within time, budget and cash targets in the required quality whilst optimizing the margin.
Ensuring compliance with Bühler related directives and EHS standards. Aufgaben: • Ensures that the project schedule baseline is agreed upon the involved parties at the start of the project • Manage and lead the project team to achieve and further improve the cost, schedule, quality and EHS targets • Perform proper risk and opportunity management • Ensure proper deviation management within the project. Assess, approve and expedite technical aspects of change orders and define effective claim strategies towards clients, partners, subcontractors, etc. • Prepare and perform Project Reviews as requested, report according to Bühler Project Management process • Responsible for the site briefing meeting; Ensures that all site relevant documents are handed over to site personnel. • Develop and maintain corresponding relationships with clients, partners and main subcontractors to ensure smooth operation of projects and smooth dispute resolution • Establish, implement and maintain operating standards to ensure quality project results and customer satisfaction • Capture return of experience and best practice, apply lessons learned. Organizes and accomplish a debriefing meeting • Supervise, support and coach the Project Team Members, provide input to project people performance reviews to functions • Supervise the final negotiations for the allocated project and provides an execution strategy Anforderungen: Knowledge, Skills and Abilities • Strong project management skills • Strong teamwork and leadership skills • Customer focus • Strong planning and organizing skills • Sound judgment and decision-making skills • Ability to anticipate, identify and manage risk • Strong interpersonal and teamwork skills • Ability to work in a matrix organization • Strong problem-solving skills • Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to interface effectively with people inside and outside of the company • Industry-, as well as general business and financial knowledge • Ability to be detail oriented without losing sight of the big picture • Comfortable working on multiple projects at one time. jobs.description:
Bühler (China) Investment Co., Ltd. established in 2011 in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province, is the group headquarters of the Swiss Bühler Group in Greater China and the first integrated headquarters of multinational companies in Jiangsu Province. With our advanced technology, we lead the market in grain handling and processing, consumer food manufacturing, and die-casting, grinding and dispersion. With our vision of "Innovations for a better world", we are committed to developing more innovative solutions by leveraging the global resources of the Bühler Group and taking advantage of localization.

布勒（中国）投资有限公司，于2011年在江苏无锡成立，是瑞士布勒集团在大中华区设立的集团总部，也是江苏省首批跨国公司综合性总部。我们凭借先进的技术优势，在谷物处理加工、消费食品制造、及压铸、研磨与分散等领域引领市场。我们秉持“布勒创新，驱动未来”愿景 ，携布勒集团全球资源，利用本地化优势，致力于开发更多创新解决方案。 Aufgaben: • Lead the deployment of AI agents and digital tools to enhance marketing efficiency, improve customer engagement, and optimize internal business processes.主导AI智能体及数字营销工具的开发与部署，提升营销效率、促进客户互动、优化内部业务流程。 • Manage the development and operational growth of the WeChat Mini Program. included curating content updates, executing marketing campaigns, tracking KPIs through analytics, and iterating on user experience to enhance engagement.负责微信小程序的开发管理及运营增长工作，包括：制定并执行内容更新策略，落地营销活动方案，通过数据分析追踪KPI，以及基于用户反馈持续迭代用户体验，以提升用户参与度。 • Lead the development and iterative upgrade of the customer service digitalization platform, overseeing end-to-end project coordination, execution, and closed-loop follow-up to elevate customer satisfaction and drive sustainable service business growth.主导客户服务数字化平台的搭建与迭代升级，全程统筹项目协调、执行及闭环跟进，提升客户满意度，驱动服务业务可持续增长。 • Lead the development, launch, and ongoing optimization of WeChat mini-site campaigns for product launches, promotions, trade shows and events.主导活动微网站的开发、上线及持续优化，支持产品发布、促销及品牌活动。 • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (marketing, sales, service, IT, etc.) and global counterparts, as well as external vendors, to ensure on-time, high-quality delivery of digital projects.与跨职能团队（营销、销售、服务、IT），全球团队及外部供应商协作，确保数字项目按时高质量交付。 • Translate business and marketing requirements into scalable digital solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.将业务及营销需求转化为可扩展的数字解决方案，确保与战略目标对齐。 • Source and evaluate advanced digital solutions and AI tools; identify optimization opportunities and deploy actionable solutions to relevant business units.搜索并评估先进数字解决方案及AI工具；识别优化机会，并向相关业务单元部署可执行方案。 • Independently develop software or leverage AI tools to implement solutions based on technical specifications.依据技术需求与规范，独立开发或借助 AI 工具实现软件解决方案。 • Ensure all digital initiatives are delivered on time, within scope, and to the highest quality standards.确保所有数字项目按时、按范围、高标准交付。 Anforderungen: • Bachelor's degree or above in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.本科及以上学历，市场营销、数字营销、工商管理、信息技术、计算机科学或相关专业。 • 7+ years of experience in digital marketing, digital project management, platform operations, or similar roles in a B2B environment.7年以上B2B环境中的数字营销、数字项目管理、平台运营或类似岗位经验。 • Fluent in English (written and spoken).英语流利（书面及口语）。 • Demonstrated expertise in digital platform development and management, including website/WeChat mini-site projects, customer-facing digital tools, or service platforms.具备数字平台开发及管理的专业能力，包括网站/微网站项目、面向客户的数字工具或服务平台。 • Hands-on experience with AI tools, Marketing automation solutions, or AI-driven marketing applications is highly preferred.具备AI工具、营销自动化解决方案或AI驱动营销应用的实操经验者优先。 • Experience leading or supporting cross-functional digital initiatives in a multinational matrix organization.具备在跨国矩阵式组织中主导或支持跨职能数字项目的经验。 • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and coordinate across internal and external stakeholders.具备扎实的项目管理能力，能够同时管理多个并行项目，并协调内外部利益相关者。 • A fast learner with a proactive, detail-oriented, and results-driven mindset, adept at independent work in fast-paced, agile environments.快速学习、主动积极、注重细节，以结果为导向，能够在快速敏捷的环境中独立开展工作。 • Based in Wuxi, with flexibility for occasional travel.常驻无锡，可灵活安排偶尔出差。 Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.description:
Aufgaben:
Customer quotation 客户报价

• Handle customer inquiries professionally and ensure timely and thorough issue resolution.专业处理客户询问，确保问题得到及时、全面的解决。
• Collect relevant customer information efficiently to understand and fulfill customer needs.高效收集客户相关信息，以准确理解并满足客户需求。
• Identify required spare parts based on customer requests and technical information.根据客户需求及技术信息识别所需备件。
• Prepare and follow up complete quotations for spare and wear parts, covering both commercial and technical aspects.准备并跟进备件及易损件的完整报价，涵盖商务及技术内容。

Order Fulfilment订单履行

• Plan and coordinate orders to ensure timely delivery to the required location.计划并协调订单，确保按时交付至指定地点。
• Monitor delivery schedules and take necessary actions to meet customer commitments. 跟踪交货计划，并采取必要措施以履行对客户的承诺。
• Ensure customer commitments are fulfilled through accurate planning and securing of stock, manufactured, and procured items. 通过准确规划并确保库存件、生产件及采购件供应，履行对客户的承诺。
• Provide customers with regular updates on order status and any delivery deviations. 定期向客户更新订单状态及交期偏差信息。

Data analysis数据分析

• Analyze sales, order, procurement, and consumption data to identify trends, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities.分析销售、订单、采购及消耗数据，识别趋势、瓶颈及改进机会。
• Monitor key operational metrics, including lead time, on-time delivery, and inventory turnover.监控关键运营指标，包括交付周期、准时交付率及库存周转率。
• Prepare weekly and monthly reports to track performance against targets.准备周报及月报，跟踪实际绩效与目标的达成情况。
• Identify root causes of order fulfilment delays and provide data-driven recommendations for process improvement.识别订单履行延迟的根本原因，并提供基于数据的流程优化建议。
• Maintain order-related data in SAP to ensure accuracy, integrity, and consistency.维护 SAP 中的订单相关数据，确保数据准确、完整且一致。

Weekly / Monthly Meetings with HQ与总部的周会/月会

• Attend weekly and monthly operational review meetings with HQ and provide updates on order performance and customer issues.参加与总部的周度及月度运营回顾会议，汇报订单处理绩效及客户相关问题。
• Prepare and present data-supported reports on order fulfilment status, backlogs, and action plans.准备并汇报基于数据的报告，内容包括订单履行状态、积压订单及行动计划。
• Align local actions with HQ's operational and business targets.确保本地行动与总部运营及业务目标保持一致。
• Share local market insights, demand trends, and operational challenges to support HQ planning and process improvement.分享本地市场洞察、需求趋势及运营挑战，支持总部规划和流程改进。
• Follow up on action items and ensure timely execution with regular progress updates.跟进行动事项，确保及时执行并定期更新进展。
• Communicate with service stations and other teams to provide necessary support.与服务站及其他团队沟通，提供必要支持。

Other task assigned by management team.完成管理层安排的其他任务。

Anforderungen:
• College degree or above in Commercial Logistics, Technical Engineering, or related fields.大专及以上学历，商业物流、技术工程或相关专业。
• Proficient in PC applications and office software.熟练使用电脑及办公软件。
• Familiar with SAP, including SD module, inventory, and procurement processes.熟悉 SAP 系统，包括 SD 模块、库存及采购流程。
• Minimum 3 years of experience in sales, service, or manufacturing environments.至少 3 年销售、服务或制造行业相关工作经验。
• Strong customer service mindset, with the ability to deliver high-quality support and meet customer expectations.具备较强的客户服务意识，能够提供高质量支持并满足客户期望。
• Excellent communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal teams, customers, and HQ stakeholders.具备出色的沟通与协调能力，能够与内部团队、客户及总部相关方高效协作。

titleByLocale.en: Plant Sales Manager成套工程销售经理(谷物事业部)
titleByLocale.de: Verkaufsleiter des Werks成套工程销售经理(谷物事业部)

jobs.description:
Aufgaben:
• 根据项目销售的要求，制定工作计划

• 开拓市场，开发新的项目类客户

• 支持销售工程师收集客户信息，协调公司内部资源，提供完整的交流资料

• 协作销售工程师与客户的工程洽谈直至项目签订

• 召开HOM会议移交工程部

• 收集，整理并报告市场信息

Anforderungen:
• 本科及以上学历，粮食工程、机械设计与工程、食品工程或相关专业背景，硕士研究生优先。

• 具备 3–5 年面粉行业销售经验，或制粉工程设计、食品工厂设计相关经验；具备 4–5 年面粉厂制粉师经验者亦可考虑。

• 熟悉面粉、制粉或食品工厂相关业务流程，能够为客户提供工程咨询、技术方案支持及初步项目规划。

• 具备一定的合同理解和转化能力，能够在必要支持下将客户需求、合同内容转化为内部执行要求。

• 具备良好的英语沟通和书面表达能力，能够进行基本商务交流及文件处理。

• 熟练使用 Microsoft Office 办公软件及 CAD 软件，能够支持日常销售、方案、图纸及项目文件处理。

jobs.description:
2007年，布勒（无锡）商业有限公司成立于江苏无锡市。凭借先进的技术优势，公司在谷物处理加工、消费食品制造及研磨与分散等领域引领市场。公司拥有制粉，面条，色选，消费食品，研磨分散等多个独立应用中心及客户服务中心，提供多产业链集成解决方案。我们秉持“布勒创新，驱动未来”愿景 ，携布勒集团全球资源，利用本地化优势，致力于开发更多创新解决方案。

Aufgaben:
根据布勒统一的研发流程与规范，负责自动化编程工具的研发、产品自动化软件的开发、电气选型和设计、整机项目支持、现有设备升级、技术转让项目落地、及其全生命周期管理等工作，具体如下：
• 新产品自动化研发：

• 完成自动化编程工具的研发。

• 完成产品自动化软件的组态、编程、仿真及界面设计等自动化程序的开发。

• 完成电气元件选型与电气方案设计。

• 根据产品开发任务书/需求输入，完成市场与应用调研；与机械、工艺、制造、质量等团队协作，制定自动化整体方案与控制架构，确保功能实现、交付质量与可维护性。

• 配合样机联调与测试验证，发现问题并持续改进。

• 跟踪新产品市场推广与客户反馈，持续优化设计文档、使用手册、程序块封装等标准化成果。

• 现有设备电气与控制升级改造：

• 对现有设备进行自动化控制升级方案设计、实施支持与验证。

• 输出改造方案、风险评估、验证计划及升级文档，支持现场验收与持续改进。

• 国外技术转让/国产化项目：

• 负责技术转让设备项目的电气图纸国产化、电气元件替代选型、软件更新与版本跟踪。

• 协调跨区域技术对齐，确保功能一致、规范一致并按期交付。

• 供应链/制造过程支持与质量改进：

• 对新选型电气设备，协助供应链与外协/外购供应商进行技术沟通、首样验收确认。

• 跟踪设备电气系统的制造与装配质量，及时发现硬件接线及软件控制问题并推动改进。

• 需求对接与技术支持：

• 学习并掌握布勒上位机控制系统的操作与应用，提出并反馈必要的开发需求。

• 负责与客户或产品开发部门的需求澄清与技术对接，形成可执行的功能规格与验收标准。

• 支持其他团队，对销售项目提供技术支持。

Anforderungen:
• 本科/硕士及以上学历，计算机软件、软件工程、电气自动化、自动化、机电一体化等相关专业。

• 3 年以上工控自动化编程类软件研发、产品自动化软件研发及电气设计相关工作经验。有食品加工行业设备自动化开发经验者优先。

• 具备开发PLC自动化编程工具的能力，包括：

• 精通Visual Basic/C#编程语言，精通工控脚本或宏编程技术。

• 精通面向对象编程（OOP）编程技术。

• 熟练使用 Git 等版本管理工具，了解常见协作流程（分支管理、合并、PR 等）。

• 熟练使用 Visual Studio Code（或 Visual Studio）工具进行开发与调试。

• 精通西门子TIA Portal SCL编程语言 和 STL编程语言。

• 熟悉西门子TIA Portal Openness开发接口。

• 熟悉微软Azure DevOps平台。

• 熟悉TypeScript/JavaScript语言和Node.js开发环境者优先。

• 具备程序标准化与版本控制意识，具备敏捷开发经验者优先。

• 具备电气专用设计工具EPlan或 Engineering Base的应用能力者优先。

• 具备常用伺服控制应用经验者优先。

• 具备扎实的电气设计基础与工程化思维，具备创新意识与解决问题的能力。

• 能够在样机测试与现场调试中独立定位问题，推动跨团队协作解决。

• 具备团队精神，开诚布公，良好的人际沟通与协作能力。

• 良好的英语读写能力及口语沟通能力。

20亿人每天食用布勒设备生产的食品。10亿人驾驶的车辆中包含本公司设备制造的部件。
布勒力求在每项决策中平衡兼顾人类、自然和经济，在全球食品、饲料和交通运输行业开发解决方案，拓展可持续业务解决方案。我们努力以创新驱动未来，特别专注于健康、安全、可持续的解决方案。因此，我们与客户、创业公司、跨国企业和学界携手
合作，共同加速实现影响。

jobs.title: Order Processing Officer
jobs.description:
Aufgaben:
• Execute Spare Part and Service Order Processing for the Southeast Asia region.

• Arrange and coordinate freight deliveries with 3PL partners from vendor to customer via courier, sea freight, air freight, or local trucking.

• Provide customer service support to internal teams and direct customers, addressing inquiries promptly.

• Follow up on account receivable to maintain strong credit performance.

• Manage trade instruments and shipping documents, including D/P, D/A, Letter of Credits, prepayment and credit terms.

• Oversee and manage the return-of-material process.

• Address customer feedback, complaints and requests for service remedies.

• Perform additional duties and responsibilities as business needs evolve.

• Provide efficient and effective Customer Service to internal and external Customers.

• Responsible for Southeast Asia region order processing and shipping arrangement.

• Ensure on-time delivery based on customer request delivery date.

• Maintain strong collaboration with Manufacturing Factory (MLS) or external suppliers

Anforderungen:
• Diploma or Degree in Supply Chain or Logistics.

• Minimum 3 years' experience in supply chain or order fulfilment environment.

• Strong PC and software knowledge (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, MS Office.

• Knowledge of SAP (SD Module, Stock, Procurement).

• Good knowledge in incoterm and freight management

• Excellent analytical, problem solving and organizational skills

• Proficient in English

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: Fachspezialist/-in Pensionskasse
jobs.description:
Du möchtest Dein Fachwissen im Bereich der beruflichen Vorsorge in eine sinnstiftenden Aufgabe einbringen? Bei der Pensionskasse Bühler erwartet Dich eine verantwortungsvolle und vielseitige Position in einem engagierten und kollegialen Team. Als Fachspezialist/-in Pensionskasse bearbeitest Du vielfältige Geschäftsfälle in der Versichertenverwaltung, stehst den Versicherten beratend zur Seite und bringst Dich in spannende Projekte ein.

Aufgaben:
• Du bearbeitest sämtliche Geschäftsfälle in der Versichertenverwaltung regelkonform gemäss gesetzlichen Vorgaben und Pensionskassenreglement

• Du betreust und berätst Versicherte kompetent bei unterschiedlichen Fragestellungen

• Du erstellst Berechnungen, verfasst anspruchsvolle Korrespondenz und bearbeitest Koordinations- sowie IV-Fälle

• Du agierst als Schnittstelle zu internen und externen Ansprechpartnern wie HR und Ämtern

• Du unterstützt die Pensionskassenleitung in Projekten und übernimmst weitere administrative sowie organisatorische Aufgaben

Anforderungen:
• Mehrjährige Praxiserfahrung in der beruflichen Vorsorge bzw. Pensionskassenverwaltung sowie eine fachspezifische Weiterbildung im Bereich Personalvorsorge, Sozialversicherungen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Empathische, teamfähige Persönlichkeit mit Freude am Kundenkontakt und ausgeprägter Dienstleistungsorientierung

• Hohe Sozialkompetenz sowie die Fähigkeit, adressatengerecht und professionell zu kommunizieren

• Versierter Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint; Kenntnisse in Swiss Pension sowie eine generelle IT-Affinität von Vorteil

• Stilsicheres Deutsch und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Wir bieten:
Attraktiver Ferienanspruch
Ausreichend Zeit für Erholung und persönliche Interessen - wir bieten von 25 bis zu 30 Tage Ferien pro Jahr abhängig vom Lebensjahr.

Attraktives Mobilitätskonzept
Wir bieten ein OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Halbtax für 365 CHF + 400CHF ÖV-Guthaben sowie ein attraktives Erstklass-Abonnement oder kostenlose Parkplätze.

Personalrestaurant VIVA
Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitenden ein tägliches Fitnessmenü ab 9, 00 CHF.

Arbeitgeberfinanzierter Pensionsplan
Die Bühler Pensionskasse bietet ihren Mitarbeitenden eine eigenständige Pensionskasse, die eine verlässliche finanzielle Abischerung im Ruhestand sicherstellt: www.pk-buhler.ch

Sportangebote
Wir fördern die sportliche Betätigung durch eigenorganisiertes Zirkeltraining und Laufgruppen sowie durch Gutscheine für Update und Activ Fitness.

Health-Port
Wir setzen uns für Gesundheitsprävention durch Laboranalysen, Massagen, Ernährungsberatung, Physiotherapie, Gruppenkurse sowie einen Betriebsarzt ein.

Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Vuoi contribuire alla tua conoscenza specializzata nel campo delle pensioni professionali ad un lavoro di sinnfiftende? Al Fondo pensioni Bühler troverai una posizione responsabile e di un personale di categoria e di un gruppo di persone di cui fa parte. In qualità di specialista in fondi pensione, lavorerai su una vasta gamma di casi aziendali nell'amministrazione assicurata, fornirai consulenza agli assicurati e ti coinvolgerai in progetti entusiasmanti. Compiti:
• Gestisci tutti i casi aziendali nell'amministrazione assicurata in conformità con i requisiti legali e le norme sui fondi pensione
• Fornisci consulenza e supporto competenti agli assicurati in diverse domande
• Prima calcoli, scrivi una sofisticata corrispondenza e coordinamento dei processi e IV casi
• Agieni come interfaccia a persone di contatto interne ed esterne come HR e uffici
• Sostieni la gestione dei fondi pensione nei progetti e prendi in carico ulteriori compiti amministrativi e organizzativi Requisiti:
• Perenne I seguenti esempi sono i più importanti: Gestione del fondo pensione e formazione specializzata in fornitura del personale, sicurezza sociale o qualifiche comparabili
• Personalità empatica, capace di lavorare in gruppo con piacere di contatto con il cliente e un forte orientamento al servizio
• Alta competenza sociale e la capacità di comunicare professionalmente e adeguatamente
• Gestione verificata di MS Office, in particolare Excel e PowerPoint; conoscenza della pensione svizzera e un generale IT-A-Finanza di vantaggio
• Elegante tedesco e molto buona conoscenza inglese in parole e scrittura Offriamo: Attraente diritto di vacanza Adeguato tempo per la ricreazione e interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanza all'anno a seconda dell'età di uno. Concetto di mobilità attraente Offriamo un OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + mezza tassa per 365 CHF + 400CHF credito di trasporto pubblico e un interessante abbonamento di prima classe o parcheggio gratuito.Ristorante personal VIVA Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menù di fitness giornaliero a partire da 9 00 CHF. Piani pensionistici finanziati dai datori di lavoro Il Bühler Pensionskassen offre ai propri dipendenti un fondo pensioni indipendente che garantisce un pensionamento finanziario affidabile: www.pk-buhler.ch Sports Promuoviamo attività sportive attraverso la formazione auto-organizzata del circuito e gruppi di corsa, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e l'uso della Fitness Activ. Health-Port Ci impegniamo per la prevenzione della salute attraverso analisi di laboratorio, lessici, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto ogni giorno nelle piante di Bühler. Un miliardo di persone viaggia in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte dalla tecnologia di Bühler. Con ogni decisione, Bühler punta a allineare le esigenze di business, persone e natura. Sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Per questo motivo lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più rapido insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
You want to contribute your specialist knowledge in the field of occupational pension provision to a sinnfiftende job? At the Bühler Pension Fund, you will find a responsible and versatile position in a committed and collegial team. As a specialist in pension funds, you will work on a wide range of business cases in the insured administration, provide the insured with advice and get involved in exciting projects. Tasks:
• You handle all business cases in the insured administration in accordance with the statutory requirements and pension fund regulations
• You provide competent advice and support to insured persons in different questions
• You first calculate, write sophisticated correspondence and process coordination and IV cases
• You act as an interface to internal and external contact persons such as HR and offices
• You support the pension fund management in projects and take over further administrative and organizational tasks Requirements:
• Perennial The following are the most important examples of this: Pension fund management as well as a specialist training in personnel provision, social security or comparable qualifications
• Empathic, team-capable personality with a pleasure of customer contact and a strong service orientation
• High social competence and the ability to communicate professionally and appropriately
• Versified handling of MS Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint; knowledge of Swiss Pension as well as a general IT-A-Finance of advantage
• Stylish German and very good English knowledge in word and writing We offer: Attractive holiday entitlement Adequate time for recreation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of holiday per year depending on the age of one. Attractive mobility concept We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-tax for 365 CHF + 400CHF public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class subscription or free parking.Personal restaurant VIVA We offer our employees a daily fitness menu starting from 9 00 CHF. Employer-funded pension plan The Bühler Pensionskassen offers its employees an independent pension fund that ensures a reliable financial retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch Sports We promote sports activities through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for update and the use of the Activ Fitness. Health-Port We are committed to health prevention through laboratory analyses, massages, nutrition advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor. Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts have been produced by Bühler technology. With every decision, Bühler aims to bring the needs of business, people and nature into line. We develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. That is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Vous souhaitez contribuer à un emploi sinnfiftende vos connaissances spécialisées dans le domaine des pensions professionnelles? A la Caisse de retraite Bühler, vous trouverez une position responsable et polyvalente dans une équipe engagée et collégiale. En tant que spécialiste des pensions, vous travaillerez sur un large éventail de dossiers d'affaires dans l'administration assurée, fournirez des conseils à l'assuré et participerez à des projets passionnants. Tâches:
• Vous traitez toutes les affaires dans l'administration assurée conformément aux exigences légales et aux règlements des fonds de pension
• Vous fournissez des conseils et un soutien compétents aux assurés dans différentes questions
• Vous calculez, rédigez d'abord la correspondance sophistiquée et la coordination des processus et IV cas
• Vous agissez comme une interface avec les personnes-ressources internes et externes telles que les RH et les bureaux
• Vous soutenez la gestion des fonds de pension dans les projets et vous assumez d'autres tâches administratives et organisationnelles. Voici les exemples les plus importants de cette situation : Gestion des fonds de pension et formation spécialisée en matière de personnel, sécurité sociale ou qualifications comparables
• Personnalité empathique, équivalant à une équipe avec un plaisir de contact avec les clients et une forte orientation de service
• Haute compétence sociale et la capacité de communiquer professionnellement et de manière appropriée
• Traitement harmonisé de MS Office, en particulier Excel et PowerPoint; connaissance de Swiss Pension ainsi qu'une IT-A-Financement générale de l'avantage
• Élégant allemand et très bonne connaissance de l'anglais en paroles et en écriture Nous offrons: Attirance de vacances Temps adéquat pour les loisirs et les intérêts personnels - nous offrons de 25 à 30 jours de vacances par année selon l'âge d'un. Concept de mobilité attractive Nous offrons un ZVV / Z-Pass + demi-taxe pour 365 CHF + 400CHF crédit de transport en commun ainsi qu'un abonnement de première classe attrayant ou un parking gratuit.Restaurant personnel VIVA Nous offrons à nos employés un menu de fitness quotidien à partir de 9 00 CHF. Régime de retraite financé par l'employeur Le Bühler Pensionskassen offre à ses employés une caisse de retraite indépendante qui assure une retraite financière fiable : www.pk-buhler.ch Sports Nous encourageons les activités sportives par l'intermédiaire de groupes auto-organisés de formation et de course ainsi que des bons de mise à jour et l'utilisation de la Fitness Activ. Health-Port Nous nous engageons à la prévention de la santé par des analyses de laboratoire, des massages, des conseils en nutrition, la physiothérapie, des cours de groupe et un médecin d'entreprise. Chaque jour, deux milliards de personnes consomment des aliments produits sur les usines de Bühler. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites par la technologie Bühler. Avec chaque décision, Bühler vise à mettre en ligne les besoins des entreprises, des personnes et de la nature. Nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités d'affaires durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation humaine, de l'alimentation animale et de la mobilité. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec nos clients, nos start-up, nos multinationales et nos scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Aufgaben:
• Identify and develop opportunities for Bühler solutions

• Maintain and expand customer base

• Plan and execute sales visits to customers and prospects

• Listen to customers, actively monitor assigned markets, report and provide feedback about market intelligence

• Actively promote the Bühler portfolio of products and services

• Plan, prepare and execute sales negotiations

• Collect and maintain accurate information about accounts, contacts, sales leads and opportunities

• Act more independently in the daily sales activities

• Design basic sales strategies for the development of the assigned areas and markets

• Set priorities to fully explore Bühler's competitive advantages

• Establish a broad network within markets

• Develop an understanding of customer decision process and criteria

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's Degree in engineering / businees or equivalent

• At least 5 years of experience in technical sales and customer service, including experience in rice solutions, rice milling technologies, and food processing solutions.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: Team Manager, Automation
jobs.description:
Manage and lead a team of engineers responsible for executing Automation projects, as well as Automation Retrofit. Ensure the delivery of all required engineering services within the defined schedule and quality standards, while maintaining compliance with Bühler directives and EHS regulations.

Oversee all technical interfaces with the customer, including specifications for subcontracted supplies. Act as the primary point of contact for the Project Director and Project Manager in matters related to automation specialization. Aufgaben: • Build and develop a team, establishing foundational processes and culture based on Bühler guidelines and values • Responsible for training and development of the team ensuring growth and alignment with the organization's defined strategic direction • Lead the project team on automation projects, overseeing all technical aspects related to automation • Project management of challenging automation projects – particularly during the team's ramp-up phase. • Manage the assigned project scope from a technical perspective to achieve defined goals and objectives • Conduct project reviews to ensure project quality or to address any deviations at an early stage • Actively participate in project meetings with cross - functional team members, suppliers, and/or customers • Support Project Manager to ensure a proper project execution according the Bühler Project Management process and provide technical support in case of Claims and Deviations • Responsible for the technical design of complex plants, approves deliverables to ensure that design will meet the customers' expectations • Supervise and support the Team Members in all technical belongings, act as mentor for Engineers Anforderungen: • Bachelor's degree in Automation / Mechatronics / Electrical / Electronic Engineering • At least 10 years' relevant experience • Minimum 5 years working experience as Lead Project Engineer in industrial automation and electrical installation / commissioning on customer site • Experience in Siemens programming software (Step7, Tia Portal) for PLC S7 300/400/1500, HMI touchscreen, SCADA system programming and commissioning at customer manufacturing site • Knowledge of .Net software programming and SQL Server Database is a plus • Strong planning, organizing and priority setting skills, with a proven ability to manage teams • Fluent verbal & written in English is a must Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. jobs.title: Field Service Team Manager

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire d ' équipe du Service mobile

jobs.description:
In this role you will lead and support a regional team of field service professionals who install, maintain, and troubleshoot customer equipment. Your focus is on helping your team work safely, deliver high‑quality results, and create a great experience for customers from start to finish.
You'll set clear expectations, coach team members, and ensure service work is completed efficiently and profitably. You'll partner closely with customers to understand their needs, resolve issues quickly, and ensure every project meets company quality and safety standards. Ultimately, you are responsible for the success of all field service activities within your assigned business area, while building a skilled, motivated, and customer‑focused team. Aufgaben: • Recruit, onboard, develop, and performance-manage Field Service Engineers (FSEs) using clear goals, IDPs, the Skills Matrix, and SuccessFactors/EPM+. • Upskill FSEs in mechanical/electronic competencies, market needs, documentation quality, customer communication, and professional reporting; conduct post‑job reviews. • Foster a safety‑first, continuous improvement culture aligned with Bühler values, enforcing all EHS/OSHA/LOTO standards and ensuring timely training and incident reporting. • Maintain deep technical curiosity and build strong working knowledge of the Bühler product portfolio, equipment, and processes. • Plan, assign, and optimize field resources to meet customer timelines, commissioning milestones, repairs, overhauls, and preventive maintenance schedules. • Review job scopes, confirm tool/parts readiness, and monitor job progress while managing escalations and complex troubleshooting with BU, Engineering, Quality, and Remote Support. • Ensure timely, professional communication with all internal and external stakeholders, taking full ownership of customer requests and escalations through closure. • Coordinate service support for project managers and ensure proper costing, accurate quotations, and timely approval of timesheets/expenses. • Manage team utilization, schedule adherence, warranty cost control, and travel/expense discipline aligned with financial goals. • Drive first‑time‑fix rates, job quality, KPI achievement, and identification of service sales opportunities (upgrades, PM contracts, training, parts). • Leverage SAP, SuccessFactors, CAQ, CRM, and reporting tools to guide decisions, recommend improvements, and support SQCDP/continuous improvement efforts. Anforderungen: • 5+ years in people leadership or technical lead capacity is required. • 5+ years in industrial field service (installation, commissioning, troubleshooting) is preferred. • Strong mechanical and industrial knowledge. • Demonstrated customer facing communication skills and conflict resolution. • Prior leadership/management role. • Formal leadership training. • Microsoft Office is required. • SAP experience is preferred. • Experience with food processing equipment (e.g., pasta, grain, milling, mixing, conveying, thermal, or sorting systems) is preferred. • Ownership & Judgment: Prioritizes safety and quality; makes data backed decisions under time pressure. • Coaching Mindset: Develops talent through feedback, on the job training, and structured learning paths. • Customer Centricity: Anticipates needs; communicates proactively; manages expectations. • Collaboration: Works across Product Lines, Engineering, Quality, and Sales to solve problems. • Continuous Improvement: Challenges the status quo; standardizes and shares best practices. Aufgaben: • Recruit, onboard, develop, and performance-manage Field Service Engineers (FSEs) using clear goals, IDPs, the Skills Matrix, and SuccessFactors/EPM+. • Upskill FSEs in mechanical/electronic competencies, market needs, documentation quality, customer communication, and professional reporting; conduct post‑job reviews. • Foster a safety‑first, continuous improvement culture aligned with Bühler values, enforcing all EHS/OSHA/LOTO standards and ensuring timely training and incident reporting. • Maintain deep technical curiosity and build strong working knowledge of the Bühler product portfolio, equipment, and processes. • Plan, assign, and optimize field resources to meet customer timelines, commissioning milestones, repairs, overhauls, and preventive maintenance schedules. • Review job scopes, confirm tool/parts readiness, and monitor job progress while managing escalations and complex troubleshooting with BU, Engineering, Quality, and Remote Support. • Ensure timely, professional communication with all internal and external stakeholders, taking full ownership of customer requests and escalations through closure. • Coordinate service support for project managers and ensure proper costing, accurate quotations, and timely approval of timesheets/expenses. • Manage team utilization, schedule adherence, warranty cost control, and travel/expense discipline aligned with financial goals. • Drive first‑time‑fix rates, job quality, KPI achievement, and identification of service sales opportunities (upgrades, PM contracts, training, parts). • Leverage SAP, SuccessFactors, CAQ, CRM, and reporting tools to guide decisions, recommend improvements, and support SQCDP/continuous improvement efforts. Anforderungen: • 5+ years in people leadership or technical lead capacity is required. • 5+ years in industrial field service (installation, commissioning, troubleshooting) is preferred. • Strong mechanical and industrial knowledge. • Demonstrated customer facing communication skills and conflict resolution. • Prior leadership/management role. • Formal leadership training. • Microsoft Office is required. • SAP experience is preferred. • Experience with food processing equipment (e.g., pasta, grain, milling, mixing, conveying, thermal, or sorting systems) is preferred. • Ownership & Judgment: Prioritizes safety and quality; makes data backed decisions under time pressure. • Coaching Mindset: Develops talent through feedback, on the job training, and structured learning paths. • Customer Centricity: Anticipates needs; communicates proactively; manages expectations. • Collaboration: Works across Product Lines, Engineering, Quality, and Sales to solve problems. • Continuous Improvement: Challenges the status quo; standardizes and shares best practices. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.description:
In 2020, Bühler Premier Tech (Wuxi) Packaging Machinery Co., Ltd. is a joint venture between the Swiss Bühler Group and the Canadian Premier Group (50% each), relying on the superior resources of Bühler and Premier, integrating their product lines and professional capabilities to make future packaging solutions more efficient through the application of automation technology, bringing the industry more cost-effective and safer semi-automatic/automatic packaging solutions.

Aufgaben:
• Work on design, develop, and maintain PLC programs for automatic machines, robot palletizer

• Partly work on the electrical wire diagram for standard products, as well as customer orders.

• Partly support the startup team at shopfloor to perform system testing, debugging, and commissioning at customer by request

• Collaborate with mechanical, pneumatic, and startup team for system integration, validation

• Prepare technical documentation, including functional descriptions, manuals, and reports

• Ensure version control of software and electrical deliverable.

• During Roadmap development, work closely with the design authority (overseas) to develop / transfer new products or new functions

• During Life cycle management, optimize the products, localize the design

• For customization, work closely with project team to develop customized solutions to match customer needs.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree or above in Automation, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or related field

• 5+ years of experience in PLC programming, electrical engineering

• 1+ years of experience in hardware engineering (electrical wire diagram)

• Experience in HMI / VFD / Servo systems, Fanuc industrial robots (or ABB, KUKA) as a plus

• Experience in performing system testing, debugging, and on-site commissioning (FAT/SAT)

• Experience to diagnose and resolve issues related to PLC, control systems, and field devices

• Experience in electrical schematic using EPLAN

• Good English communication skills for international projects

• Experience in complex automation systems or full production lines

• Proficiency in at least one major PLC platform:

• Siemens (S7-1200/1500, TIA Portal) as mandatory experience

• Rockwell (Allen-Bradley) or Beckhoff (TwinCAT) as a plus

• Familiar with industrial communication protocols:

• Profinet, Profibus, EtherNet/IP, Modbus

• Good at Hardware tool Eplan

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Systematically manage tasks activities, time, quality, cost related.

• Good communication and teamwork abilities

• Ownership & carefulness for daily work

• Willingness to travel for on-site commissioning (not too often) when required

20亿人每天食用布勒设备生产的食品。10亿人驾驶的车辆中包含本公司设备制造的部件。
布勒力求在每项决策中平衡兼顾人类、自然和经济，在全球食品、饲料和交通运输行业开发解决方案，拓展可持续业务解决方案。我们努力以创新驱动未来，特别专注于健康、安全、可持续的解决方案。因此，我们与客户、创业公司、跨国企业和学界携手
合作，共同加速实现影响。

jobs.description:
Aufgaben:
• To Independently transfer BOM of electrical section into whole machine, and maintain MBOM and routing in SAP 独立确定，转化整机电气BOM 结构, 维护MBOM和工艺

• Be responsible for creating or improving process, working hours, familiar with process of electrical installation and commissioning and working hours编制与优化电气安装调试的工艺流程，制定工时

• Standard product wire diagram: Work with design authority (overseas) to design, develop, and maintain standard wire diagram and list for automatic machines, robot palletizer标准产品电路图：与海外工程师一起设计、开发、标准化电路图及清单

• Project wire diagram: Customize OBOM and electrical diagram according to standard product diagram客户项目图纸：根据标准的产品电气原理图定制客户项目的OBOM和电路图

• Project start-up preparation: Set up and calibrate electrical and electronic components, download the PLC program, solving the electrical issues during testing客户项目调试准备：设置并校准电气元器件参数,下载PLC程序,解决测试过程中的电气问题

• To make new production introduction, coordinate with relevant department to ensure project is going ahead (focus on delivery, cost, quality) 新产品项目的导入，协调各部门确保项目顺利进行（关注货期，成本，质量）

• To effectively organize or lead implement of cost reduction project 有效组织或者领导降本项目的实施

• To support TS project implemented on site支持现场的精益生产活动

• To support quality improvement with quality people, support in supplier side, if necessary支持质量部门的质量改善，如果需要，需要到供应商进行支持

• Create SOP with support from quality people and operators在质量与现场的帮助下，创建标准作业指导书

• Follow up manufacturing and quality problems to find solutions负责对生产中遇到的制造和质量问题的跟进和方案的落实。

• Lead and push the lean manufacturing about safety, quality, efficiency and cost带领并推动针对安全、质量、效率、成本方面的持续改善。

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree (major in automation or electronic engineering or other related) 本科学历（自动化或电子工程类或相关专业）

• 8+ year work experience in electron industry 8年以上电子行业背景

• 5+year work experience in complete machine 5年以上整机行业

• Be excellent at English skill, independently communicate 良好的英语技能，能够进行独立沟通

• Be familiar with tools and fixtures in electrical installation and testing process 熟悉电气安装测试过程中的常用工具和工装。

• Use computer to make standard sheets such as work instruction 能熟练使用电脑并编制工作指导书等文件

• Experience in independently creating a complete electrical schematic using EPLAN 具备用EPLAN独立完成一套完整电气原理图经验

• Sense of being master 主人翁精神

• Patience, have sense of responsibility 耐心仔细，有责任感

jobs.description:
Am Standort Beilngries widmen sich rund 360 Mitarbeitende im Geschäftsbereich Grain Quality and Supply dem Anlagen- und Maschinenbau rund um die Themen Getreideverarbeitung sowie Mälzen & Brauen.
Dies umfasst die Reinigung, Trocknung, den Transport (inkl. Fördertechnik und Schiffsbeladung), die Lagerung und Digitalisierung, um Getreide vom Feld bis zum Verbraucher zu verarbeiten. Immer mit dem Fokus auf Effizienz, Produktqualität und Nachhaltigkeit.

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: Mit einem Dualen Studium zum Bachelor of Engineering (B.Eng.) Maschinenbau (m/w/d) in Kooperation mit Bühler und unserer Partnerhochschule TH Ingolstadt schlägst du einen sehr vielseitigen Weg für deine berufliche Laufbahn ein. Im Studium mit vertiefter Praxis wird keine Berufsausbildung parallel zum Studium absolviert, sondern während der vorlesungsfreien Zeit werden Praxisphasen im Unternehmen verbracht. Mit diesem Modell sammelst du etwa 50 Prozent mehr Praxiserfahrung als im regulären Studium. Der Studiengang vermittelt dir nicht nur fundierte theoretische und praktische Grundlagen des Maschinenbaus, sondern auch die nötige Methodenkompetenz, um komplexe technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen. Im Mittelpunkt steht eine ingenieurwissenschaftliche Ausbildung - optimal verknüpft mit wertvollen Praxiseinblicken in unser Unternehmen. • Theoriephasen im Studium: Vorlesungen u. a. in Mathematik, Mechanik, Thermodynamik und Elektrotechnik. Durch Wahlfächer wie Produktentwicklung und Produktion, Mechatronik oder Energietechnik kannst du eigene Schwerpunkte setzen • Praxisphasen bei Bühler: Einsätze z. B. in der Forschung & Entwicklung, Konstruktion, Qualitätsmanagement, Supply Chain Management oder Projektmanagement • Basics: Kennenlernen der grundlegenden Ingenieurkenntnisse in Mathematik, Physik, Mechanik und Werkstoffkunde • Spezialisierung: Du erlangst fachrichtungsbezogenes Wissen in der Konstruktion und Entwicklung • Die Methoden & Umsetzung: Lösungsorientierte Bearbeitung praktischer Engineering-Aufgaben u. a. durch Studien- und Praxisarbeiten und Erlangen von Sozial- und Methodenkompetenz • Raum für Orientierung: Du durchläufst die Abteilungen Lehrwerkstatt, Forschung und Entwicklung, Prototypenbau, Fertigungsplanung und Fertigungstechnik und lernst so alle möglichen Einsatzgebiete kennen, in denen du nach deinem Abschluss tätig werden könntest • Eigenverantwortung: Von Anfang an kannst du eigene Projekte übernehmen und arbeitest ausbildungsübergreifend mit anderen Auszubildenden z.B. an einem Nachhaltigkeitsprojekt Anforderungen: • Schulabschluss: Abitur (allgemein oder fachgebunden) oder Fachhochschulreife - idealerweise mit dem Leistungskurs Mathematik oder Physik • Interesse an Maschinenbau: Du findest Technik spannend und hast gutes räumliches und logisches Vorstellungsvermögen • Sprache & Persönlichkeit: Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie Offenheit für fremde Kulturen, Teamfähigkeit und Engagement • Praxis: Du möchtest studieren und gleichzeitig Praxiserfahrung sammeln • Digitalisierung & Leidenschaft: Du hast Lust, unsere digitale Zukunft voranzutreiben Wir bieten: Familiäre Unternehmenskultur Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit bester technischer Ausstattung Arbeiten Sie an einem modernen Arbeitsplatz, der mit den neuesten technischen Hilfsmitteln ausgestattet ist, um Ihre Produktivität und Innovation zu fördern. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Mitarbeitendenvorteile und Rabatte Geniessen Sie eine Vielzahl von Mitarbeitendenvorteilen und Ermässigungen, die Ihren Alltag erleichtern. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und erfahren Sie mehr. Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Grossartiger Kaffee und frisches Obst Geniessen Sie unsere Annehmlichkeiten, wie kostenlosen Premium-Kaffee und frisches Obst - für Ihren perfekten Start in den Tag! jobs.description:
Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen hochmotivierten Praktikanten (m/w/d) oder Werkstudenten (m/w/d) der unser Team in Alzenau tatkräftg unterstützt. Unser Wunschkollege (m/w/d) überzeugt durch Einsatzbereitschaft und Teamgeist und scheut sich nicht vor neuen Herausforderungen. Ergreife deine Chance und werde ein Teil der Bühler-Welt!

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.

Aufgaben: • Geschäftsprozesse optimieren und Schnittstellen definieren: Gemeinsam mit den verantwortlichen Fachabteilungen erstellst und überarbeitest du Geschäftsprozesse.
