jobs.title: R&D Engineer (m/f/d) Ion Beam Sputtering
jobs.description:
As an R&D Engineer (m/f/d) Ion Beam Sputtering, you will contribute to the further development of our LEYBOLD OPTICS IBS ion beam sputtering platforms. In this role, you will develop advanced thin-film coating processes and support the realization of innovative vacuum coating systems for demanding optical applications. If you enjoy working in an innovative technical environment, combining scientific understanding with hands-on engineering, we look forward to receiving your application.

Creating impact together at Bühler!
Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together. Aufgaben: • You develop and optimize ion beam sputtering processes for the deposition of optical thin-film systems • You are actively involved in the development, testing, and qualification of new components, process solutions, and system features • You coordinate and execute R&D projects in close collaboration with internal departments and external partners • You write development and application reports as well as scientific publications • You attend international conferences and technical events to follow the latest developments, present results, and build professional networks • You commission novel vacuum coating systems • You support our sales team and customers with technical expertise Anforderungen: • You have successfully completed a university degree e.g., in Physics, Applied Physics, Material Science, Physical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a comparable field • Experience in process development, experimental work, data evaluation, or system commissioning • Ideally, you have experience with ion beam sputtering systems, vacuum coating technology, optical thin films, or optical interference filters • You have a good command of English, German skills are of advantage • You have a structured, reliable, and solution-oriented way of working • You are willing to travel internationally to visit customers, support system commissioning, and attend conferences Wir bieten: Modern workplace with best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to support your productivity and innovation. Cross-cultural working environment The key to our success is our diverse workforce from at least 100 nationalities as well as our inclusive culture. Career and personal development We deliver a broad spectrum of learning opportunities through videos, e-learnings, classroom trainings, and webinars that offer training in formats that are short, relevant, engaging, personalized, and mobile. Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts designed to enhance your everyday life. Join our team and learn more. Canteen with healthy meal options Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices! Team and social events Your engagement makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our holidays parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities to do so. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: Entwicklungsingenieur (m/w/d) Ionenstrahl-Sputtern
jobs.description:
Als R&D Engineer (m/w/d) Ion Beam Sputtering tragen Sie zur Weiterentwicklung unserer LEYBOLD OPTICS IBS-Ionenstrahl-Sputterplattformen bei. In dieser Rolle entwickeln Sie fortschrittliche Dünnschicht-Beschichtungsprozesse und unterstützen die Realisierung innovativer Vakuumbeschichtungssysteme für anspruchsvolle optische Anwendungen. Wenn Sie gerne in einem innovativen technischen Umfeld arbeiten und wissenschaftliches Verständnis mit praxisorientiertem Engineering verbinden, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

Lassen Sie uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Sie entwickeln und optimieren Ionenstrahl-Sputterprozesse zur Abscheidung optischer Dünnschichtsysteme • Sie sind aktiv an der Entwicklung, Erprobung und Qualifizierung neuer Komponenten, Prozesslösungen und Systemfunktionen beteiligt • Sie koordinieren und führen F&E-Projekte in enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen Abteilungen und externen Partnern durch • Sie verfassen Entwicklungs- und Anwendungsberichte sowie wissenschaftliche Publikationen • Sie nehmen an internationalen Konferenzen und Fachveranstaltungen teil, um die neuesten Entwicklungen zu verfolgen, Ergebnisse zu präsentieren und berufliche Netzwerke aufzubauen • Sie nehmen neuartige Vakuumbeschichtungssysteme in Betrieb • Sie unterstützen unser Vertriebsteam und unsere Kunden mit technischem Fachwissen Anforderungen: • Sie haben ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes technisches Studium z. B. in Physik, Angewandter Physik, Materialwissenschaften, Physikalischer Technik, Optiktechnik, Elektrotechnik oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet • Sie verfügen über Erfahrung in der Prozessentwicklung, experimentellen Arbeit, Datenauswertung oder Inbetriebnahme von Systemen • Idealerweise haben Sie Erfahrung mit Ionenstrahl-Sputtersystemen, Vakuumbeschichtungstechnologie, optischen Dünnschichten oder optischen Interferenzfiltern • Sie verfügen über gute Englischkenntnisse; Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil • Sie zeichnen sich durch eine strukturierte, zuverlässige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise aus • Sie sind bereit, international zu reisen, um Kunden zu besuchen, Systeminbetriebnahmen zu unterstützen und an Konferenzen teilzunehmen Wir bieten: Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit bester technischer Ausstattung Arbeiten Sie an einem modernen Arbeitsplatz, der mit den neuesten technischen Hilfsmitteln ausgestattet ist, um Ihre Produktivität und Innovation zu fördern. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung Wir bieten ein breites Spektrum an Lernmöglichkeiten, wie Videos, Online-Schulungen, Präsenzschulungen und Webinare mit kurzen, relevanten, ansprechenden, personalisierten und mobilen Formaten. Mitarbeitendenvorteile und Rabatte Geniessen Sie eine Vielzahl von Mitarbeitendenvorteilen und Ermässigungen, die Ihren Alltag erleichtern. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und erfahren Sie mehr. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge oder vermögenswirksame Leistungen Profitiere von unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge oder vermögenswirksamen Leistungen – für eine sichere Zukunft! Kantine mit gesunden Mahlzeiten Geniessen Sie gesunde Mahlzeiten in unserer Kantine zu fairen Preisen. jobs.title: Solution Architect (Customer Service Systems)

titleByLocale.fr: Architecte de Solutions (Systèmes de Service Client)

jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Solution Architect to design and deliver creative, scalable solutions across our global Customer Service business. In this role, you will shape the architecture of our service processes across SAP S/4HANA, SAP CS, SM & SD, Service Cloud (C4C V2), SAP Field Service Management, and Asset Manager. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, developers, and implementation partners to ensure robust, future-ready service solutions.

Aufgaben:
• You design and deliver high-quality solution architectures for the Epics and initiatives you own

• You elaborate solution concepts, perform requirements engineering, and create system and program specifications

• You coordinate internal and external development partners, including quality checks and testing

• You independently perform SAP S/4HANA CS/SM/SD/FSM customizing and document system setups

• You support global implementation projects and provide third-level support for global users

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in business informatics, computer science, engineering, or a comparable field

• 5+ years of professional experience, including 2+ years in a similar Solution Architect or Application Manager role

• Strong experience with SAP S/4HANA Customer Service (CS), Sales & Distribution (SD) as well as experience with Service Management in S/4

• Proven ability to create architecture deliverables in both waterfall and Agile environments

• Fluency in English, with strong communication and collaboration skills

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement
Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking.

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Health-Port
We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Cerchiamo una soluzione pratica per progettare e fornire soluzioni creative e scalabili in tutta la nostra attività di servizio clienti globale. In questo ruolo, formerai l'architettura dei nostri processi di servizio attraverso SAP S/4HANA, SAP CS, SM & SD, Service Cloud (C4C V2), SAP Field Service Management e Asset Manager. Collaborerai strettamente con stakeholder aziendali, sviluppatori e partner di implementazione per garantire soluzioni di servizio robuste e future-ready. Aufgaben:
• Progetti e consegni architetture di alta qualità per le Epics e le iniziative che possiedi
• elabora concetti di soluzioni, esegue l'ingegneria dei requisiti e crea specifiche di sistema e programma
• Coordina partner di sviluppo interni ed esterni, compresi controlli e test di qualità
• Esegui indipendentemente SAP S/4HANA CS/SM/SD/FSM personalizzazione e setup di sistemi di documenti
• Supporti progetti di attuazione globali e fornisci supporto di terzo livello agli utenti globali Anforderungen:
• Laurea in informatica aziendale, informatica, ingegneria o un campo comparabile
• 5+ anni di esperienza professionale, compresi 2+ anni in un simile ruolo di Solution Architect o Application Manager
• Forte esperienza con SAP S/4HANA Customer Service (CS), Sales & Distribution (SD) e esperienza con Service Management in S/4
• Progettazione di soluzioni architettoniche in ambienti sia cascate che Agile
• Flessibilità in inglese, con forti capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione Wirbieten: Attraente diritto alla vacation Abbastanza tempo per rilassarsi e interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacation all'anno a seconda del periodo di vacanza Eta'. Concetto di mobilità attraente Offriamo una OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + travelcard a metà prezzo per CHF 365 + CHF 400 credito di trasporto pubblico, nonché una carta di viaggio di prima classe attraente o parcheggio gratuito.VIVA Restaurant Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu fitness giornaliero a partire da 9, 00 CHF. Piani pensionistici finanziati dai datori di lavoro Il Fondo Pensione Bühler offre ai dipendenti Bühler un fondo pensionistico indipendente che garantisce una sicurezza finanziaria affidabile in pensione: www.pk-buhler.ch Health-Port Ci impegniamo a prevenire l'assistenza sanitaria attraverso analisi di laboratorio, trucchi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine. Bühler punta a bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sblocchino opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, dei mangimi e della mobilità globale. Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con una particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, collaboriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e mondo accademico per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

jobs.title: Quotation Specialist
jobs.description:
The Quotation Specialist supports Customer Service, Outside Sales, and Bühler Group teams by preparing accurate quotations, processing orders, coordinating internal documentation, and supporting customer growth. This role helps develop existing and new customer opportunities, contributes to monthly sales targets at appropriate gross margins, and ensures timely, professional communication throughout the quotation and order process.
The position serves as an internal coordinator from initial customer request through order receipt and delivery, working closely with customers, vendors, sales, engineering, procurement, manufacturing, finance, accounting, purchasing, and shipping. Aufgaben: • Respond to customer inquiries and direct requests to the appropriate contact when needed. • Understand the customers' needs; able to accurately identify spare parts, calculate pricing, and provide detailed shipping information & documentation. • Prepare cost sheets, quotations, and customer proposals. • Coordinate with vendors, procurement, engineering, and manufacturing to obtain current pricing, lead times, and product information. • Price manufactured items while supporting standard margin objectives. • Work with outside sales engineers to develop complete and accurate proposals. • Follow up with customers on proposal status and provide updates on order status. • Review new projects with engineering as needed. • Review historical documentation and databases to support quotation and order accuracy. • Investigate quality issues & customer complaints; understand the root cause and implement quality gates to prevent recurrence. • Participate in departmental training and continuous improvement efforts • Other tasks as deemed necessary by management. Anforderungen: Job Specifications • Bachelor's degree is a plus but not required. • 1–3 years of inside sales, customer service, or related experience preferred. • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite with exceptional verbal, written, and communication skills. • Experience with business systems such as SAP and CRM • Mechanical mindset with aptitude for navigating the Windchill environment to access, interpret, and process engineering drawings, CAD models, and BOMs Knowledge, Skills and Abilities • Strong organizational, prioritization, and problem-solving skills. • Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously with accuracy and attention to detail. • Professional communication skills, both verbal and written. • Ability to build strong working relationships with customers, vendors, colleagues, and internal departments. • Customer-focused mindset with strong service, quality, value, and reliability orientation. • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while following company guidelines. • Sound judgment, timely decision-making, and willingness to take responsibility. • Ability to identify risks, propose solutions, and support continuous improvement. • Flexibility, adaptability, and openness to change. • Strong teamwork, conflict-resolution, and cross-functional coordination skills. • Professional appearance, self-confidence, persistence, and self-motivation. • Industry awareness, including competitors, market trends, and business opportunities. • Keen investigator and researcher; proficient at finding missing details • Buhler TOP value proponent; contributes to improving the company culture Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. jobs.title: Order Processing Executive

titleByLocale.fr: Direction générale du traitement des commandes

jobs.description:
Aufgaben:
• Part of a team responsible to process single machines and small project orders in SAP from Order to Delivery for the assigned countries.

• Single point of contact on Order Commercial and Delivery matters between Project Manager and intercompany Supplier.

• Day to day process includes but not limited to:

• Create Sales Order in SAP accurately and timely.

• Issue purchase order to Suppliers and follow up Order confirmation to ensure project timeline is met.

• Close monitoring of machine readiness and ensure timely delivery and completeness of invoice.

• Data maintenance in SAP to ensure up to date information for accurate turnover forecast

• Prepare Invoices and sending it to Sales / customers.

• Co-ordinate with Sales manager / Project Manager to collect outstanding payment.

• Co-ordinate in arranging shipping documents such as Packing list and Bill of Lading (B/L) and co-ordinate with forwarder / Logistic department for shipment.

• Maintenance of documentation in SAP (softcopies of various documents in relevant folder).

• Participate in monthly project reviews with Project Manager and Project Controller.

• Work closely with Sales team and Project Execution team to handle customer's enquiries and to meet project time schedule. Provide correct and prompt response to internal and external customers enquiries professionally and timely.

• Other adhoc duties as assigned

Anforderungen:
• Diploma/Bachelor Degree; preferably in Business Management / Supply Chain

• Minimum 4 years Knowledge in Order Management & Logistic Process

• Working knowledge of SAP systems is a plus

• Experience in project support is an advantage

• Proficient in English, both written and spoken

• Able to handle full cycle of order fulfilment and order management

• Good knowledge of Incoterms

• Strong in excel and MS office

jobs.title: Servicetechniker (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir freuen uns auf ein engagiertes Teammitglied (m/w/d), welches unser Service-Team im Kundendienst der Business Area Grinding & Dispersing tatkräftig durch Eigeninitiative, Flexibilität und Kundenorientierung unterstützt. In Ihrer Rolle als Servicetechniker (m/w/d) überzeugen Sie durch Einsatzbereitschaft und Kommunikationsstärke und scheuen sich nicht vor neuen Herausforderungen. Ergreifen Sie Ihre Chance und werden Sie Teil der Bühler-Welt

Lassen Sie uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Sie führen Inbetriebnahmen und Servicearbeiten wie Reparaturen, Umbauten, Inspektionen, Instandsetzungen und Wartungen von Einzelmaschinen und Anlagen im In- und Ausland durch • Sie übernehmen technische Betreuung bzw. -unterstützung unseres weltweiten Kundenstamms telefonisch oder vor Ort und pflegen Kundenkontakte • Sie analysieren und beheben Fehler/ Probleme mit den entsprechenden Fachabteilungen • Sie schulen Mitarbeiter der Kunden während des Serviceeinsatzes im Bereich Maschinenbedienung • Sie arbeiten mit an der Aktualisierung der Maschinensoftware Anforderungen: • Sie haben eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Mechatroniker (m/w/d), Industriemechaniker (m/w/d), Elektriker (m/w/d) oder vergleichbar, gerne mit Weiterbildung zum Meister/ Techniker (m/w/d) oder ein Studium im Bereich Elektrotechnik • Sie verfügen über Berufserfahrung im Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, idealerweise im Bereich Dispergier- und Nassmahltechnik • Sie haben Kenntnisse in der SPS Steuerung (Siemens) • Sie kommunizieren sehr gut in Englisch • Eine selbstständige und kundenorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie eine weltweite Reisebereitschaft runden Ihr Profil ab Wir bieten: Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit bester technischer Ausstattung Arbeiten Sie an einem modernen Arbeitsplatz, der mit den neuesten technischen Hilfsmitteln ausgestattet ist, um Ihre Produktivität und Innovation zu fördern. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung Wir bieten ein breites Spektrum an Lernmöglichkeiten, wie Videos, Online-Schulungen, Präsenzschulungen und Webinare mit kurzen, relevanten, ansprechenden, personalisierten und mobilen Formaten. Mitarbeitendenvorteile und Rabatte Geniessen Sie eine Vielzahl von Mitarbeitendenvorteilen und Ermässigungen, die Ihren Alltag erleichtern. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und erfahren Sie mehr. Kantine mit gesunden Mahlzeiten Geniessen Sie gesunde Mahlzeiten in unserer Kantine zu fairen Preisen. Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien und stetiges Wachstum. descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler Leybold Optics è sinonimo di tecnologie innovative e crescita costante. Come parte del Gruppo Bühler, un gruppo di ingegneria globale con oltre 13.000 dipendenti, siamo uno dei principali produttori di sistemi di rivestimento sottovuoto ad alta tecnologia. Da oltre 150 anni, abbiamo offerto ai nostri clienti una vasta gamma di attrezzature per il rivestimento di vetro architettonico, occhiali, componenti ottici in smartphone, auto, tecnologia medica e molto altro ancora. Il nostro team internazionale riesce a stabilire nuovi standard ogni giorno e ad implementare con successo progetti complessi. > Nel ruolo di ingegnere (m/f/d) nella messa in servizio di processo, è possibile dimostrare la vostra creatività nella soluzione di problemi in un ambiente innovativo. Con le vostre capacità di comunicazione e dedizione, ispirate non solo noi, ma anche i nostri clienti - direttamente sul posto. Applicare ora e diventare parte del nostro team.
Facciamo una differenza insieme a Bühler! Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. > Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. > Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme. Compiti: • Sei responsabile del processo di messa in servizio di impianti di rivestimento sottovuoto in-house e in loco presso la sede del cliente in Germania e all'estero • Sei responsabile per l'impostazione, l'ottimizzazione e la documentazione dei processi di rivestimento • Essi svolgono lavori di servizio legati al processo e accettazione tecnica degli impianti • Lavorare con sviluppo, progettazione, software, project management e servizio clienti Migliora continuamente i nostri processi e prodotti in Requisiti • Hai completato con successo studi tecnici, ad esempio nei campi della fisica, delle scienze dei materiali, dell'ingegneria fisica, dell'ingegneria elettrica o simili • Idealmente, avete esperienza in PVD, sorgenti di plasma e sistemi ad alto vuoto. • Se hai già conoscenza dei sistemi di interferenze ottiche, questo è un vantaggio • Si parla molto bene la lingua inglese, la conoscenza del tedesco è un vantaggio • Sono giocatori di squadra e sono caratterizzati da affidabilità e forza di comunicazione • Una volontà mondiale di viaggiare per il tuo profilo Offriamo: Posto di lavoro moderno con le migliori attrezzature tecniche Lavorare in un luogo di lavoro moderno dotato degli ultimi strumenti tecnici per aumentare la produttività e l'innovazione. Ambiente di lavoro interculturale La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da più di 100 nazioni e la nostra cultura inclusiva. Sviluppo professionale e personale Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di apprendimento, come video, formazione online, formazione faccia a faccia e webinar con formati brevi, rilevanti, coinvolgenti, personalizzati e mobili. Vantaggi e sconti dei dipendenti Godetevi una varietà di vantaggi e sconti per i dipendenti che rendono la vostra vita quotidiana più facile. Diventa parte della nostra squadra e scopri di più. Previdenza sociale Approfittate delle nostre pensioni aziendali o dei servizi di asset-generazione – per un futuro sicuro! Mensa con pasti sani Godetevi pasti sani nella nostra mensa a prezzi equi. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and steady growth. As part of the Bühler Group, a global engineering group with over 13,000 employees, we are one of the leading manufacturers of high-tech thin-film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have offered our customers a wide range of equipment for the coating of architectural glass, eyeglasses, optical components in smartphones, cars, medical technology and much more. Our international team succeeds in setting new standards every day and successfully implementing complex projects.

In the role of engineer (m/f/d) in process commissioning, you can demonstrate your creativity in solving problems in an innovative environment. With your communication skills and dedication, you inspire not only us, but also our customers - directly on site. Apply now and become part of our team.

Let us at Bühler make a difference together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Bühler Leybold Optics est synonyme de technologies innovantes et de croissance soutenue. Dans le cadre du groupe Bühler, un groupe d'ingénierie mondial comptant plus de 13 000 employés, nous sommes l'un des principaux fabricants de systèmes de revêtement sous vide à film mince de haute technologie. Depuis plus de 150 ans, nous offrons à nos clients une large gamme d'équipements pour le revêtement de verre architectural, de lunettes, de composants optiques dans les smartphones, les voitures, la technologie médicale et bien plus encore. Notre équipe internationale réussit à établir de nouvelles normes chaque jour et à mettre en oeuvre avec succès des projets complexes.

Dans le rôle de l'ingénieur (m/f/d) dans la mise en service de processus, vous pouvez démontrer votre créativité dans la résolution de problèmes dans un environnement innovant. Avec vos compétences en communication et votre dévouement, vous inspirez non seulement nous, mais aussi nos clients - directement sur le site. Faites une demande maintenant et faites partie de notre équipe.

À Bühler, faisons la différence ensemble !
Deux milliards de personnes mangent de la nourriture produite sur des plantes de Bühler chaque jour. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler.
Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins de l'économie, des personnes et de la nature. De cette manière, nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales des aliments pour animaux, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité.
Nous voulons créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble. Tâches : • Vous êtes responsable du processus de mise en service des usines de revêtement sous vide en interne et sur place dans les locaux du client en Allemagne et à l'étranger • Vous êtes responsable du réglage, de l'optimisation et de la documentation des processus de revêtement • Ils effectuent des travaux de service liés aux procédés et acceptent les installations • Travailler avec le développement, la conception, le logiciel, la gestion de projet et le service à la clientèle Vous améliorez continuellement nos processus et nos produits Exigences • Vous avez complété avec succès des études techniques, par exemple dans les domaines de la physique, des sciences des matériaux, du génie physique, du génie électrique ou de la comparaison • Idéalement, vous avez de l'expérience en PVD, sources de plasma et systèmes à vide élevé. • Si vous connaissez déjà les systèmes de couche d'interférence optique, c'est un avantage • Vous parlez très bien l'anglais, la connaissance de l'allemand est un avantage • Ils sont des joueurs d'équipe et se caractérisent par la fiabilité et la force de communication • Une volonté mondiale de voyager complète votre profil Nous offrons: Un lieu de travail moderne avec le meilleur équipement technique Travaillez dans un lieu de travail moderne équipé des derniers outils techniques pour stimuler votre productivité et votre innovation. jobs.title: Regional Finance Business Partner (Customer Service)
jobs.description:
Aufgaben:
• Strategic Partnering : Collaborate with CFO, CS Sales and Operations leaders to align customer service strategies with overall business goals.

• Financial Stewardship : Prepare and interpret financial reports, providing actionable insights that guide decision-making and resource allocation.

• Performance Management : Monitor Service KPIs including turnover, margin and coverage difference, proactively identifying risks and opportunities to improve service delivery.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with regional and global teams to address service coverage gaps and implement solutions that strengthen customer satisfaction.

• Data-Driven Insights : Use analytics and market intelligence to recommend process improvements and innovative approaches that enhance efficiency and competitiveness.

• Continuous Improvement : Lead initiatives that optimize the Lead-to-Cash process, ensuring seamless integration between finance and customer service.

• Influence & Communication : Present clear, concise updates to stakeholders, influencing decisions with evidence-based recommendations.

• Market Awareness : Stay ahead of industry trends and emerging technologies, advising leadership on opportunities to evolve customer service capabilities.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years' experience in financial analysis, reporting, and data interpretation.

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, SAP S/4 Hana and data visualization tools (SAP Analytics).

• Experience in partnering with cross-functional teams to drive business outcomes.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: Customer Service Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sales-driven Customer Service professional to grow Bühler's after-sales business in Thailand for Human and Animal Nutrition. This role will drive service sales, develop customer relationships, and convert opportunities into orders, working closely with the sales and service teams.

Aufgaben:
• Achieve sales targets (orders, revenue, margin, pipeline).

• Identify, develop, and close Customer Service opportunities.

• Grow service business across spare parts, service agreements, retrofits, upgrades, and field services.

• Build strong relationships with customers and understand their operational needs.

• Translate customer challenges (e.g., downtime, efficiency, quality, cost) into solutions.

• Manage sales pipeline, quotations, and forecasts using CRM tools.

• Drive recurring revenue through service contracts and long-term agreements.

• Collaborate with internal teams to deliver competitive proposals.

• Provide market insights on customer needs, competitors, and pricing.

Anforderungen:
• Degree/Diploma in Engineering, Business, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in service, aftermarket, or technical sales.

• Proven track record in sales and customer relationship management.

• Experience in machinery, spare parts, or industrial solutions preferred.

• Fluent in Thai and English.

• Familiarity with CRM and digital/AI sales tools is a plus.

• Knowledge of food/feed processing industries is an advantage.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
The key account manager (KAM) is responsible for handling Buhler's strategically important client accounts This person must build and maintain long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships with such key accounts. S/he will be the main point of contact for all key account matters and is required to understand the client's needs and collaborate with other internal functions and business units to ensure that clients succeed in achieving their business objectives. jobs.title: Project Manager (Engineering)
jobs.description:
Managing and leading the project team-including internal stakeholders, subcontractors, and consortium partners, as applicable-as well as coordinating with external interfaces for projects of up to high complexity.

Aufgaben:
• Manage and lead the project team to achieve and further improve the cost, schedule, quality and EHS targets

• Supervise the final negotiations for the allocated project and provides the execution strategy

• Ensures that the project schedule baseline is signed by the involved parties at the start of the project

• Perform proper risk and opportunity management

• Prepare and perform Project Reviews as requested, report according Bühler Project Management process

• Responsible for the site briefing meeting; Ensures that all site relevant documents are handed over to site personnel

• Ensure forecasting accuracy and monitor project KPIs including Schedule Performance Index (SPI) and Cost Performance Index (CPI), timely Turnover (TO) and manual TO Pulls if needed, to drive project success

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Engineering

• Minimum 4 years as Project Manager or proof of sufficient skills (full cycle project management)

• Plant Engineering experience preferred

• Preferably PMI/PMP Certification

• Strong planning, organizing and priority setting skills, with a proven ability to manage teams

• Ability to work in a matrix organization

• Strong problem-solving skills

• Strong teamwork and leadership skills

• Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to interface effectively with people inside and outside of the company

jobs.title: Team Manager, Service Operations
jobs.description:
This role is responsible for leading and optimizing customer service operations, including field service engineering, service performance management and customer-centric service execution. This role will oversee service teams, improve operation efficiency, manage key service KPIs, and support the growth of service-related business areas such as field service, spare parts, workshops, service contracts and technical advisory services.

Aufgaben:
• Lead and manage the field service engineer team, ensuring effective resource allocation and operational efficiency.

• Develop and implement customer service workforce strategies, including recruitment, development, deployment, and capability building.

• Standardize and improve service operation processes to enhance execution quality and consistency.

• Support service sales activities by identifying customer needs and business opportunities.

• Manage and improve key customer service KPIs, including service cost, engineer utilization, productivity, and operational performance.

• Drive profitability through effective management of service, workshop, and spare parts business operations.

• Manage and prioritize the service product portfolio based on business needs, customer value, and growth potential.

• Develop and execute mid-to-long-term growth strategies for the customer service business.

• Analyze customer service operation needs and develop growth plans for areas such as parts, field service, service contracts, and technical advisory services.

• Lead customer communication during project execution and service delivery.

• Collect and analyze customer feedback to identify service improvement opportunities and new business potential.

• Collaborate with executive management and cross-functional stakeholders to make effective operational and business decisions.

Anforderungen:
• Minimum 3 years of experience managing a plant, facility, or field service organization

• Understanding of engineering, mechanical systems or facility service operation.

• Experience in service business operation s and P&L management

• Proven leadership experience managing field service engineers or technical service teams

• Experience in performance management and business operation within a service or technology-based organization.

• Proven track record of delivering results with strong ownership, responsibility, and execution capability

jobs.title: Supply Chain Planner (Demand Planning)
jobs.description:
Planning and execution of Supply Chain in Customer Projects. Ensure seamless and accurate scheduling that aligns with business, project, and manufacturing requirements, with particular emphasis on timely delivery.

Aufgaben:
• Convert business information into demand planning within the system, verify capacity across different factories, and ensure financial performance aligns with targets

• Review quotations to check lead times, consider factory workload in line with the requirements of the business

• Coordinating closely and collaborating with Commercial team, Procurement, Shipping and Manufacturing

• Define supply chain events for all components based on project strategy, lead times and given capacities

• Draft, adjust and update the event schedule and prepare event schedule for kick-off meetings

• Track major events, monitor progress and proactively define actions with the Project Manager, the Supply Chain and Logistics in case of deviation or delay

• Act as Single point of contact within the Sales & Operations Planning Process for Project Manager, Supply Chain and Logistics

• Manage and coordinate factory supplies, ensuring a balanced supply plan that aligns project priorities and factory requirements with the manufacturing planner

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's Degree in a technical field or equivalent, Master's degree in a technical field will be considered as a plus

• 1 to 2 years of experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain Management, or Project Planning

• Very good communication skills in English, any additional language will be considered as a plus

• Strong ability in the use of SAP, MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Analysis) and SAP IBP

• Strong customer focused problem solving and conflict management skills

• Team spirit and well-developed communication skills as well as the ability to work within an interdisciplinary and international environment

jobs.title: Ausbildung: Industriekauffrau/-mann (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Als Teil der Bühler Group, einem weltweit agierenden Maschinenbaukonzern mit über 12.000 Mitarbeitenden, sind wir einer der führenden Hersteller von Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren bieten wir unseren Kunden ein breites Angebot an Anlagen für die Beschichtung von Architekturglas, Brillengläsern, optischen Komponenten in Smartphones, Autos, Medizintechnik und vielem mehr. Unserem internationalen Team gelingt es täglich neue Maßstäbe zu setzen und komplexe Projekte erfolgreich umzusetzen.


Wir suchen einen motivierten Auszubildenden (m/w/d), der unser Team in Alzenau tatkräftig unterstützt. Du bist engagiert, zuverlässig und möchtest eigenständig Aufgaben übernehmen? Dann bewerbe dich jetzt und werde Teil unseres Teams!

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Während deiner Ausbildung zum/zur Industriekaufmann/-frau (m/w/d) erhältst du umfassende Einblicke in alle wichtigen kaufmännischen und betriebswirtschaftlichen Bereiche unseres Unternehmens. • Du lernst systematisch verschiedene Abteilungen kennen, z. B. Einkauf, Kundensupport und Finanzwesen, und baust dabei kontinuierlich deine Kenntnisse in Fremdsprachen, EDV sowie Präsentations- und Kommunikationstechniken aus. • Du arbeitest an abteilungsübergreifenden Projekten mit und unterstützt das Management bei vielfältigen Aufgaben. Anforderungen: • Mindestens einen guten mittleren Schulabschluss • Gute Leistungen in Deutsch, Mathematik und Englisch • Interesse an kaufmännischen und organisatorischen Tätigkeiten • Sicherer Umgang mit dem Computer • Teamfähigkeit, Kommunikationsstärke und Kreativität Wir bieten: Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Kantine mit gesunden Mahlzeiten Geniessen Sie gesunde Mahlzeiten in unserer Kantine zu fairen Preisen. Familiäre Unternehmenskultur Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung Wir bieten ein breites Spektrum an Lernmöglichkeiten, wie Videos, Online-Schulungen, Präsenzschulungen und Webinare mit kurzen, relevanten, ansprechenden, personalisierten und mobilen Formaten. Mitarbeitendenvorteile und Rabatte Geniessen Sie eine Vielzahl von Mitarbeitendenvorteilen und Ermässigungen, die Ihren Alltag erleichtern. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und erfahren Sie mehr. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden. Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen. Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen.

jobs.title: Cash & FX Management Specialist

titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste de la gestion de la trésorerie et des finances

jobs.description:
As a Cash & FX Management Specialist, you will join our Corporate Treasury team and contribute to a highly international and dynamic environment. Based at our headquarters in Uzwil, you will support our global organization in more than 80 countries with banking services across cash and liquidity management, payment transactions, foreign exchange risk management and investments. Acting as a key link between our internal stakeholders and our banking partners, you will help ensure efficient, secure and transparent Treasury operations across the Group.

Aufgaben:
• You support daily Treasury operations, including cash management, FX activities, and periodic FX and interest rate fixings

• You manage intercompany processes such as monthly netting cycles, internal FX hedging, and cash pool administration with interest calculations

• You ensure accurate FX accounting by handling month-end valuation, hedge accounting, and financial result reporting

• You oversee treasury-related accounting tasks in collaboration with global teams and liaise with banks and internal stakeholders on payment matters

• You administer and enhance Treasury systems, support bank connectivity (EBICS/SWIFT), and contribute to automation and process improvement projects

Anforderungen:
• Degree in a relevant field such as Finance, Business Administration, Economics or a comparable discipline

• Experience in Treasury Accounting or Banking with strong Excel skills, solid data analysis capabilities and knowledge of SAP

• Technical and analytical strengths including quick comprehension, system understanding and the ability to automate workflows

• Independent and collaborative working style marked by professionalism, friendly interaction and effective teamwork

• Fluency in English and German

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement
Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking.

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Sports activities
We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness.

Health-Port
We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Come Specialista di Gestione Cash & FX, unirai il nostro team Corporate Treasury e contribuirà a un ambiente altamente internazionale e dinamico. Con sede a Uzwil, sosterrai la nostra organizzazione globale in più di 80 paesi con servizi bancari attraverso la gestione di cassa e liquidità, transazioni di pagamento, gestione del rischio di cambio e investimenti. Agendo come un collegamento chiave tra i nostri stakeholder interni e i nostri partner bancari, aiuterai a garantire operazioni di Tesoro efficienti, sicure e trasparenti in tutto il Gruppo. Aufgaben:
• Sostieni le operazioni quotidiane del Tesoro, compresa la gestione del contante, le attività FX e le correzioni periodiche dei tassi di interesse
• Gestisci processi interaziendali come cicli di compensazione mensili, copertura interna FX e amministrazione del pool di cassa con calcoli di interessi
• Garantisci l'accurata contabilità FX gestendo la valutazione di fine mese, la contabilizzazione delle operazioni di copertura e la segnalazione dei risultati finanziari
• Soprintende alle attività di contabilità relative al tesoro in collaborazione con squadre globali e contatti con banche e stakeholder interni in materia di pagamenti
• Amministri e potenzia i sistemi del Tesoro, supporto alla connettività bancaria (EBICS/SWIFT) e contribuisce a progetti di automazione e miglioramento dei processi Anforderungen:
• Laurea in un settore rilevante come Finance, Business Administration, Economics o una disciplina comparabile
• Esperienza in Treasury Accounting o Banking con forti competenze Excel, solide capacità di analisi dei dati e conoscenza di SAP
• Punti di forza tecnici e analitici tra cui la comprensione rapida, la comprensione del sistema e la capacità di automatizzare i flussi di lavoro
• Stile di lavoro indipendente e collaborativo caratterizzato da professionalità, interazione amichevole e lavoro di squadra efficace
• Fluenza in inglese e tedesco Wirbiet: Attraente diritto alla vacation Abbastanza tempo per rilassarsi e interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacation all'anno a seconda dell'età. Concetto di mobilità attraente Offriamo una OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + travelcard a metà prezzo per CHF 365 + CHF 400 credito di trasporto pubblico, nonché una carta di viaggio di prima classe attraente o parcheggio gratuito.VIVA Restaurant Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu fitness giornaliero a partire da 9, 00 CHF. Piani pensionistici finanziati dai datori di lavoro Il Fondo Pensioni Bühler offre ai dipendenti Bühler un fondo pensionistico indipendente che garantisce una sicurezza finanziaria affidabile nel pensionamento: www.pk-buhler.ch Attività sportive Promuoviamo l'attività fisica attraverso la formazione auto-organizzata del circuito e gruppi di corsa, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e la fedeltà Activ.Salute-Port Ci impegniamo a prevenire la salute attraverso analisi di laboratorio, trucchi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli i cui componenti sono stati fabbricati con le nostre macchine. Bühler mira a bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sblocchino opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con una particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, collaboriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e mondo accademico per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

• Sie verwalten zwischenbetriebliche Prozesse wie monatliche fting-Zyklen, interne FX-Hedging und Cash-Pool-Verwaltung mit Zinsberechnungen
• Sie gewährleisten eine genaue FX-Buchhaltung durch die Bearbeitung von Monatsend-Bewertungen, Hedge-Buchhaltung und Finanzergebnisberichterstattung
• Sie überwachen die finanzministeriumbezogenen Buchhaltungsaufgaben in Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Teams und unterhalten mit Banken und internen Stakeholdern in Zahlungsangelegenheiten
• Sie verwalten und verbessern die Treasury-Systeme, Unterstützung der Bankenkonnektivität (EBICS/SWIFT) und Beitrag zu Automatisierungs- und Prozessverbesserungsprojekten ellen:
• Abschluss in einem relevanten Bereich wie Finanzen, Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaft oder einer vergleichbaren Disziplin
• Erfahrung im Treasury Accounting oder Banking mit starken Excel-Fähigkeiten, soliden Datenanalysefähigkeiten und Kenntnissen von SAP

jobs.title: Treasury Analyst
jobs.description:
As a Treasury Analyst, you will be part of the Treasury team at our headquarters in Uzwil, which ensures the financial stability of the Group. They support our subsidiaries with insightful analyses, clear and reliable reports, cash planning and intra-group financing, contribute to group-wide liquidity management and coordinate intra-group dividend processes. You will also manage the KYC/UBO information requests and bank credit lines.

Aufgaben:
• You manage Treasury Reporting by analyzing monthly reports, commenting on results and supporting FX and daily cash management

• You drive cash flow planning by preparing Group cash flow forecasts and leading an AI‑enabled forecasting project

• You oversee internal financing by managing intercompany loans, dividends and cash‑pooling agreements

• You support governance and compliance by contributing to the annual report, processing KYC/UBO information requests and managing bank credit lines

• You contribute to strategic initiatives by supporting the Supply Chain Finance Program and participating in global Treasury projects

Anforderungen:
• Degree in a relevant field such as Finance, Business Administration, Economics or a comparable discipline

• Professional experience in Corporate Treasury or Banking combined with strong analytical skills for critical financial assessment

• Structured and reliable working style paired with strong communication abilities and effective collaboration with internal and external stakeholders

• Proficiency with a Treasury Management System (e.g. Coupa)

• Fluency in English and German

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement
Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking.

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Sports activities
We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness.

Health-Port
We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.

jobs.description:
Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien und stetiges Wachstum. Als Teil der Bühler Group, einem weltweit agierenden Maschinenbaukonzern mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden, sind wir einer der führenden Hersteller von Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren bieten wir unseren Kunden ein breites Angebot an Anlagen für die Beschichtung von Architekturglas, Brillengläsern, optischen Komponenten in Smartphones, Autos, Medizintechnik und vielem mehr. Unserem internationalen Team gelingt es tagtäglich neue Maßstäbe zu setzen und komplexe Projekte erfolgreich umzusetzen.

Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen hochmotivierten Werkstudenten (m/w/d) der unser Team in Alzenau tatkräftig unterstützt. Unser Wunschkollege (m/w/d) überzeugt durch Einsatzbereitschaft und Teamgeist und scheut sich nicht vor neuen Herausforderungen. Ergreife deine Chance und werde ein Teil der Bühler-Welt!

Lassen Sie uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Du wertest regelmäßig Importvorgänge zur Überprüfung von Steuerbescheiden gemäß Risikomatrix aus • Du prüfst eingehende Speditionsrechnungen und gleichst diese mit den entsprechenden Zollbelegen ab • Du erstellst und analysierst Auswertungen für den CBAM-Report im Zusammenhang mit der CO₂-Ausgleichsabgabe • Du unterstützt bei projektbezogenen Export-Compliance-Prüfungen • Du wirkst bei der Prüfung und Korrektur von Steuerbescheiden mit • Du unterstützt bei der Einholung und Verwaltung von Lieferantenerklärungen Anforderungen: • Du bist immatrikulierte/r Student/in der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs • Idealerweise bringst Du bereits eine Ausbildung zum Industriekaufmann / zur Industriekauffrau mit • Du hast Freude an Recherchetätigkeiten und arbeitest Dich gerne in komplexe Themen ein • Du verfügst über ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten • Du arbeitest sorgfältig, strukturiert und zuverlässig • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere Excel • Du interessierst Dich für zoll-, steuer- und außenwirtschaftliche Fragestellungen Wir bieten: Kantine mit gesunden Mahlzeiten Geniessen Sie gesunde Mahlzeiten in unserer Kantine zu fairen Preisen. Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Familiäre Unternehmenskultur Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Mitarbeitendenvorteile und Rabatte Geniessen Sie eine Vielzahl von Mitarbeitendenvorteilen und Ermässigungen, die Ihren Alltag erleichtern. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und erfahren Sie mehr. Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit bester technischer Ausstattung Arbeiten Sie an einem modernen Arbeitsplatz, der mit den neuesten technischen Hilfsmitteln ausgestattet ist, um Ihre Produktivität und Innovation zu fördern. jobs.description:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Werkstudenten (m/w/d) mit technischem oder naturwissenschaftlichem Hintergrund. Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) unterstützt du unser R&D-Team aktiv in laufenden Entwicklungsprojekten und sammelst praktische Erfahrung in einem technologisch anspruchsvollen Umfeld.

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.

B. durch optische und materialanalytische Messungen Anforderungen: • Du bist immatrikulierter Student (m/w/d) im Bereich Physik, Materialwissenschaften, Chemie, Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik, Elektrotechnik oder in einem verwandten technischen bzw. naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang • Idealerweise bringst du erste Erfahrungen oder großes Interesse an Vakuumtechnik, Dünnschichttechnologie oder Beschichtungsverfahren mit • Du hast Freude an experimenteller Laborarbeit und technischer Problemlösung • Du bist eine aufgeschlossene, kommunikative Persönlichkeit mit Hands-on-Mentalität und packst gerne aktiv mit an • Du fühlst dich in einem internationalen, multikulturellen Team wohl, in dem Englisch die tägliche Arbeitssprache ist • Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und strukturiert Wir bieten: Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit bester technischer Ausstattung Arbeiten Sie an einem modernen Arbeitsplatz, der mit den neuesten technischen Hilfsmitteln ausgestattet ist, um Ihre Produktivität und Innovation zu fördern. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren bieten wir unseren Kunden ein breites Angebot an Anlagen für die Beschichtung von Architekturglas, Brillengläsern, optischen Komponenten in Smartphones, Autos, Medizintechnik und vielem mehr. jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Aufgaben:
• Prepare the control philosophy document and obtain line manager approval prior to initiating software design.

• Create the software design and secure line manager approval before commencing PLC and Plant Control System (PCS) engineering.

• Prepare the required PLC and PCS development tools and document, such as templates and simulators.

• Develop and simulate PLC and PCS software in alignment with project scope and customer requirements. Obtain line manager approval prior to the Customer Acceptance Test (CAT).

• Lead the CAT prior to commissioning. Present the software to the customer, ensure alignment between Bühler and the customer on the scope of work. Document and resolve all open points. Follow up with the customer as needed.

• Commission the PLC and PCS software in accordance with the scope of work and agreements reached during CAT. Submit commissioning reports to project team in timely manner and according to Bühler template.

• Conduct on-site training to the customer's team on Bühler PCS operations.

• Participate in project meetings to align with the project team and the customer from project initiation through completion.

• Store and backup all documentation and software properly.

• Securely store sensitive information, including customer passwords and internal documents in compliance with Bühler standards.

• Complete all deliverables (concept, engineering, commissioning) on time and within the approved project budget and timeline.

• Provide remote support for automation-related issues after commissioning, as required.

• Gather feedback and lesson learned during project execution and share with colleagues to drive continuous improvement

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or Industrial Engineering or any related Engineering degree

• At least 3 years of experience in automation design, implementation, or commissioning

• Hands-on experience with Siemens, Allen-Bradley or similar tools

• Experience in industrial automation

• Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues

• Understanding of manufacturing principles

• Proficiency in English language

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: Electro Mechanical Technician
jobs.description:
Maintain, troubleshoot, repair, and keep records on production equipment, vehicles, HVAC, building and grounds and security system. See day to day functionality of manufacturing equipment and make/oversee repairs as needed.

Aufgaben:
• Performs trouble-shooting and diagnostic tests on all types of production equipment Investigates and executes economic repair options on production equipment

• Executes preventative maintenance program

• Maintains inventory of maintenance spare parts

• Assists in the installation of new equipment, and relocation of existing equipment Performs maintenance on buildings, grounds and facility infrastructure

• Coordinates with outside resources for delivery of repair goods and services

• Maintains the highest quality of workmanship

• Requires minimal supervision

• Accepts/performs other responsibilities/duties as assigned by immediate supervisor

• Complete tasks and operate equipment in a safe manner

• Work at an acceptable and communicated level of productivity

Anforderungen:
Job Specifications:
 (Desired education and experience)

• Vocational training in blue print reading, basic machining and basic quality control

• Strong electrical / mechanical troubleshooting skills

• Minimum five years in the industrial maintenance field

• Minimum two years vocational training

• Must have a current North Carolina driver's license

• Basic computer skills and knowledge of Word and Excel software

• Must be able to wear safety equipment(hard hat, safety shoes, safety glasses)

• Ability to work overtime when needed

TECHNICAL SKILLS

• Electrical

• Plumbing

• Hydraulics

• Carpentry

• Machine Shop

• Welding

• Troubleshooting electronic machine controls.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
 Mechanical -- Knowledge of machines and tools, including their designs, uses, repair, and maintenance. Knowledge of electrical, hydraulics, control systems and HVAC systems.
 Design -- Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principles involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models.
 Building and Construction -- Knowledge of materials, methods, and the tools involved in basic carpentry and construction.
 Engineering and Technology -- Knowledge of the practical application of engineering science and technology. This includes applying principles, techniques, procedures, and equipment to the design and production of various goods and services.
 Production and Processing -- Knowledge of raw materials, production processes, quality control , costs, and other techniques for maximizing the effective manufacture and distribution of goods.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

Maintain, troubleshoot, repair, and keep records on production equipment, vehicles, HVAC, building and grounds and security system. See day to day functionality of manufacturing equipment and make/oversee repairs as needed.

Aufgaben:
• Performs trouble-shooting and diagnostic tests on all types of production equipment Investigates and executes economic repair options on production equipment

• Executes preventative maintenance program

• Maintains inventory of maintenance spare parts

• Assists in the installation of new equipment, and relocation of existing equipment Performs maintenance on buildings, grounds and facility infrastructure

• Coordinates with outside resources for delivery of repair goods and services

• Maintains the highest quality of workmanship

• Requires minimal supervision

• Accepts/performs other responsibilities/duties as assigned by immediate supervisor

• Complete tasks and operate equipment in a safe manner

• Work at an acceptable and communicated level of productivity

Anforderungen:
Job Specifications:
(Desired education and experience)

• Vocational training in blue print reading, basic machining and basic quality control

• Strong electrical / mechanical troubleshooting skills

• Minimum five years in the industrial maintenance field

• Minimum two years vocational training

• Must have a current North Carolina driver's license

• Basic computer skills and knowledge of Word and Excel software

• Must be able to wear safety equipment(hard hat, safety shoes, safety glasses)

• Ability to work overtime when needed

TECHNICAL SKILLS

• Electrical

• Plumbing

• Hydraulics

• Carpentry

• Machine Shop

• Welding

• Troubleshooting electronic machine controls.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
Mechanical -- Knowledge of machines and tools, including their designs, uses, repair, and maintenance. Knowledge of electrical, hydraulics, control systems and HVAC systems.
Design -- Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principles involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models.
Building and Construction -- Knowledge of materials, methods, and the tools involved in basic carpentry and construction.
Engineering and Technology -- Knowledge of the practical application of engineering science and technology. This includes applying principles, techniques, procedures, and equipment to the design and production of various goods and services.
Production and Processing -- Knowledge of raw materials, production processes, quality control , costs, and other techniques for maximizing the effective manufacture and distribution of goods.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Are you ready to lead exciting international projects in the processing industry?
At Bühler, we are looking for a motivated Project Manager to join our growing international team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to bring in your creativity, exchange knowledge with colleagues across the globe, and contribute to innovative solutions that shape the future of food production. Aufgaben: • Project management of customer projects within industrial Biscuit and Cracker baking production lines • Responsible for financial result, delivery on time and quality of own projects from handover from Sales until handover to the customers after installation, commissioning and SAT. • Ensuring FAT in our workshops prior to shipment • Execute projects in close collaboration with our sales, engineering and service department Anforderungen: We are looking for a person with a strong drive, who can work with people at different levels in the organization. • Experience with project execution within automated process industry, preferable in the food sector. • Structured personality, with a good sense of time-management. • A good communicator in English (fluent in writing and verbally) and ideally in German too. International Head of Human Resources (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
In dieser Position übernehmen Sie die HR-Gesamtverantwortung für Bühler Standorte in Österreich, Deutschland, Dänemark und den Niederlanden.

Lassen Sie uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Strategischer Sparringspartner für die Geschäftsführung und Führungskräfte national und international (AT, DE, NL, DK) in allen relevanten HR-Themen. • Weiterentwicklung und Umsetzung einer nachhaltigen HR Strategie im Einklang mit den Unternehmenszielen und in Abstimmung mit dem globalen Headquarter. • Führung, Entwicklung und operative Unterstützung der HR Teams. • Steuerung und Optimierung der Aktivitäten im Talent-, Performance & Compensation Management. • Begleitung und Coaching von Führungskräften und Mitarbeitenden bei Veränderungsprozessen und Moderation interner Workshops. • Sicherstellung arbeitsrechtlicher Compliance und Ansprechpartner für die Betriebsräte. • Weiterentwicklung einer nachhaltigen, modernen Employer Branding und Recruiting Strategie. Anforderungen: • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als „Head of HR“ oder in vergleichbarer Führungsposition mit Erfahrung/Verständnis für Konzernstrukturen. • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung (Universität oder FH) vorzugsweise mit Schwerpunkt Human Resources. • Erfahrung in der Steuerung und Begleitung von Change Prozessen und HR-Projekten. • Sehr gute Kenntnisse im österreichischen Arbeits- und Sozialrecht. • Strukturierte, entscheidungs- und umsetzungsstarke Arbeitsweise, gepaart mit einem professionellen, gewinnenden Auftreten. • Kommunikations-, Moderations- und Beratungsfreude auf Augenhöhe in deutscher und englischer Sprache. • Optimistische Haltung, strategisches Denken, pragmatisches Mindset Wir bieten: Berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung Wir bieten ein breites Spektrum an Lernmöglichkeiten, wie Videos, Online-Schulungen, Präsenzschulungen und Webinare mit kurzen, relevanten, ansprechenden, personalisierten und mobilen Formaten. Öffentliche und private Anbindung Unser Standort bietet eine hervorragende Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel und bequeme Parkplätze, die Ihnen das tägliche Pendeln erleichtern. Kantine mit gesunden Mahlzeiten Geniessen Sie gesunde Mahlzeiten in unserer Kantine zu fairen Preisen. Vepflegungszuschuss und kostenloses Salatbuffet Geniessen Sie einen Verpflegungszuschuss sowie ein kostenloses Salatbuffet. Grossartiges und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld Arbeiten Sie in einem grossartigen und dynamischen Umfeld, das Wachstum und Innovation fördert. Familiäre Unternehmenskultur Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg.
