jobs.title: Entwicklungsingenieur / Mechatronikingenieur (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien, Präzision und nachhaltiges Wachstum. Als Teil der international erfolgreichen Bühler Group mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit gehören wir zu den Marktführern im Bereich Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen.

Unser Competence Center Leipzig ist spezialisiert auf hochpräzise Oberflächenpolierung mittels Ionenstrahl- und Plasmabearbeitungsverfahren im Subnanometerbereich. Zudem entwickeln wir optische Messsysteme und setzen anspruchsvolle Automations- und Roboterlösungen um.

Als Entwicklungsingenieur (m/w/d) werden Sie Teil eines interdisziplinären Teams, das technische Herausforderungen mit Kreativität und Innovationsfreude löst. Sie arbeiten an Schlüsselkomponenten für High-End-Anlagen und begleiten Entwicklungen von der Idee bis zur Serienreife.

Wenn Sie Freude daran haben, komplexe technische Lösungen zu entwickeln und in einem dynamischen Umfeld mitzugestalten, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen.

Lassen Sie uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: In dieser vielseitigen Position übernehmen Sie Verantwortung für die Entwicklung anspruchsvoller technischer Lösungen und arbeiten eng mit internen sowie externen Partnern zusammen. Ihre Aufgaben umfassen insbesondere: • Entwicklung von Konzepten und technischen Lösungen für die Neu- und Weiterentwicklung von Schlüsselkomponenten unserer High-End-Anlagen • Begleitung der Umsetzung von Entwicklungsprojekten bis hin zu serienreifen Produkten • Erstellung und Pflege technischer Dokumentationen, unter anderem in den Bereichen Mechanikkonstruktion, Schaltplanauslegung und Leiterplattenrouting • Planung, Durchführung und Auswertung von Laborversuchen zur Verifizierung neuer Entwicklungen • Enge Zusammenarbeit und technische Abstimmung mit internen Fachbereichen sowie externen Kunden • Unterstützung bei Montage, Integration und Inbetriebnahme hochpräziser Messsysteme • Auswahl geeigneter Komponenten sowie Kommunikation und Abstimmung mit Lieferanten • Aktive Mitarbeit in einem cross-funktionalen Team mit viel Raum für eigene Ideen und technische Gestaltung Anforderungen: Für diese Position suchen wir eine technisch begeisterte Persönlichkeit, die gerne lösungsorientiert arbeitet und Freude an anspruchsvollen Entwicklungsaufgaben hat. Sie bringen mit: • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Mechatronik, Laser- und Optotechnik, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation • Sicherer Umgang mit technischen Datenblättern, Spezifikationen und Dokumentationen • Erste Kenntnisse in der Elektronikentwicklung, beispielsweise mit Autodesk Eagle, sowie in der mechanischen Konstruktion, beispielsweise mit Solid Edge • Programmierkenntnisse in C++ oder Python sind von Vorteil • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift • Strukturierte, verantwortungsbewusste und selbstständige Arbeitsweise • Teamgeist, Kommunikationsstärke und Freude daran, gemeinsam innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln Wir bieten: Öffentliche und private Anbindung Unser Standort bietet eine hervorragende Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel und bequeme Parkplätze, die Ihnen das tägliche Pendeln erleichtern. Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Familiäre Unternehmenskultur Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Mitarbeitendenvorteile und Rabatte Geniessen Sie eine Vielzahl von Mitarbeitendenvorteilen und Ermässigungen, die Ihren Alltag erleichtern. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und erfahren Sie mehr. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung Wir bieten ein breites Spektrum an Lernmöglichkeiten, wie Videos, Online-Schulungen, Präsenzschulungen und Webinare mit kurzen, relevanten, ansprechenden, personalisierten und mobilen Formaten. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen.

jobs.title: Spare and Wear Parts Officer
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about delivering excellent customer service and keeping processes running smoothly? As a Spare Parts Specialist, you will be the key link between our customers and internal teams, including Technical Advisors and Product Master Data Specialists.
In this role, you will coordinate all activities related to spare parts quotation and order processes. Your goal will be to provide customers with accurate, high-quality quotations as quickly as possible, ensuring a seamless and efficient experience from request to order. Aufgaben: • Receive and review customer requests: Accept and evaluate customer inquiries for service-related offerings (e.g. spare parts). Ensure requests are complete and determine appropriate next steps. • Initiate and prepare quotations in ERP (e.g., SAP): Create and process quotations for various customer requirements within the relevant system, ensuring accurate entry of all relevant information. • Communicate effectively with customers: Manage communications with customers regarding their requests and quotations, answering questions, clarifying details, and managing expectations throughout the process. • Complete technical and commercial details: gather, verify, and input all necessary technical specifications and commercial terms to ensure comprehensive and precise quotations. • Ensure efficient information flow: Collect and provide all necessary information and supporting documentation to streamline processing by internal specialists and stakeholders. Anforderungen: • Diploma from upper secondary school in an electrical or mechanical field or equivalent education through other educational paths • Experience with SAP or similar ERP systems • Highly structured, detail-oriented, and conscientious way of working, ability to use time and resources efficiently • Fluent in the local language and English Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: SAP Processes & Applications Specialist
jobs.description:
Aufgaben:
• Support the regional Center of Processes and Applications (COPA) with a team of IT experts across Finance/Controlling (FI/CO), Customer Service (CS), Customer Projects (CP), and Supply Chain Logistics (SCL).

• Serve as the lead for the Customer Service (CS) stream.

• Assist in developing and implementing the COPA strategy for Southeast Asia and Oceania

• Support the alignment and enablement of global initiatives in consideration of regional requirements

• Facilitate the rollout of global solutions across the region, including the Small Entity Template (SET)

• Support regional ITP projects and initiatives.

• Contribute to talent development and capability building across the region.

• Ensure regional processes and tools are aligned with and enabled by global templates.

• Facilitate the localization of IT applications to meet regional requirements.

• Support the optimization and streamlining of the Small Entity Template (SET) rollout.

• Collaborate with central IT and business teams to ensure aligned and cohesive strategies.

• Coordinate with regional business stakeholders to understand and address the user needs.

• Facilitate knowledge sharing and the adoption of best practices across the region.

• Organize regional superuser alignment for the Customer Service (CS) stream.

• Support the oversight of regional IT projects from initiation through completion.

• Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.

• Assist in managing project risks and issues, ensuring appropriate mitigation strategies are in place.

• Support the Team Manager, COPA SEA, in developing the team's knowledge base and strengthening overall capabilities.

• Ensure high-quality responses to regional users and their inquiries beyond individual stream responsibilities.

• Promote a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

• Assist in developing key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure performance and success.

• Monitor and report on the performance of regional IT applications and processes.

• Ensure compliance with regional and global IT policies, standards, and governance requirements.

Anforderungen:
• Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration or a related field

• Language skills: fluent in English and one additional Asian language.

• Solid experience in IT Project Management, Process Management, Application Management or IT Management for at least 5-7 years.

• Experience working in multinational companies.

• Proven experience in supporting and implementing SAP solutions.

• Strong background in business process optimization and application management.

jobs.title: Automation Quotation Engineer
jobs.description:
Responsible for producing quotation documents with internal tools, consisting of pricing, concept drawing, presentation material, and other supporting sales process. Provide technical leadership and direction for projects in the quotation phase. In charge to deliver the required quotation services within the given time and required quality, while ensuring compliance with Bühler related directives and EHS standards.

Aufgaben:
• Responsible for preparing automation quotations using Bühler internal tools, standards and quotation processes.

• Clarifies automation requirements with internal project sales teams and, where required, directly with customers.

• Performs technical and commercial analysis of customer requirements in close alignment with the Sales Manager.

• Develops project-specific plant automation concepts based on customer requirements, project scope, technical feasibility and Bühler solution standards.

• Collaborates with Sales, Technology, Engineering, Commercial Services, Mechanical Engineers and Automation Specialists to develop competitive and high-quality quotations.

• Ensures technical and commercial ownership of assigned quotations, including scope, assumptions, risks, exclusions and deliverables.

• Provides timely responses to internal technical questions and supports clarification of technical issues during the quotation phase.

• Proactively follows up on submitted quotation documents with internal stakeholders or customers to support the sales process.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Industrial Engineering or any related Engineering degree

• Minimum of 2–3 years of experience in an engineering role, preferably in quotation, project, or technical sales engineering

• Experience in Industrial Automation

• Demonstrated ability to manage technical and commercial aspects of quotations

• Experience in layout preparation, technical concept development, and customer-facing discussions

• Proficiency in the English language

We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.description:
Wir freuen uns auf ein engagiertes Teammitglied (m/w/d), welches unser Service-Team im Kundendienst tatkräftig durch Eigeninitiative, Flexibilität und Kundenorientierung unterstützt. In Ihrer Rolle als Technical Engineer "Remote Support & Customer Consultation" (m/w/d) überzeugen Sie durch Einsatzbereitschaft und Kommunikationsstärke und scheuen sich nicht vor neuen Herausforderungen. Ergreifen Sie Ihre Chance und werden Sie Teil der Bühler-Welt!

Lassen Sie uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Sie übernehmen technische Betreuung bzw. -unterstützung unseres weltweiten Kundenstamms mittels „remote support“ (telefonisch als durch Fernwartungs-Software) • Sie analysieren und beheben Fehler/ Probleme mit den entsprechenden Fachabteilungen • Sie schulen Mitarbeiter der Kunden vor Ort, als auch im Werk in Alzenau • Sie arbeiten mit an der Aktualisierung der Maschinensoftware • Sie führen im Bedarfsfall auch Servicearbeiten wie Reparaturen, Umbauten, Inspektionen, Instandsetzungen und Wartungen von Einzelmaschinen und Anlagen im In- und Ausland durch Anforderungen: • Sie haben eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Mechatroniker (m/w/d), Industriemechaniker (m/w/d), Elektriker (m/w/d) oder vergleichbar, gerne mit Weiterbildung zum Meister/ Techniker (m/w/d) oder ein Studium im Bereich Elektrotechnik • Sie verfügen über Berufserfahrung im Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, idealerweise im Bereich Vakuumbeschichtung • Kenntnisse in der SPS-Programmierung (Beckhoff: TwinCAT 2 & 3) sind von Vorteil • Sie kommunizieren sehr sicher in Englisch und verfügen über gute Deutschkenntnisse • Eine selbstständige und kundenorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie eine Reisebereitschaft (In- und Ausland) runden Ihr Profil ab Wir bieten: Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit bester technischer Ausstattung Arbeiten Sie an einem modernen Arbeitsplatz, der mit den neuesten technischen Hilfsmitteln ausgestattet ist, um Ihre Produktivität und Innovation zu fördern. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung Wir bieten ein breites Spektrum an Lernmöglichkeiten, wie Videos, Online-Schulungen, Präsenzschulungen und Webinare mit kurzen, relevanten, ansprechenden, personalisierten und mobilen Formaten. Mitarbeitendenvorteile und Rabatte Geniessen Sie eine Vielzahl von Mitarbeitendenvorteilen und Ermässigungen, die Ihren Alltag erleichtern. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und erfahren Sie mehr. Kantine mit gesunden Mahlzeiten Geniessen Sie gesunde Mahlzeiten in unserer Kantine zu fairen Preisen. Learning Plattform Willkommen in einer Welt von über 16.000 Möglichkeiten, sich weiterzubilden! jobs.title: Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
To strengthen our Legal Services team at our headquarters in Uzwil, we are looking for a motivated and business-minded Legal Counsel who combines strong legal expertise with a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach. In this role, you will work closely with colleagues across our global organization, advising on a wide range of legal matters and supporting the business in achieving its goals in a compliant and commercially sound way.

Aufgaben:
• You advise internal stakeholders on a broad range of legal matters, with a focus on commercial contracts, IT law, and corporate governance

• You draft, review, and negotiate a variety of agreements, including customer, supplier, and IT-related contracts (software, cloud, SaaS)

• You develop and enhance contract templates, policies, and legal standards, while supporting the continuous improvement of legal processes and tools

• You identify legal risks, monitor regulatory developments, and translate them into practical, business-oriented guidance

• You collaborate cross-functionally and support governance matters, ensuring effective communication with stakeholders at all levels

Anforderungen:
• Swiss law degree and admission to the bar in Switzerland, combined with several years of relevant professional experience in a law firm or in-house environment, ideally in an international, industrial or technology-driven setting

• Strong expertise in contract law, IT law, and corporate governance, with proven experience in drafting and negotiating commercial and IT-related agreements

• Independent, structured working style paired with strong teamwork skills, business acumen, and a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, along with a high level of integrity, reliability, and sound judgment

• Fluency in German and English; strong interest in digitalization, legal technology, and continuous improvement, combined with curiosity and a willingness to learn

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement
Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking.

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Health-Port
We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Sports activities
We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

Seit mehr als 150 Jahren bieten wir unseren Kunden ein breites Angebot an Anlagen für die Beschichtung von Brillengläsern, optischen Komponenten in Smartphones, Autos, Medizintechnik Kameras, Head Up Displays von Autos und vielem mehr. La tecnologia ti eccita e hai una buona immaginazione spaziale? Allora l'apprendistato come costruttore: in EFZ a Bühler è esattamente la cosa giusta per voi! Applicare ora con i documenti di applicazione completi (lettera di motivazione, CV, certificati) e iniziare il tuo futuro con noi! Compiti: • Crea disegni tecnici sia a mano che con moderni strumenti CAD • Sviluppi liste di parti e definisci requisiti tecnici • Progettare, ottimizzare e sviluppare prodotti e componenti • Sviluppi idee utilizzando metodi creativi e li traduci in concetti • Pianifica e accompagna progetti, crea documentazione e presenta i tuoi risultati in modo convincente Requisiti • Interessi nei processi meccanici • L'immaginazione spaziale • Metodi di lavoro precisi e attenti • Pazienza, resistenza e concentrazione • Lavoro di squadra e affidabilità Offriamo: Attraente diritto di vacanza Tempo sufficiente per la ricreazione e gli interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanze all'anno a seconda dell'anno di vita. Concetto di mobilità attraente Offriamo un OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax per 365 CHF + 400CHF credito di trasporto pubblico e un attraente abbonamento di prima classe o parcheggio gratuito. Ristorante personale VIVA Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9.00 CHF. Abbonamenti mobili Offriamo condizioni speciali per gli abbonamenti mobili tramite Mobilezone a Sunrise e Swisscom. Porta salute Siamo impegnati nella prevenzione della salute attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale. Attività sportive Promuoviamo lo sport attraverso la formazione di circuiti auto-organizzati e gruppi in esecuzione, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e il fitness attivo. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Start now. Design tomorrow. BFuture.


Technology excites you, and you have a good spatial imagination? Then the apprenticeship as a constructor: in EFZ at Bühler is exactly the right thing for you!


Apply now with your complete application documents (motivation letter, CV, certificates) and start your future with us! Tasks: • You create technical drawings both by hand and with modern CAD tools • You develop parts lists and define technical requirements • You design, optimize and develop products and components further • You develop ideas using creative methods and translate them into concepts • You plan and accompany projects, create documentation and present your results convincingly Requirements • Interest in mechanical processes • Spatial imagination • Precise and careful working methods • Patience, endurance and concentration • Teamwork and reliability We offer: Attractive holiday entitlement Sufficient time for recreation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of holidays per year depending on the year of life. Attractive mobility concept We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax for 365 CHF + 400CHF public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class subscription or free parking. Staff restaurant VIVA We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9.00 CHF. Mobile subscriptions We offer special conditions for mobile subscriptions via Mobilezone at Sunrise and Swisscom. Health port We are committed to health prevention through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor. Sports activities We promote sport through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for update and active fitness. Two billion people eat food produced at Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies. With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Starte jetzt. Gestalte morgen. BFuture.


Technik begeistert dich, und du hast ein gutes räumliches Vorstellungsvermögen? Dann ist die Lehrstelle als Konstrukteur:in EFZ bei Bühler genau das Richtige für dich!


Bewerbe dich jetzt mit deinen vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse) und starte deine Zukunft mit uns! Aufgaben: • Du erstellst technische Zeichnungen sowohl von Hand als auch mit modernen CAD-Tools • Du erarbeitest Stücklisten und definierst technische Anforderungen • Du gestaltest, optimierst und entwickelst Produkte und Bauteile weiter • Du entwickelst Ideen mit kreativen Methoden und setzt diese in Konzepte um • Du planst und begleitest Projekte, erstellst Dokumentationen und präsentierst deine Ergebnisse überzeugend Anforderungen: • Interesse an mechanischen Prozessen • Räumliches Vorstellungsvermögen • Exakte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise • Geduld, Ausdauer und Konzentrationsvermögen • Teamfähigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit Wir bieten: Attraktiver Ferienanspruch Ausreichend Zeit für Erholung und persönliche Interessen - wir bieten von 25 bis zu 30 Tage Ferien pro Jahr abhängig vom Lebensjahr. Attraktives Mobilitätskonzept Wir bieten ein OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Halbtax für 365 CHF + 400CHF ÖV-Guthaben sowie ein attraktives Erstklass-Abonnement oder kostenlose Parkplätze. Personalrestaurant VIVA Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitenden ein tägliches Fitnessmenü ab 9, 00 CHF. Handy-Abonnements Wir bieten Spezialkonditionen bei Handyabonnements über Mobilezone bei Sunrise und Swisscom. Health-Port Wir setzen uns für Gesundheitsprävention durch Laboranalysen, Massagen, Ernährungsberatung, Physiotherapie, Gruppenkurse sowie einen Betriebsarzt ein. Sportangebote Wir fördern die sportliche Betätigung durch eigenorganisiertes Zirkeltraining und Laufgruppen sowie durch Gutscheine für Update und Activ Fitness. Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden. Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen. Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen.

jobs.title: Project Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Buhler Group in Izmir, Türkiye, is looking for a skilled and proactive professional to join our Service Operations Team as a Project Operations Lead. The role will be responsible to coordinate and monitor active Service and Plant Projects, ensuring alignment across engineering, customers, local teams along with driving milestone execution, issue resolution, and successful installation and commissioning activities. The role requires a strong commitment to quality, on-time delivery, customer satisfaction, and compliance with Bühler directives and Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) standards.

Aufgaben:
• Coordinate and monitor all active Service and Plant Projects within the local organization.

• Act as the primary interface between customers, Service Project Engineers, local teams, and global Bühler project organizations.

• Guide Service Project Engineers and support engineering alignment during project planning and execution.

• Track project milestones, risks, deviations, and execution progress, ensuring timely escalation and resolution of critical issues.

• Support global Project Managers by coordinating local resources, site readiness, stakeholder communication, installation, and commissioning activities.

• Facilitate collaboration between customer sites, engineering functions, service teams, and global stakeholders.

• Ensure compliance with Bühler directives, processes, and EHS standards.

• Maintain project reporting, documentation, and continuous improvement activities, including lessons learned and service solution planning.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or a related field.

• Minimum 7 years of experience in project coordination, service operations, or industrial engineering environments.

• Experience leading or coordinating cross-functional teams.

• Strong technical understanding across engineering and process disciplines, with the ability to translate complexity into effective execution and coordination.

• Fluent in English and Turkish (written and spoken).

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Willingness to travel and work flexible hours when required.

• Residing in the Izmir or Manisa region.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.en:
As a Quotation Specialist you will be responsible for preparing and managing quotations for Service Projects (single machines/retrofits/automation upgrades etc.) and Service Agreements.
This role requires close collaboration with the Sales and internal (Operations) teams to ensure all quotations are accurate, competitive, and aligned with the company's pricing strategy, focusing on defining the scope, cost, and commercial terms. Aufgaben: • Technical and commercial responsibility for Service Projects and Service Agreements quotations • Elaborate on the technical and commercial analysis of customer requirements and project opportunities in alignment with the sales manager • Develop the concept in collaboration with sales, technology, engineering, and commercial services • Leads quotation development (including cost, scope, risks and commercial terms), and actively supports negotiation of related complex services agreements in order to maximize profitability while maintaining customer satisfaction • Collaborate with experts from relevant departments to gather the necessary information for creating accurate and compliant quotations, i.e., technical experts, tax, legal, commercial, finance, etc. Anforderungen: • University degree in business administration or engineering, or equivalent education through other educational paths • Minimum 3 years of experience as Quotation Engineer/Quotation Specialist or proof of sufficient skills • Sufficient technical knowledge (depending on market) to understand client processes, not only machines but overall transformation and operation processes to identify customer needs • Sound understanding of pricing strategies, financial analysis, contract negotiation, and project management principles • Enter relevant qualifications with bullet points Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

B. technische Experten, Steuer-, Rechts-, Handels-, Finanz- usw. jobs.description:
Am Standort Beilngries widmen sich rund 360 Mitarbeitende im Geschäftsbereich Grain Quality and Supply (GQ) dem Anlagen- und Maschinenbau rund um die Themen Getreideverarbeitung sowie Mälzen & Brauen.
Dies umfasst die Reinigung, Trocknung, den Transport (inkl. Fördertechnik und Schiffsbeladung), die Lagerung und Digitalisierung, um Getreide vom Feld bis zum Verbraucher zu verarbeiten. Immer mit dem Fokus auf Effizienz, Produktqualität und Nachhaltigkeit.

Als Montageleiter (m/w/d) bist Du der zentrale Ansprechpartner auf unseren Baustellen weltweit und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Projekte im Anlagen- und Maschinenbau reibungslos, termingerecht und in hoher Qualität umgesetzt werden.
Du koordinierst Teams, planst Abläufe und trägst aktiv dazu bei, dass unsere Kunden auf unsere Kompetenz und Zuverlässigkeit bauen können.

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.

Baustellendokumentation Anforderungen: • Abgeschlossene gewerbliche oder technische Ausbildung (Konstruktions-, Anlagenmechanik, Metallbau oder ähnliches) • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Montage auf Baustellen, vorzugsweise im Anlagenbau • Entscheidungsfreudige und lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit • Organisationstalent, ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und erkennbares Führungspotenzial • Flexibilität und hohe Mobilität bezüglich Einsatzbereitschaft und -ort (Reisebereitschaft weltweit ca. 90%) • Sichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift • Führerschein Klasse B erforderlich Wir bieten: Familiäre Unternehmenskultur Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Nel sito Beilngries, circa 360 dipendenti della divisione Grain Quality and Supply (GQ) sono dedicati all'ingegneria meccanica e vegetale nei settori della lavorazione del grano e della produzione di malto e malto. > Ciò include la pulizia, l'essiccazione, il trasporto (comprese le attrezzature di trasporto e il carico delle navi), lo stoccaggio e la digitalizzazione per elaborare il grano dal campo al consumatore. Sempre al centro dell'efficienza, della qualità del prodotto e della sostenibilità. > > Come direttore d'assemblaggio (m/f/d) Lei è il punto centrale di contatto sui nostri cantieri in tutto il mondo e assicura che i nostri progetti in ingegneria vegetale e meccanica siano implementati senza intoppi, nel tempo e in alta qualità. > Coordinate team, pianificate processi e aiutate attivamente i nostri clienti a sviluppare le nostre competenze e affidabilità. > > Facciamo la differenza a Bühler insieme! • Coordinamento del progetto: interfaccia tra project management, cliente e subappaltatore
• Processo di costruzione: pianificazione e monitoraggio del montaggio e della messa in servizio in termini di qualità, tempo e uso del materiale

• Diversi anni di esperienza professionale in assemblaggio su cantieri, preferibilmente in costruzione di impianti
• Personalità decisionale e orientata alla soluzione
• Talenti organizzativi, forte orientamento del cliente e potenziale di leadership riconoscibile
• Flessibilità e elevata mobilità in termini di disponibilità operativa e posizione (prontezza del viaggio intorno al 90% in tutto il mondo)
• Conoscenza sicura dell'inglese in parola e scrittura
• Titolo di guida della categoria B richiesto Offriamo: Cultura aziendale familiare Abbiamo più di 160 anni di storia. Questo ci rende una società che pensa e investe a lungo termine - in innovazione, i nostri dipendenti e il successo economico. Ambiente di lavoro interculturale La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da più di 100 nazioni e la nostra cultura inclusiva. Previdenza sociale Approfittate delle nostre pensioni aziendali o dei servizi che generano attività – per un futuro sicuro! Eventi e eventi di squadra Il vostro impegno ci rende possibile. Vogliamo festeggiare insieme a te. Le nostre feste di Natale, feste estive, eventi sportivi e eventi di squadra offrono le migliori opportunità per farlo. Cultura della comunicazione aperta Approfittate di una cultura di comunicazione aperta che promuove la trasparenza e lo scambio! Sviluppo professionale e personale Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di apprendimento, come video, formazione online, formazione faccia a faccia e webinar con formati brevi, rilevanti, coinvolgenti, personalizzati e mobili. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At the Beilngries site, around 360 employees in the Grain Quality and Supply (GQ) division are dedicated to plant and mechanical engineering in the areas of grain processing and malt & brewing.
This includes cleaning, drying, transport (including conveying equipment and ship loading), storage and digitization to process grain from the field to the consumer. Always with the focus on efficiency, product quality and sustainability.

As assembly conductor (m/f/d) You are the central point of contact on our construction sites worldwide and ensure that our projects in plant and mechanical engineering are implemented smoothly, on time and in high quality.
You coordinate teams, plan processes and actively help our customers to build on our expertise and reliability.

Let's make a difference at Bühler together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • Assembly and commissioning: Independent organization and implementation of assembly and commissioning on construction sites worldwide • Project coordination: interface between project management, customer and subcontractor • Construction process: planning and monitoring of assembly and commissioning in terms of quality, time and material use • Resource planning: operational planning for own and external personnel and machines • Quality and Safety Management: Enforcement of Occupational Safety Policies and Reduction of Construction Progress • Documentation: Conduct of meetings, partial acceptances and customer visits incl. Construction site documentation Requirements • Completed commercial or technical training (construction, plant mechanics, metal construction or similar) • Several years of professional experience in assembly on construction sites, preferably in plant construction • Decision-making and solution-oriented personality • Organizational talent, strong customer orientation and recognizable leadership potential • Flexibility and high mobility in terms of operational readiness and location (travel readiness around 90% worldwide) • Safe knowledge of English in word and writing • Category B driving licence required We offer: Family business culture We have more than 160 years of history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term - in innovation, our employees and economic success. Intercultural working environment Key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture. Occupational pension schemes or asset-generating benefits Benefit from our company pensions or asset-generating services – for a secure future! Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities to do so. Open communication culture Benefit from an open communication culture that promotes transparency and exchange! Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, face-to-face training and webinars with short, relevant, engaging, personalised and mobile formats. Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies. With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Bühler Leybold Optics is one of the world's leading companies in the field of high-tech thin-film coating systems. As part of the global Bühler Group with more than 13,000 employees, we develop technologies that are used in smartphones, cars, medical technology and architectural glass all over the world.


Let us at Bühler make a difference together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • Development of customized software solutions: You develop customized software solutions for controlling our plants and machines. • Cover project cycle: You take over the entire cycle of software projects, from conception to implementation. • Planning and implementation: You plan and implement complex measurement and control systems. • Software commissioning: You support the software commissioning both in Alzenau and, if necessary, directly at the customer’s site. • Cross-departmental cooperation: You work closely with other departments and contribute to the further development of our processes. Requirements • Successfully completed studies: You have successfully completed studies in electrical engineering, communications technology, automation technology, technical computer science or a comparable field. • Professional experience in automation: You can show initial professional experience in the field of automation of machinery and equipment. • Experience with C# and WPF: You have profound knowledge in dealing with C# and WPF. • Technical background and PLC experience: Ideally, you have a technical background and experience with PLC connections, especially Beckhoff and Siemens. • Language skills: Very good German and good English skills in word and writing round off your profile. We offer: Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, face-to-face training and webinars with short, relevant, engaging, personalised and mobile formats. Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices. Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities to do so. Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to boost your productivity and innovation. Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and find out more. Intercultural working environment Key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture. Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. Tâches : • Développement de solutions logicielles personnalisées : Vous développez des solutions logicielles personnalisées pour contrôler nos installations et machines. • Couverture du cycle du projet: Vous prenez en charge tout le cycle des projets logiciels, de la conception à la mise en œuvre. • Planification et mise en oeuvre: Vous planifiez et mettez en œuvre des systèmes de mesure et de contrôle complexes. • Mise en service du logiciel: Vous supportez le logiciel mis en service à la fois à Alzenau et, si nécessaire, directement sur le site du client. • Coopération interministérielle : Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec d'autres ministères et contribuez au développement de nos processus. Nous offrons: Développement professionnel et personnel Nous offrons un large éventail de possibilités d'apprentissage, telles que des vidéos, des formations en ligne, des formations en face à face et des webinaires avec des formats courts, pertinents, engageants, personnalisés et mobiles. Une cantine avec des repas sains Profitez de repas sains dans notre cantine à des prix équitables. Manifestations et événements en équipe Votre engagement nous rend possibles. Nous voulons célébrer ça avec vous. Nos fêtes de Noël, les fêtes d'été, les événements sportifs et les événements en équipe offrent les meilleures occasions de le faire. Un lieu de travail moderne avec le meilleur équipement technique Travailler dans un lieu de travail moderne équipé des derniers outils techniques pour augmenter votre productivité et votre innovation. Avantages sociaux et rabais Profitez d'une variété d'avantages sociaux et de réductions qui facilitent votre vie quotidienne. Faites partie de notre équipe et en savoir plus. Environnement de travail interculturel La clé de notre succès est notre main-d'oeuvre diversifiée de plus de 100 pays et notre culture inclusive. Deux milliards de personnes mangent chaque jour des aliments produits sur les plantes de Bühler. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler. Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins de l'économie, des personnes et de la nature. De cette façon, nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des débouchés commerciaux durables dans les industries mondiales des aliments pour animaux, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité. Nous voulons innover pour un monde meilleur, avec un accent particulier sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

jobs.title: Monteur / Industriemechaniker (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien und stetiges Wachstum. Als Teil der Bühler Group, einem weltweit agierenden Maschinenbaukonzern mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden, sind wir einer der Marktführer im Bereich Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren bieten wir unseren Kunden ein breites Angebot an Anlagen für die Beschichtung von Architekturglas, Brillengläsern, optischen Komponenten in Smartphones, Autos, Medizintechnik und vielem mehr. Unserem internationalen Team gelingt es tagtäglich neue Maßstäbe zu setzen und komplexe Projekte erfolgreich umzusetzen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir Sie als Monteur (m/w/d). In dieser Rolle montieren Sie Baugruppen mit hoher Präzision und tragen entscheidend dazu bei, innovative Technologien zum Leben zu erwecken. Werden Sie Teil unseres engagierten Teams bei der Bühler Alzenau GmbH in Hasselroth und bringen Sie Ihr handwerkliches Können dort ein, wo Technik Zukunft gestaltet.

Lassen Sie uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Sie montieren mechanische Baugruppen sowie komplette Anlagen nach Zeichnung und Vorgabe. • Sie prüfen Bauteile sorgfältig und dokumentieren Ihre Ergebnisse in Prüfprotokollen. • Sie behalten Termine und Fortschritte Ihrer zugeordneten Baugruppen im Blick. • Sie bearbeiten Reparaturaufträge zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert. • Sie leisten mit Ihrer präzisen Arbeit einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Qualität unserer Hightech-Anlagen. Anforderungen: • Sie haben eine technische Ausbildung erfolgreich abgeschlossen, z. B. als Industriemechaniker, Mechatroniker oder in einem vergleichbaren Beruf. • Idealerweise bringen Sie erste Erfahrung in der Montage von Baugruppen, Komponenten oder Anlagen mit. • Sie arbeiten sorgfältig, genau und qualitätsbewusst. • Sie bringen technisches Verständnis sowie Freude an mechanischer Montage mit. • Sie arbeiten gerne im Team und übernehmen Verantwortung für Ihre Aufgaben. Wir bieten: Öffentliche und private Anbindung Unser Standort bietet eine hervorragende Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel und bequeme Parkplätze, die Ihnen das tägliche Pendeln erleichtern. Familiäre Unternehmenskultur Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Mitarbeitendenvorteile und Rabatte Geniessen Sie eine Vielzahl von Mitarbeitendenvorteilen und Ermässigungen, die Ihren Alltag erleichtern. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und erfahren Sie mehr. Offene Kommunikationskultur Profitieren Sie von einer offenen Kommunikationskultur, die Transparenz und Austausch fördert! jobs.title: Warehouse Worker
jobs.description:
Join our team and take on a hands-on role where you'll keep operations moving smoothly behind the scenes. In this position, you'll work with a supportive team to receive and organize incoming materials, accurately pick and prepare orders, and ensure products are packed and shipped with care. You'll also play an important role in maintaining an organized warehouse, making it easy to track and retrieve inventory. If you enjoy staying active, paying attention to detail, and being part of a team that values your contributions, this is a great opportunity to grow your skills in a team environment.

Aufgaben:
• Pull and prioritize order, restock inventory

• Operate automated storage modules

• Operates powered industrial trucks to load and unload materials from trucks and shelving

• Performing daily equipment check such as recharging forklift batteries and general maintenance

• Assist shipping and receiving unloading trucks and checking in merchandise

• Moving goods packed on pallets or in crates around the storage facility

• May assist in counting of physical inventory

• Prepares orders by processing requests and supply orders: pulling materials and packaging orders securely

• Examining products to verify conformance to quality standards

• Process orders for shipment via UPS, FedEx, or Traffic to determine

• Manages miscellaneous projects and completes various tasks as needed

• Accepts and performs all other duties as assigned by immediate supervisor. To include any and all jobs or tasks that may not be directly related to this job description

• Work shift is from 8:00am to 5pm (M – F)

• Must arrive at work promptly and predictably

Anforderungen:
• Highschool diploma or equivalent

• Experience with UPS & FedEx shipments

• Experience with a forklift is a plus

• Safe working habits

• Good cooperation and communication skills

• Maintenance of a neat and clean work area

• High degree of mechanical aptitude

• Good organizational skills

• Good computer skills, ideally with SAP background

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.

We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

As part of the Bühler Group, a global technology group with over 13,000 employees, we are one of the leading manufacturers of high-tech thin-film vacuum coating systems. Become part of the Bühler world!

Let us make a difference together at Bühler!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.

This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. jobs.title: Process Engineer (Quotation & Project Execution)
jobs.description:
As a Process Engineer (Quotation & Project Execution), you will play a key role in designing and defining process and plant concepts, ensuring technical excellence and high-quality standards throughout the entire project lifecycle. Acting as a vital link between Sales, Quotation, Project Execution, R&D, market segment leaders, international hubs, and customers, you will contribute to the successful delivery of innovative solutions that create lasting value for our customers.

Aufgaben:
• You develop and calculate process solutions during sales and quotation phases ranging from individual machines to complete plant concepts, including process flow diagrams, design bases, technical specifications, and the application of quality principles

• You work on different customer projects during the quotation phase and take an active role during the entire project execution phases, ensuring technical excellence, stakeholder alignment, compliance with deadlines, and cost transparency

• You transform customer requirements into technically sound and value-driven process concepts while providing active expert support to Sales, Quotation, and Project Execution teams

• You take ownership of a dedicated market segment within our Business Area Human Nutrition, managing technical risks, deviations, change requests, and supporting commissioning (mainly back-office), customer trials, and product development activities

• You drive continuous improvement by enhancing workflows, maintaining high-quality documentation and data standards, fostering cross-functional collaboration, and ensuring systematic feedback of product and performance data into internal knowledge bases

Anforderungen:
• Master's degree in Food/Process Technology or Process Engineering, or a comparable qualification with a focus on grain processing (e.g. Swiss Milling School, Swiss Institute of Feed Technology, Deutsche Müller Schule Braunschweig)

• Practical experience in grain processing, including process design, technology, calculations, and/or commissioning activities

• Strong project management, organizational, and problem-solving skills combined with a structured, pragmatic, and results-oriented approach

• Proficiency in MS Office; basic CAD knowledge and additional language skills (e.g., Spanish, French, or Italian) are considered an advantage

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in international and multidisciplinary environments; fluent in German and English

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement
Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking.

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Health-Port
We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Sports activities
We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Come Ingegnere di Processo (Quotation & Project Execution), si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella progettazione e definizione di concetti di processo e di impianto, garantendo l'eccellenza tecnica e standard di alta qualità in tutto il ciclo di vita del progetto. Agendo come un collegamento vitale tra Vendite, Quotazione, Project Execution, R&D, leader di segmenti di mercato, hub internazionali e clienti, contribuirà alla consegna di soluzioni innovative che creano valore duraturo per i nostri clienti. Aufgaben:
• Sviluppi e calcoli delle soluzioni di processo durante le fasi di vendita e quotazione che vanno dalle singole macchine ai concetti di impianto completi, compresi i diagrammi di flusso di processo, le basi di progettazione, le specifiche tecniche e l'applicazione dei principi di qualità
• Lavorate su diversi progetti dei clienti durante la fase di quotazione e assumete un ruolo attivo durante tutte le fasi di esecuzione del progetto, garantendo l'eccellenza tecnica, l'allineamento delle parti interessate, il rispetto delle scadenze e la trasparenza dei costi
• Trasformate i requisiti dei clienti in concetti di processo tecnicamente sani e orientati al valore, fornendo un supporto esperto attivo ai team Sales, Quotation e Project Execution
• Si prende possesso di un segmento di mercato dedicato all'interno della nostra Business Area Human Nutrition, gestione dei rischi tecnici, deviazioni, richieste di cambiamento e supporto alla messa in servizio (principalmente back-office), prove del cliente e attività di sviluppo del prodotto
• Promuovi un miglioramento continuo migliorando i flussi di lavoro, mantenendo standard di documentazione e dati di alta qualità, promuovendo la collaborazione interfunzionale e garantendo un feedback sistematico dei dati di prodotto e di performance nelle basi di conoscenza interne Anforderungen:
• Laurea magistrale in Food/Process Technology o Process Engineering, o una qualifica paragonabile con un focus sulla lavorazione del grano (ad esempio Swiss Milling School, Swiss Institute of Feed Technology, Deutsche Müller Schule Braunschweig)
• Esperienza pratica nella lavorazione del grano, tra cui progettazione di processo, tecnologia, calcoli e/o attività di messa in servizio
• Forte gestione del progetto, capacità organizzative e di problem solving combinate con un approccio strutturato, pragmatico e orientato ai risultati
• La competenza in MS Office; le conoscenze CAD di base e le competenze linguistiche aggiuntive (ad esempio, spagnolo, francese o italiano) sono considerate un vantaggio
• Ottima capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente in ambienti internazionali e multidisciplinari; fluente in tedesco e inglese Wir bieten: Attraente diritto di vacanza Abbastanza tempo per il relax e gli interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanza all'anno a seconda dell'età. Concetto di mobilità attraente Offriamo una OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + mezza carta di viaggio per CHF 365 + CHF 400 credito di trasporto pubblico, nonché una attraente carta di viaggio di prima classe o un parcheggio gratuito. Ristorante VIVA Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9, 00 CHF. Piano pensionistico finanziato dal datore di lavoro Il Bühler Pension Fund offre ai dipendenti Bühler un fondo pensione indipendente che garantisce una sicurezza finanziaria affidabile in pensione: www.pk-buhler.ch Salute-Porto Ci impegniamo per l'assistenza sanitaria preventiva attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consulenza nutrizionale, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale. Attività sportive Promuoviamo l'attività fisica attraverso la formazione di circuiti auto-organizzati e gruppi in esecuzione, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e l'attivazione di fitness. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine. Bühler si propone di bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

Agissant comme un lien vital entre les ventes, la soumission, l'exécution de projets, la R-D, les leaders du segment de marché, les hubs internationaux et les clients, vous contribuerez à la livraison réussie de solutions innovantes qui créent une valeur durable pour nos clients. • Vous conduisez une amélioration continue en améliorant les flux de travail, en maintenant des normes de documentation et de données de haute qualité, en favorisant la collaboration interfonctionnelle et en assurant la rétroaction systématique des données sur les produits et les performances dans les bases de connaissances internes C'est pas vrai.

• Expérience pratique de la transformation du grain, y compris la conception des procédés, la technologie, les calculs et/ou les activités de mise en service
• Des compétences solides en gestion de projet, en organisation et en résolution de problèmes associées à une approche structurée, pragmatique et axée sur les résultats
• Compétence en MS Office; connaissances de base en CAO et compétences linguistiques supplémentaires (p. ex. espagnol, français ou italien) sont considérées comme un avantage
• Excellentes compétences en communication et gestion des parties prenantes avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement dans des environnements internationaux et multidisciplinaires; parlant couramment l'allemand et l'anglais - Oui. jobs.title: Installation Supervisor
jobs.description:
La persona en este puesto gestiona y dirige un equipo de personal de instalación en sitio para proyectos de diversos tamaños, planificando, preparando y ejecutando la instalación eléctrica de hardware y/o software de los proyectos asignados.

Aufgaben:
• Gestiona y lidera un equipo de instalación y/o realiza instalaciones eléctricas de acuerdo con las especificaciones y documentos de ingeniería, con el objetivo de alcanzar y seguir mejorando las metas de costo, cronograma, calidad y OHS/seguridad y salud ocupacional.

• Supervisa el avance de la construcción e inicia medidas preventivas; asegura que el departamento de ingeniería esté informado y gestione los problemas técnicos que puedan surgir.

• Dirige o asiste a reuniones programadas regularmente con los miembros del equipo y proporciona actualizaciones al personal directivo; entrega retroalimentación al departamento de Ejecución de Proyectos durante las reuniones de cierre o revisión..

• En ausencia de un Site Manager/Gerente de Sitio, actúa como punto principal de contacto para clientes y contratistas en sitio, y autoriza o inicia la gestión del avance, la organización del sitio, OHS/seguridad y salud ocupacional, recomendaciones financieras, control de calidad y modificaciones de diseño.

• Da seguimiento a los cronogramas del proyecto para garantizar que las tareas se completen a tiempo y en su totalidad; registra cualquier desviación en el alcance del trabajo en el sistema Bühler CAQ.

Anforderungen:
Licenciatura en: ingeniería mecánica, eléctrica, automatización o afín
Mimino 3 años de experiencia en un puesto de ingeniería de instalación
Hardware: AutoCAD, Ebase o Eplan.
Software: Windows Server 2012, Microsoft Visual Studio, Microsoft SQL Server 2012, VMware, HyperV.
PLC: Studio 5000, TIA Portal.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: International Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
As an International Logistics Coordinator, you will play a key role in ensuring customer orders are delivered smoothly and reliably across the globe. You'll take ownership of coordinating international shipments, proactively addressing potential disruptions, and keeping stakeholders informed every step of the way. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to make a direct impact on customer satisfaction by ensuring orders are delivered on time, on cost, and to the highest quality standards, while collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive successful outcomes.

Aufgaben:
• Responsible for coordinating shipping of equipment around the world including all modes of transportation.

• Knowledge in Incoterms, Harmonized Codes, Schedule B Number.

• Working and managing Buhler's relationship with the carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers.

• Tracking and reporting data.

• Work closely with all areas involved in the supply chain: Customer Service, Project Execution, procurement, Accounting, Commercial, Manufacturing, warehouse and shipping departments of Buhler.

• Frequent use of Excel, SAP, and Word programs.

Anforderungen:
• College Degree Preferred.

• At 3-5 years experience in international shipping, and logistics, purchasing or fulfillment.

• Experience with SAP or similar ERP preferred.

• Working knowledge of Excel and Mircosoft Office software.

• Logistics experience in strategically designing, implementing and modifying complex supply chains across multiple modes.

• Ability to assign routes for all types and sizes of shipments according to delivery dates assigned.

• Experience in all modes of logistics providing the ability to analyze the supply chain and make adjustments and recommendations to improve service and cost.

descriptionByLocale.de:

Sie übernehmen die Verantwortung für die Koordination internationaler Sendungen, die proaktive Bewältigung potenzieller Störungen und halten die Stakeholder bei jedem Schritt auf dem Weg auf dem Laufenden. In dieser Rolle haben Sie die Möglichkeit, einen direkten Einfluss auf die Kundenzufriedenheit zu haben, indem Sie sicherstellen, dass Bestellungen pünktlich, kostendeckend und nach höchsten Qualitätsstandards geliefert werden, während Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenarbeiten, um erfolgreiche Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Aufgaben:
• Verantwortlich für die Koordination des Versands von Ausrüstung auf der ganzen Welt, einschließlich aller Transportmittel.
• Kenntnisse in Incoterms, Harmonized Codes, Schedule B Nummer.
• Arbeit und Verwaltung der Beziehung von Buhler zu den Spediteuren, Spediteuren und Zollagenten.
• Tracking- und Reporting-Daten.
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit allen Bereichen der Lieferkette: Kundenservice, Projektausführung, Beschaffung, Buchhaltung, Handel, Fertigung, Lager und Versandabteilungen von Buhler.
• Häufige Verwendung von Excel, SAP und Word-Programmen. Anforderungen:
• College Degree Preferred.
• Mit 3-5 Jahren Erfahrung im internationalen Versand, und Logistik, Einkauf oder Fulfillment.
• Erfahrung mit SAP oder ähnlichem ERP bevorzugt.
• Kenntnisse in Excel und Mircosoft Office Software.
• Logistikerfahrung in der strategischen Gestaltung, Implementierung und Änderung komplexer Lieferketten über mehrere Modi hinweg.
• Möglichkeit, Routen für alle Arten und Größen von Sendungen gemäß den zugewiesenen Lieferterminen zuzuweisen.
• Erfahrung in allen Arten der Logistik bietet die Möglichkeit, die Lieferkette zu analysieren und Anpassungen und Empfehlungen zur Verbesserung von Service und Kosten vorzunehmen. Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die mit Bühler-Geräten hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen fahren Fahrzeuge, deren Teile mit unseren Maschinen hergestellt wurden. Wir bemühen uns, Innovationen für eine bessere Welt zu schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. descriptionByLocale.fr:

Vous serez propriétaire de la coordination des expéditions internationales, de la gestion proactive des perturbations potentielles et de l'information des intervenants à chaque étape. Dans ce rôle, vous aurez l'occasion d'avoir un impact direct sur la satisfaction des clients en vous assurant que les commandes sont livrées à temps, sur les coûts et selon les normes de qualité les plus élevées, tout en collaborant avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour obtenir des résultats positifs. Aufgaben:
• Responsable de la coordination de l'expédition de matériel dans le monde entier, y compris tous les modes de transport.
• Connaissance des incoterms, des codes harmonisés, numéro de l'annexe B.
• Travailler et gérer les relations de Buhler avec les transporteurs, les transitaires, les courtiers en douane.
• Données de suivi et de communication.
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec tous les secteurs de la chaîne d'approvisionnement : Service à la clientèle, Exécution de projets, Achats, Comptabilité, Commercial, Fabrication, entrepôt et services d'expédition de Buhler.
• Utilisation fréquente des programmes Excel, SAP et Word. C'est pas vrai.
• Diplôme universitaire préféré.
• À 3-5 ans d'expérience dans le transport maritime international, et la logistique, l'achat ou la réalisation.
• Expérience avec SAP ou ERP similaire préféré.
• Connaissance pratique des logiciels Excel et Mircosoft Office.
• Expérience logistique dans la conception stratégique, la mise en œuvre et la modification de chaînes d'approvisionnement complexes à travers plusieurs modes.
• Capacité d'attribuer des itinéraires pour tous les types et tailles d'expéditions selon les dates de livraison assignées.
• Expérience dans tous les modes de logistique offrant la capacité d'analyser la chaîne d'approvisionnement et faire des ajustements et des recommandations pour améliorer le service et les coûts. Deux milliards de personnes mangent chaque jour de la nourriture produite avec des équipements Bühler. Un milliard de personnes conduisent des véhicules dont les pièces ont été fabriquées avec nos machines. Bühler vise à équilibrer l'humanité, la nature et l'économie dans chaque décision en développant des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation humaine, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité. Nous nous efforçons de créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. Par conséquent, nous faisons équipe avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les universités pour accélérer l'impact ensemble.

jobs.title: Regional Channel Partner Specialist
jobs.description:
As Regional Channel Partner Specialist, you will serve as the primary link between our commercial team and our region network of distributors, reseller and dealers. Your mission is to scale our market presence by empowering partners with the technical knowledge, sales tools, and strategic support they need to succeed. The role is task to manage the entire partner lifecycle from scouting and onboarding new partners to driving revenue growth within established accounts.

Aufgaben:
• Identify, recruit, and onboard high-performing channel partners in key geographic territories. Develop and execute strategic channel programs to drive significant sales growth and market share expansion through partner networks.

• Establish clear performance metrics and goals for each partner, aligned with overall channel objectives. Regularly monitor partner performance, identify areas for improvement, and implement corrective actions as needed

• Coordinate with the internal team to provide partners with deep-dive training product and services.

• Build strong, trust-based relationships with key decision-makers within partner organizations. Proactively identify and address partner challenges and roadblocks to ensure smooth collaboration

• Stay abreast of industry trends, competitor activity, and market conditions that may impact the channel landscape. Analyze partner performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement. Generate comprehensive reports on channel performance, including sales results, pipeline metrics, and partner satisfaction levels.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelors degree in business management or equivalent

• Minimum 5 years of experience in channel management, with a proven track record of success in driving significant revenue growth through partner networks. Prior sales experience and track records will be an added advantage.

• Proficiency in CRM system

• Proficiency in English, both spoken and written

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.
