jobs.description:
Bühler (China) Investment Co., Ltd. established in 2011 in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province, is the group headquarters of the Swiss Bühler Group in Greater China and the first integrated headquarters of multinational companies in Jiangsu Province. With our advanced technology, we lead the market in grain handling and processing, consumer food manufacturing, and die-casting, grinding and dispersion. With our vision of "Innovations for a better world", we are committed to developing more innovative solutions by leveraging the global resources of the Bühler Group and taking advantage of localization.

Aufgaben:
• Manage sourcing activities of indirect materials, including MICE、Capital Expense, MRO, facility management, IT and HR services

• Responsible for sourcing and supplier management, continually optimize supply base to get competitive supplier base for indirect materials

• Work with regional category manager in building and implementing sourcing and category strategy

• Lead cross function team to complete potential supplier assessment and audit, and supplier performance improvement with corrective measures

• Closely work with internal customers to specify procurement requirements including but not limited to cost target, delivery time, brand, technology, and services

• Carry out RFI and RFQ process with competitive bidding process, and negotiate best prices and other commercial terms together with internal stakeholders

• Implement supplier contract to mitigate all potential supply and legal risks

• Complete subsequent purchasing activities timely including purchase order release, supplier delivery follow up and payment process

• Ensure supply and service continuous improvement, for business needs as well as internal customer service

• Establish the price database of indirect material, take lead on category annual cost saving initiatives and meet the objective.

Anforderungen:
• First degree: Bachelor

• PMP or CPSM is preferred

• 5-7 years' working experience in multinational companies, with head office experience is plus.

• 5-7 years' working experience for MICE category purchasing.

• 5-7 years' experience of indirect materials purchasing in an equipment manufacturing environment or similar.

• Be familiar with the purchasing of MRO, factory civil engineering, property leasing, equipment and plant maintenance, and administration consumables, etc.

• Advanced Sourcing methods (TCO, cost breakdown, negotiations skills, supplier selection, development, and relationship management)

• Good knowledge of project management, contract law, risk avoidance

• Good knowledge of the company operations, such as logistic, finance, production, quality, and R&D

• Good software/ system skills – excel, word, PowerPoint, SAP

• Language：CET6

• Self-driven and apt to take decisions

• Presentation and representations skills

• Have the capability to lead a cross function team to achieve the target

• Personal commitment and result oriented

• Cross functional, holistic and logic thinking and action taking

• Good execution and provide feedback in time

• Able to work under the pressure

• Good communication skills with influencing and convincing

descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler (Cina) Investment Co., Ltd. fondata nel 2011 a Wuxi, provincia di Jiangsu, è la sede del gruppo del Gruppo svizzero Bühler in Cina Maggiore e la prima sede integrata di società multinazionali nella provincia di Jiangsu. Con la nostra tecnologia avanzata, guidiamo il mercato nella manipolazione e nella lavorazione dei cereali, nella produzione di cibo di consumo e nella pressofusione, nella macinazione e nella dispersione. Con la nostra visione di "Innovazioni per un mondo migliore", ci impegniamo a sviluppare soluzioni più innovative sfruttando le risorse globali del Gruppo Bühler e sfruttando la localizzazione. Aufgaben:
• Gestire attività di approvvigionamento di materiali indiretti, tra cui MICE escursioniCapital Expense, MRO, gestione impianti, servizi IT e HR
• Responsabile per la gestione dell'approvvigionamento e dei fornitori, ottimizza continuamente la base di approvvigionamento per ottenere una base di fornitori competitiva per materiali indiretti
• Lavorare con il responsabile della categoria regionale nella costruzione e nell'attuazione della strategia di approvvigionamento e categoria
• Lead cross team funzione per completare la valutazione e l'audit dei potenziali fornitori e il miglioramento delle prestazioni dei fornitori con misure correttive
• Lavorare con i clienti interni per specificare i requisiti di approvvigionamento, compresi ma non limitati a target di costo, tempi di consegna, marca, tecnologia e servizi
• Eseguire il processo RFI e RFQ con il processo di offerta competitiva, e negoziare i migliori prezzi e altri termini commerciali insieme con gli stakeholder interni
• Contratto fornitore di implementazione per mitigare tutti i potenziali rischi di approvvigionamento e legale
• Completare le successive attività di acquisto puntuale compreso il rilascio dell'ordine di acquisto, la consegna del fornitore segue il processo di pagamento
• Assicurare la fornitura e il servizio di miglioramento continuo, per le esigenze aziendali e il servizio clienti interno
• Stabilire il database dei prezzi dei materiali indiretti, prendere in considerazione le iniziative di risparmio annuale di categoria e soddisfare l'obiettivo. Anforderungen:
• Primo grado: Bachelor
• PMP o CPSM è preferito
• 5-7 anni di esperienza lavorativa nelle aziende multinazionali, con esperienza di ufficio principale è più.
• 5-7 anni di esperienza lavorativa per l'acquisto di categoria MICE.
• 5-7 anni di esperienza di materiali indiretti che acquistano in un ambiente di produzione di attrezzature o simili.
• Conoscere l'acquisto di MRO, ingegneria civile di fabbrica, leasing di proprietà, attrezzature e manutenzione di impianti, e materiali di consumo di amministrazione, ecc.
• Metodi di Sourcing avanzato (TCO, ripartizione dei costi, competenze di negoziazione, selezione dei fornitori, sviluppo e gestione delle relazioni)
• Buona conoscenza della gestione del progetto, diritto contrattuale, evitare rischi
• Buona conoscenza delle operazioni aziendali, come logistica, finanza, produzione, qualità e R&D
• Buon software / competenze di sistema – eccellere, parola, PowerPoint, SAP
• Lingua: CET6
• Autodidatta e adatta a prendere decisioni
• Presentazione e capacità di rappresentazione
• Avere la capacità di guidare un team di funzione trasversale per raggiungere il bersaglio
• Impegno personale e orientamento dei risultati
• Croce funzionale, olistico e logica pensiero e azione
• Buona esecuzione e fornire feedback in tempo
• In grado di lavorare sotto la pressione
• Buone capacità di comunicazione con influenzare e convincere Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine. Bühler si propone di bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nei settori alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

• Sie übernehmen die Projektanalyse, Problemerkennung und -behebung sowie Einleitung von Massnahmen

• Sie sind verantwortlich für die Durchführung von Basic- und Detailengineering unter Einbezug von internen und externen Stakeholdern

• Sie haben Freude am regelmässigen Kontakt zu Kunden und diversen internen und externen Stakeholdern und unterstützen bei der Offerterstellung

Anforderungen:
• Technisches Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau, Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik (FH/HF) oder ähnlich

• Erfahrung in der Abwicklung internationaler Anlageprojekte

• Kenntnisse in Automatisation und Elektroplanung

• Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch- und Englisch sowie Fähigkeit mit verschiedenen Anspruchsgruppen zu interagieren

• Selbstständige, motivierte und belastbare Persönlichkeit, welche offen für internationale Reisen ist (ca. 20%)

Personalrestaurant VIVA
Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitenden ein tägliches Fitnessmenü ab 9, 00 CHF.

Wir bieten ein OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Halbtax für 365 CHF + 400CHF ÖV-Guthaben sowie ein attraktives Erstklass-Abonnement oder kostenlose Parkplätze.

Health-Port
Wir setzen uns für Gesundheitsprävention durch Laboranalysen, Massagen, Ernährungsberatung, Physiotherapie, Gruppenkurse sowie einen Betriebsarzt ein.

Wir bieten Spezialkonditionen bei Handyabonnements über Mobilezone bei Sunrise und Swisscom.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Do you have a soft spot for the administrative handling of export transactions and would you like to assume responsibility in a dynamic environment? Then you are exactly right in our forwarding team in the field of Manufacturing and Logistics. In this versatile role, you ensure the smooth administrative handling of international transports of machines and spare parts and actively contribute to an efficient, timely and customer-oriented supply chain. Tasks:
• You handle export and cross-trade shipments for machines and spare parts independently and customer-oriented
• They manage defined country territories, take on special tasks in the forwarding team and communicate proactively with internal interfaces, international locations, authorities and transport service providers.
• You create export-compliant shipping and transport documents and together with internal and external partners ensure correct import processing in the receiving country
• You provide shipping instructions to carriers and logistics partners, monitor shipping dates and coordinate multimodal transports
• They obtain transport offers, compare and evaluate them according to defined selection criteria and ensure compliance with all customs and export-relevant requirements. Requirements
• Completed commercial training, ideally supplemented by further education or professional experience in forwarding, export or international logistics
• Several years of experience in export processing and international transport administration as well as good knowledge in shipping documentation, international transports and administrative logistics processes
• Knowledge of customs tariff, customs clearance or export control beneficial
• Structured, independent and proactive personality with high customer and service orientation, communication strength and teamwork
• Flexibility and adaptability in a dynamic environment as well as good MS Office skills, ideally SAP experience, and very good German and English skills in word and writing We offer: Attractive holiday entitlement Sufficient time for recreation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of holidays per year depending on the year of life. Attractive mobility concept We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax for 365 CHF + 400CHF public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class subscription or free parking. Staff restaurant VIVA We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9.00 CHF. Employer-funded pension plan Bühler Pensionskasse offers its employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch Sports activities We promote sport through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for update and active fitness. Health port We are committed to health prevention through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor. Two billion people eat food produced at Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies. With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

jobs.description:
布勒莱宝光学设备（北京）有限公司，是德国布勒莱宝光学在北京设立的独资子公司，目前是布勒集团高真空镀膜设备全球两大生产制造基地之一。布勒莱宝光学的业务涉及光学以及能源镀膜两大类业务领域，为中国的精密光学、视光学、汽车、半导体、柔性电子、建筑玻璃等行业的发展做出了贡献。
Bühler Leybold Optics is a wholly owned subsidiary of Bühler Leybold Optics in Beijing and is currently one of the two global manufacturing bases for high vacuum coating equipment of the Bühler Group. The business of Bühler Leybold Optics covers two major business fields: optics and large area coating, contributing to the development of the precision optics, optics, automotive, semiconductor, flexible electronics and architectural glass industries in China. Aufgaben: • 1、根据项目要求，制定电气系统的设计，改进方案； • 2、根据开发计划需要，进行设备电气部件的设计与改进； • 3、电气相关元件的选型、物料清单的编制； • 4、配合产品设计各阶段评审、验证和确认； • 5、参与生产过程中电气部分的调试和技术支持； • 6、协助解决生产过程中的电气技术问题； • 7、负责对供应商进行技术支持； • 8、及时跟进新产品市场反馈，了解客户使用情况； • 9、负责技术资料的翻译整理，及图文资料、样品的分类管理、归档。 Anforderungen: • 1、电气、自动化相关专业，本科及以上学历； • 2、具有3年以上全套设备电气设计经验，有真空设备经验优先； • 3、熟悉EPLAN P8电气设计软件； • 4、熟悉非标产品设计，熟悉低压配电产品，机电设备控制，能独立完成电气控制系统部品的基本选型和设计任务； • 5、英语读写熟练。 • 20亿人每天食用布勒设备生产的食品。10亿人驾驶的车辆中包含本公司设备制造的部件。 • 布勒力求在每项决策中平衡兼顾人类、自然和经济，在全球食品、饲料和交通运输行业开发解决方案，拓展可持续业务解决方案。我们努力以创新驱动未来，特别专注于健康、安全、可持续的解决方案。因此，我们与客户、创业公司、跨国企业和学界携手 • 合作，共同加速实现影响。

jobs.title: Senior Installation Supervisor
jobs.description:
As a Senior Installation Supervisor at Bühler you are managing and leading a team of technician required for the installation of big and / or complex projects (X-BU, type A projects). You would be responsible for the planning, preparation and execution of the installation supervision, within scope of work associated to the assigned project. Would you like to take on this new challenge? We look forward to receiving your application!

Aufgaben:
• You get sure that the personnel assigned is fully acquainted with the site specific rules, safety regulations and environmental protection measures and that they perform their work accordingly as well as you perform installation according to the specifications and engineering documents, taking into account the safety instructions, environmental protection measures and local regulations

• You monitor progress of construction against the program, and take steps to ensure the program is achieved. You initiate as required mitigation/ preventive actions to achieve target program timely with the support of the Site Manager or Project Manager

• You conduct or attend daily and weekly meetings with Bühler staff and subcontractors, ensure that the Site Manager and the Project Manager receive regular information updates as well as correct behaviour and good teamwork within the installation and commissioning team in accordance with company policy and local requirements/ regulations

• You ensure proper reporting while identify, document and communicate any deviations from customer contract as well as you are responsible for maintaining an intensive customer relationship and a high level of customer satisfaction

Anforderungen:
• Engineering degree as well as 10 years of experience as Chief Installation Supervisor or proof of sufficient skills

• Technical and commercial knowledge covering multiple disciplines

• Excellent written and oral communication skills in English, including the ability to interface effectively with people inside and outside of the company

• Strong planning, organising and priority setting skills, with a proven ability to manage teams

• Strong customer focus, sound judgment and decision making and problem solving skills

Polymechanik in Fachrichtung Drehen und/ oder Fräsen ist Ihre Leidenschaft und Sie arbeiten gerne in einem dynamischen Umfeld? descriptionByLocale.it:
La responsabilità principale di Manufacturing, Logistics & Supply Chain è garantire una catena di fornitura liscia per Bühler e i nostri clienti - nelle regioni per le regioni. Le nostre 29 fabbriche in tutto il mondo seguono il sistema di produzione BPS Bühler con i suoi principi Total Synchro e obiettivi SQCDP, e ogni fabbrica della nostra rete ha un focus chiaramente definito. I nostri 5000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo si sforzano di fornire prodotti Bühler ogni giorno al momento giusto, al giusto costo e nella giusta qualità. La polimeccanica nel campo della tornitura e/o della fresatura è la vostra passione e vi piace lavorare in un ambiente dinamico? Come membro del nostro team nella sede di Uzwil, troverete un ambiente emozionante e vivace - non vediamo l'ora di vederti! Compiti:
• Sei responsabile per l'installazione, la programmazione e l'uso di rettificatrici circolari CNC Studer S31 e Studer S41
• Si prende il controllo della rettifica di singole parti e piccole serie con requisiti di alta qualità
• Ti piace la selezione e la configurazione dei mezzi di bloccaggio, le molatrici e i parametri di processo
• L'utente è responsabile di garantire la precisione dimensionale in base al disegno e alle tolleranze (comprese le tolleranze di forma e posizione)
• Si prende il sopravvento dell'ottimizzazione dei processi di rettifica per quanto riguarda il tempo di ciclo, la qualità della superficie e la durata degli utensili Requisiti
• Formazione completa come polimeccanica: nella produzione EFZ o formazione equivalente
• Diversi anni di esperienza nella rettifica circolare CNC, idealmente su Studer S31/S41
• Modo di lavoro indipendente, efficace, preciso e orientato alla qualità, nonché personalità orientata al team, affidabile e motivata
• Buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'IT
• Volontà di lavorare sia in orari di lavoro normali che in un modello di tempo di lavoro a turni Offriamo: Ristorante personale VIVA Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9.00 CHF. Concetto di mobilità attraente Offriamo un OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax per 365 CHF + 400CHF credito di trasporto pubblico e un attraente abbonamento di prima classe o parcheggio gratuito. Porta salute Siamo impegnati nella prevenzione della salute attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale. Attraente diritto di vacanza Tempo sufficiente per la ricreazione e gli interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanze all'anno a seconda dell'anno di vita. Piano pensionistico finanziato dal datore di lavoro Bühler Pensionskasse offre ai propri dipendenti un fondo pensione indipendente che garantisce un pensionamento finanziario affidabile: www.pk-buhler.ch Abbonamenti mobili Offriamo condizioni speciali per gli abbonamenti mobili tramite Mobilezone a Sunrise e Swisscom. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The main responsibility of Manufacturing, Logistics & Supply Chain is to ensure a smooth supply chain for Bühler and our customers - in the regions for the regions. Our 29 factories worldwide follow the BPS Bühler production system with its Total Synchro principles and SQCDP goals, and every factory in our network has a clearly defined focus. Our 5000 employees worldwide strive to deliver Bühler products every day at the right time, at the right cost and in the right quality. Polymechanics in the field of turning and/or milling is your passion and you like working in a dynamic environment? As a member of our team at the Uzwil headquarters, you will find an exciting and lively environment - we look forward to seeing you! Tasks:
• You are responsible for setting up, programming and operating CNC circular grinding machines Studer S31 and Studer S41
• You take over the grinding of individual parts and small series with high quality requirements
• You enjoy the selection and setup of clamping means, grinding wheels and process parameters
• You are responsible for ensuring dimensional accuracy according to the drawing and tolerances (including shape and position tolerances)
• You take over the optimization of the grinding processes with regard to cycle time, surface quality and tool life Requirements
• Completed training as a polymechanic:in EFZ production or equivalent training
• Several years of experience in CNC circular grinding, ideally on Studer S31/S41
• Independent, effective, precise and quality-oriented way of working as well as team-oriented, reliable and motivated personality
• Good knowledge of German and IT
• Willingness to work both in normal working hours and in a shift-like working time model We offer: Staff restaurant VIVA We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9.00 CHF. Attractive mobility concept We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax for 365 CHF + 400CHF public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class subscription or free parking. Health port We are committed to health prevention through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor. Attractive holiday entitlement Sufficient time for recreation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of holidays per year depending on the year of life. Employer-funded pension plan Bühler Pensionskasse offers its employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch Mobile subscriptions We offer special conditions for mobile subscriptions via Mobilezone at Sunrise and Swisscom. Two billion people eat food produced at Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies. With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Nos 29 usines dans le monde suivent le système de production BPS Bühler avec ses principes Total Synchro et ses objectifs SQCDP, et chaque usine de notre réseau a un objectif clairement défini. Nos 5000 employés du monde entier s'efforcent de livrer des produits Bühler chaque jour au bon moment, au bon coût et dans la bonne qualité. La polymécanique dans le domaine du tournage et/ou du fraisage est votre passion et vous aimez travailler dans un environnement dynamique? En tant que membre de notre équipe au siège d'Uzwil, vous trouverez un environnement passionnant et animé - nous avons hâte de vous voir! Tâches :

• Plusieurs années d'expérience dans le broyage circulaire CNC, idéalement sur Studer S31/S41
• Un mode de travail indépendant, efficace, précis et axé sur la qualité ainsi qu'une personnalité axée sur l'équipe, fiable et motivée
• Bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'informatique
• Volonté de travailler à la fois dans les heures normales de travail et dans un modèle de temps de travail par quart Nous offrons: Restaurant du personnel VIVA Nous offrons à nos employés un menu de fitness quotidien à partir de 9.00 CHF. Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins de l'économie, des personnes et de la nature. jobs.title: Solution Architect SAP PM & BPT
jobs.description: To strengthen our IT department, we are looking for a Solution Architect SAP S/4HANA PM & BPT to shape the future of digital asset lifecycle management for our global B2B customers. In this role, you will own the end-to-end architecture of our Installed Base & Asset Data Platform, driving integration across SAP and non-SAP ecosystems, data platforms, and IoT solutions. Working closely with Product Owners, development teams, and business stakeholders, you will design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that enable seamless service processes, high-quality asset data, and outstanding customer service outcomes. Aufgaben: • You define and own the end-to-end solution architecture for the Installed Base & Asset Data Platform, ensuring scalability, resilience, and alignment with enterprise architecture standards • You design and optimize integration architectures across SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, Service Cloud, SAP FSM, Asset Manager, data platforms, and IoT ecosystems • You translate business, functional, and non-functional requirements into robust architecture blueprints, solution designs, and implementation guidelines • You lead architectural governance by conducting design reviews, driving technical decisions, and ensuring compliance with integration, API, and data standards • You collaborate closely with Product Owners, engineering teams, and key stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions aligned with the target architecture and strategic roadmap Anforderungen: • University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Informatics, or a related discipline • Proven experience in solution architecture, enterprise application design, and system integration within complex SAP and non-SAP environments, including SAP S/4HANA service processes • Strong expertise in designing architectures for B2B Customer Service asset lifecycle management, with a focus on cross-system integration and scalable solution design • Deep understanding of data and integration architectures, including APIs, event-driven architectures, SAP BW/BDC, data platforms, IoT ecosystems, and cloud-based technologies • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills in English, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for business audiences and collaborate effectively in distributed agile teams Wir bieten: Attractive vacation entitlement Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age. Attractive mobility concept We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking. VIVA Restaurant We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF. Employer-funded pension plan The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch Health-Port We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor. Sports activities We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

Lavorando a stretto contatto con i proprietari di prodotti, i team di sviluppo e gli stakeholder aziendali, progetta soluzioni scalabili, sicure e pronte per il futuro che consentono processi di servizio senza soluzione di continuità, dati di asset di alta qualità e risultati eccezionali del servizio clienti. offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanza all'anno a seconda dell'età. Ristorante VIVA Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9, 00 CHF. Piano pensionistico finanziato dal datore di lavoro Il Bühler Pension Fund offre ai dipendenti Bühler un fondo pensione indipendente che garantisce una sicurezza finanziaria affidabile in pensione: www.pk-buhler.ch Salute-Porto Ci impegniamo nell'assistenza sanitaria preventiva attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale. Attività sportive Promuoviamo l'attività fisica attraverso la formazione di circuiti auto-organizzati e gruppi in esecuzione, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e l'attivazione di fitness. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine. Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

descriptionByLocale.en:
As an accountant, you will support our experienced accounting team at the Salzburg Bühler AG office in any operational and administrative tasks. After a comprehensive training, you will take on your own tasks, which you will handle independently. Accounting provides important information to manage the company in the best possible way. In order to continue to perform this responsible task optimally, we are looking for you, our new team member!

Let us at Bühler make a difference together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • You check and book the travel expenses of the field staff of our Central Eastern Europe region • The asset accounting is managed and maintained by you (inventory) • In addition, you are responsible for the ongoing accounting, including the processing of incoming invoices as well as the processing of credit card and bank transactions, • You create and submit statistical reports • The VAT refund is carried out annually by you • In addition, you support in the preparation of the annual accounts • Also the support of the front office team (representation at the reception if necessary) is one of your tasks Requirements • Completed commercial training (HAK, HAS, HLW, apprenticeship) • At least 1-2 years of professional experience in accounting according to UGB & tax law • Very good MS Office user knowledge (especially Excel) • Knowledge of BMD-NTCS accounting software (including BMD KORE) is an advantage • You have perfect German & good English skills in word and writing • An open-minded and friendly personality sets you apart • You are a team player and work structured, accurate and reliable We offer: Mobile work If your work permits, mobile work is possible in consultation with your manager (up to 40%). This allows you to reconcile your professional and private life. Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities to do so. Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices. Diverse and inclusive workplace We promote an inclusive culture that values our global diversity. Respect and empathy ensure that everyone feels safe and can do their best. Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, face-to-face training and webinars with short, relevant, engaging, personalised and mobile formats. Health and well-being services We offer a range of health and wellness offerings to help you feel physically and mentally comfortable. Two billion people eat food produced at Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies. With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

jobs.title: Solution Architect SAP C4C v2
jobs.description:
To strengthen our IT department, we are looking for a Solution Architect SAP C4C v2 to shape our global CRM landscape based on SAP Sales Cloud v2 and SAP Service Cloud v2. As the architectural lead, you will design scalable and integrated solutions that support Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, and Digital Customer Experience processes, while ensuring seamless connectivity across SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, and other enterprise platforms. Working closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and development teams, you will drive architectural decisions, govern technology standards, and help define the future roadmap of our customer engagement ecosystem.

Aufgaben:
• You define and drive the target architecture for Bühler's global CRM platform and Customer Engagement ecosystem

• You design scalable integration and data solutions across SAP Sales Cloud v2, SAP Service Cloud v2, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, and connected digital platforms

• You translate business and technical requirements into solution architectures, implementation roadmaps, and design guidelines

• You lead architectural governance, technical decision-making, and ensure compliance with enterprise architecture, integration, and security standards

• You collaborate closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and delivery teams to continuously evolve and enhance CRM capabilities

Anforderungen:
• University degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Engineering, or a comparable qualification, combined with proven experience as a Solution Architect or Lead Architect in large-scale SAP CRM transformation programs

• Deep expertise in SAP Sales Cloud v2, SAP Service Cloud v2, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, and SAP Integration Suite within complex global SAP environments

• Strong knowledge of enterprise integration architecture, including APIs, event-driven architectures, master data integration, customer data management, and enterprise integration patterns

• Ability to define architecture roadmaps, lead technical governance, and translate business strategy into scalable, secure, and future-oriented solution designs

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills in English, with experience working in Agile (SAFe) environments and influencing business and technology decisions at senior leadership level

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement
Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking.

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Health-Port
We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Sports activities
We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: Export Control Officer
jobs.description:
Join our team as Export Control Officer and play a key role in ensuring compliant, efficient, and successful international business operations. In this position, you will be at the forefront of export control, safeguarding adherence to global regulations while supporting cross-border customer projects from initial offer to final delivery. Working in a dynamic and international environment, you will collaborate closely with various stakeholders, contribute to process improvements and digital initiatives, and make a tangible impact on how we manage export compliance. If you are a detail-oriented professional with strong analytical skills and a passion for working across departments and cultures, this is your opportunity to grow and excel.

Aufgaben:
• You ensure compliance with export control, sanctions, and embargo regulations (CH, EU, US) while safeguarding adherence to all legal requirements

• You perform screenings, classifications (ECN/ECCN), and risk assessments, including thorough end-use and end-user evaluations

• You determine licensing requirements, apply for, and manage export licenses to support smooth and compliant operations

• You support customer projects end-to-end - from offer to delivery - including cross-border movements and on-site activities - while ensuring accurate export documentation and compliant shipment processes

• You advise and train internal stakeholders and actively contribute to process improvements, audits, digitalization initiatives, and the maintenance of export control master data

Anforderungen:
• Relevant technical or commercial education combined with several years of professional experience in import/export, customs, logistics, or related areas, ideally including export control or project business

• Strong knowledge of IT systems and tools, especially MS Office and SAP (ERP/GTS), with additional expertise in export control systems considered an advantage

• Structured, independent, and goal-oriented work style, coupled with strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and cross-functional decision-making skills, as well as high attention to sensitive topics

• High level of commitment, flexibility, resilience, and teamwork, with additional certifications or experience in international export control regulations (CH, EU, US) and multicultural environments viewed as beneficial

• Confident communicator with a professional presence, capable of interacting effectively with internal and external stakeholders in English; German and other languages are a plus

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement
Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking.

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Health-Port
We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Sports activities
We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness.

Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

In questa posizione, sarai in prima linea nel controllo delle esportazioni, salvaguardando l'adesione alle normative globali, supportando i progetti dei clienti transfrontalieri dall'offerta iniziale alla consegna finale. Lavorando in un ambiente dinamico e internazionale, collaborerai a stretto contatto con vari stakeholder, contribuirai a elaborare miglioramenti e iniziative digitali e a dare un impatto tangibile su come gestiamo la conformità all'esportazione. • Effettuate proiezioni, classificazioni (ECN/ECCN), e valutazioni dei rischi, comprese le valutazioni complete dell'utente finale e dell'utente finale
• Determina i requisiti di licenza, applica e gestisce le licenze di esportazione per supportare operazioni lisce e conformi
• Sostieni i progetti dei clienti end-to-end - dall'offerta alla consegna - compresi i movimenti transfrontalieri e le attività in loco - garantendo al contempo la documentazione di esportazione accurata e i processi di spedizione conformi
• Si consiglia e formare le parti interessate interne e contribuire attivamente a elaborare miglioramenti, audit, iniziative di digitalizzazione, e la manutenzione dei dati master di controllo delle esportazioni Anforderungen:
• Istruzione tecnica o commerciale rilevante combinata con diversi anni di esperienza professionale in import/export, dogana, logistica o aree correlate, idealmente compreso il controllo delle esportazioni o il business del progetto
• Forte conoscenza dei sistemi e degli strumenti IT, in particolare MS Office e SAP (ERP/GTS), con ulteriori competenze nei sistemi di controllo delle esportazioni considerato un vantaggio
• Stile di lavoro strutturato, indipendente e orientato all'obiettivo, accoppiato con forte pensiero analitico, problem-solving, e competenze decisionali interfunzionali, così come alta attenzione a temi sensibili
• Alto livello di impegno, flessibilità, resilienza e lavoro di squadra, con certificazioni aggiuntive o esperienza nelle normative internazionali di controllo delle esportazioni (CH, EU, US) e ambienti multiculturali visti come vantaggiosi
• Confidente comunicatore con presenza professionale, capace di interagire efficacemente con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni in inglese; tedesco e altre lingue sono un plus Wir bieten: Attraente diritto di vacanza Abbastanza tempo per il relax e gli interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanza all'anno a seconda dell'età. Ristorante VIVA Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9, 00 CHF. Piano pensionistico finanziato dal datore di lavoro Il Bühler Pension Fund offre ai dipendenti Bühler un fondo pensione indipendente che garantisce una sicurezza finanziaria affidabile in pensione: www.pk-buhler.ch Salute-Porto Ci impegniamo nell'assistenza sanitaria preventiva attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale. Attività sportive Promuoviamo l'attività fisica attraverso la formazione di circuiti auto-organizzati e gruppi in esecuzione, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e l'attivazione di fitness. Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

jobs.description:
Join Bühler's Business Area Value Nutrition and help shape the next generation of automation and software solutions for advanced machine control systems. In this role within R&D, you will combine PLC programming, modern software development, and interdisciplinary collaboration to develop reliable, efficient, and high-performing solutions that support our customers in achieving outstanding process and product quality.

Aufgaben:
• You develop and implement PLC software for machine control systems, primarily using Siemens automation platforms; Rockwell knowledge is an advantage

• You design, implement, and maintain visualization software, including C# backend services and Angular-based frontend applications

• You analyze technical requirements and translate them into robust automation and software solutions aligned with engineering standards and best practices

• You collaborate closely with electrical, mechanical, process, and project teams, including close cooperation with our development team in China

• You support machine commissioning, troubleshooting, optimization, and 3rd-level support for machine control systems and related services, both remotely and on-site when required

Anforderungen:
• Degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a comparable technical field, ideally from a University of Applied Sciences or ETH

• Several years of experience in industrial automation, with solid knowledge of PLC programming, machine control software, relevant automation standards, C# backend development, and ideally Angular, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS frontend development

• Good understanding of software engineering principles, including modular design, testing, version control, and documentation, combined with analytical thinking, strong problem-solving skills and deployment strategies as well as willingness to learn data science, data analytics, and machine learning methods for industrial applications

• Strong communication and collaboration skills in interdisciplinary teams, along with very good English and good German skills

• Willingness to travel up to 10% per year

jobs.description:
In 2007, Bühler (Wuxi) Commercial Co., Ltd. was established in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province. We lead the market in grain handling and processing, consumer food manufacturing, and grinding and dispersion with our advanced technology advantages. We have several independent application centers and customer service centers for milling, pasta, color sorting, consumer food, grinding and dispersion, providing integrated solutions for multiple industry chains.
With our vision of “Innovations for a better world”, we are committed to developing more innovative solutions by leveraging the global resources of the Bühler Group and taking advantage of localization. Aufgaben: • Develop and maintain application software on Bühler's Linux-based embedded platform for machine control, covering control logic, parameter handling, alarms, status management, and machine interfaces. • Develop and maintain firmware for sensors used on Bühler machines, enabling sensing, data collection, local processing, diagnostics, and data upload. • Participate in software testing, verification, and validation. • Support machine integration, commissioning, troubleshooting, and issue resolution. Willingness to travel internationally (market introductions, troubleshooting). • Create and maintain technical documentation, such as software design documents, interface descriptions, test records, and release notes. • Follow software development processes, coding standards, version control and quality requirements. Anforderungen: • Bachelor's degree or above in Automation, Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, Control Engineering, or a related field. • 3 or more years of embedded software development experience. • Solid programming skills in C/C++ and good understanding of embedded software development. Familiar with embedded software development tools and workflows, e.g. Eclipse, git etc. We develop on Microsoft Windows for Linux and bare-metal. • Interest in complete machines, and motivated to work in a multidisciplinary and international environment. • Good English reading, writing, and verbal communication skills for international collaboration and technical documentation. • Experience in embedded software development, real-time machine control software, signal processing and closed-loop control, communication networks (IP, CAN, Fieldbus, BLE), low-power embedded systems, relational databases (SQL) is a plus. • Experience with ARM processors, STMicroelectronics STM32, Texas Instruments MCUs, or similar microcontroller platforms is a plus. jobs.description:
Am Standort Beilngries widmen sich rund 360 Mitarbeitende im Geschäftsbereich Grain Quality and Supply dem Anlagen- und Maschinenbau rund um die Themen Getreideverarbeitung sowie Mälzen & Brauen.
Dies umfasst die Reinigung, Trocknung, den Transport (inkl. Fördertechnik und Schiffsbeladung), die Lagerung und Digitalisierung, um Getreide vom Feld bis zum Verbraucher zu verarbeiten. Immer mit dem Fokus auf Effizienz, Produktqualität und Nachhaltigkeit.

Starte deine Ausbildung bei Bühler in Beilngries und freu dich auf:
• Startprämie 500, - Euro + zusätzliche Prämien für deine guten Leistungen
• Azubi-Auto für Fahrten zur Berufsschule
• 1 Woche bezahlter Lernurlaub
• Spannende Azubi-Projekte und Ausflüge
• Mitarbeitervergünstigungen für viele Shops
• International offene Türen nach deinem Abschluss dank unserer Standorte auf der ganzen Welt

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Als Konstruktionsmechaniker (m/w/d) bist du für die Erstellung der Bauteile unserer Maschinen und Anlagen zuständig. • Nach einigen Wochen in der Lehrwerkstatt wirst du alle Bereiche unserer Fertigung kennenlernen und schnell im Auftragsgeschäft aktiv mitarbeiten. • Unsere Ausbildung ist sehr vielfältig und bietet dir einen perfekten Einstieg in das Berufsleben. • Die Ausbildung dauert i.d.R. 3,5 Jahre, die Berufsschule ist in Eichstätt. Anforderungen: • Du interessierst dich für Technik, hast ein gutes räumliches Vorstellungsvermögen und handwerkliches Geschick. • Außerdem bist du engagiert und zuverlässig, Teamarbeit macht dir Spaß. • Mit dem Mittelschulabschluss und guten Noten in Mathematik, sowie den naturwissenschaftlichen Fächern, bist du bei uns genau richtig. Und nach der Ausbildung? • Dieser Beruf bietet ein sehr breites Feld an Chancen nach der Ausbildung. • Du kannst als Konstruktionsmechaniker (m/w/d) in unserer Fertigung arbeiten oder als Außenmonteur „die große Freiheit“ kennenlernen. • Wenn du dich noch weiterbilden möchtest (z.B. Industriemeister, Techniker, Maschinenbaustudium oder Ähnliches), bietet dir Bühler dabei Unterstützung an. Wir bieten: • Familiäre Unternehmenskultur • Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. jobs.title: Service Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Buhler Group in Cairo, Egypt is looking for a passionate professional to join us as Service Sales Manager to lead the Service Sales function for the assigned territory. This position is responsible for driving business growth, developing customer relationships, and leading the team to achieve business objectives.

Aufgaben:
• Maintain strong product knowledge while developing and managing strategic customer relationships.

• Lead, coach, and develop the Service Sales team to achieve business objectives and foster a high-performance culture.

• Develop and execute territory growth plans by identifying new business opportunities and expanding existing customer relationships.

• Collaborate with Area Sales and Service Managers to strengthen customer engagement and business growth in the assigned territory.

• Plan, monitor, and coach the team to achieve sales targets and improve overall performance.

• Identify, handle, and resolve customer complaints/concerns.

• Drive business development by following up on opportunities and sharing market intelligence with internal stakeholders.

• Ensure accurate CRM management with client data and sales pipeline visibility.

• Prepare customer proposals, quotations, and business presentations to support sales growth.

• Achieve Service sales targets while driving overall team performance within the assigned territory.

• Monitor sales performance, provide regular coaching, and support the team in closing key business opportunities.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop business strategies and improve customer satisfaction.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in engineering.

• 10+ years of experience in service, technical sales, or the food processing industry, including experience in leading or mentoring a sales team.

• Fluent communication skill in English and Arabic languages.

• Ability to conduct technical sales discussions and commercial negotiations with customers.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: Prozesstechniker:in
jobs.description:
Möchten Sie technische Herausforderungen direkt vor Ort lösen, Produktionsprozesse optimieren und gleichzeitig an der Weiterentwicklung innovativer Lösungen im Markt des Fahrzeugbaus mitwirken? In dieser spannenden Position als Prozesstechniker:in im Druckguss repräsentieren Sie die Anwendungstechnik und agieren als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Entwicklung, Engineering und Kundenservice – sowohl international beim Kunden als auch im Versuchslabor.

Aufgaben:
• Sie unterstützen den Produktionsstart von Neuanlagen direkt beim Kunden vor Ort – von der Inbetriebnahme und dem Hochfahren der Anlage bis hin zur Fehlersuche, Störungsbeseitigung sowie Optimierung des Gießprozesses.

• Sie optimieren den Produktionsoutput und stellen die Funktion sowie Verfügbarkeit der Anlagen bei unseren internationalen Kunden sicher.

• Sie legen Prozessparameter fest, entwickeln diese weiter und tragen aktiv zur Stabilität, Effizienz und Qualität der Produktionsprozesse im Druckguss bei.

• Sie überwachen und analysieren Qualitätsdaten, identifizieren Ursachen bei Ausschuss und leiten geeignete Korrekturmaßnahmen ein.

• Sie arbeiten eng mit unserer Entwicklungsabteilung zusammen, unterstützen anwendungstechnische Entwicklungsprojekte, betreiben Versuchsinstallationen im Versuchslabor und sind international mit einer Reisetätigkeit von bis zu 60 % im Einsatz.

Anforderungen:
• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Anlagen- und Apparatebauer:in, Automatiker:in, Polymechaniker:in, Elektriker:in, Landmaschinenmechaniker:in, Automobilmechatroniker:in oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung

• Erfahrung in der Inbetriebnahme, Prozessoptimierung sowie Anwendungstechnik im Druckguss

• Grundkenntnisse in Metallurgie, Strömungstechnik und Thermodynamik von Vorteil

• Kenntnisse in Elektrik/Elektronik sowie in hydraulischen Komponenten wünschenswert

• Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie Bereitschaft zu internationalen Reisen von bis zu 60%

jobs.title: Regional Contractual Services Manager
jobs.description:
The Service Agreements Regional Partner is responsible for driving the growth and execution of service agreements across Southeast Asia. This role partners closely with the Sales organization to expand Bühler's service portfolio by identifying opportunities, developing tailored contractual solutions, and securing long-term service agreements. The position plays a critical role in defining commercial structures, ensuring operational excellence, and delivering customer success through strong contractual partnerships.

Aufgaben:
• Take full ownership of the assigned portfolio of service agreements (e.g., Remote Services, Inspection, and Maintenance), ensuring delivery excellence and high customer satisfaction

• Develop and lead a regional support structure, including quotation management, contract delivery, and back-office operations.

• Act as the primary point of contact for all contractual service matters, ensuring timely and effective execution aligned with customer expectations.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Project Execution, Field Service, Spare Parts, and Automation teams to deliver integrated service solutions.

• Drive operational excellence and standardization of service agreement management across the SEA region.

• Oversee contract renewal processes, pricing strategies, and cost control measures to maintain profitability.

• Develop and present integrated service proposals that balance customer needs with business objectives.

• Support the identification, development, quotation, and negotiation of complex service agreements.

• Establish and maintain region-specific cost calculation models in alignment with global guidelines.

• Work with technical, legal, finance, and commercial teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and competitive proposals.

• Maintain comprehensive documentation of quotations, contracts, and handover processes.

• Communicate proactively with stakeholders on proposal status, pricing updates, and contract execution progress.

• Collaborate with global teams to share insights and continuously improve service offerings and customer experience.

• Support the implementation of service frameworks, processes, tools, and best practices within the region

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in value-based selling or front-end commercial roles.

• Strong understanding of maintenance strategies and planning methodologies.

• Solid commercial acumen, including pricing, cost management, and risk assessment.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

• Fluency in English (written and spoken).

• Self-motivated with a strong entrepreneurial mindset and results-driven approach.

• Ability to operate effectively within a matrix organization across multiple countries and business units.

• Proven ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.description:
The Executive Assistant to Regional President is a business-facing role, who supports the President in strategic analysis, business coordination, executive communication, stakeholder management and selected strategic projects. The role is not positioned as a traditional administrative assistant role, but as a value-added business support position to enhance leadership productivity and regional execution effectiveness.

Aufgaben:
- Strategic and Business Support
• Support the President in reviewing, consolidating and refining strategic perspectives for Greater China business topics.

• Prepare executive summaries based on large volumes of internal and external inputs, including business reports, market information, stakeholder feedback and strategic documents.

• Conduct business, market, industry, policy and competitor analysis to support management decision-making.

• Read, assimilate and summarize external inputs, including market trends, macroeconomic updates, regulatory changes and industry developments.

• Support the preparation, review and improvement of strategic presentations, management reports and professional slide decks for internal and external meetings.

• Support and coordinate M&A projects

• Regional President's Office Coordination

• Help establish and operate the President's Office as an effective working mechanism to support the President's productivity.

• Coordinate annual, quarterly, monthly and weekly business rhythms, management meetings and follow-up mechanisms.

• Maintain and follow up on key action lists, priorities, decisions and deliverables related to regional management topics.

• Prepare meeting minutes for strategic or business-critical meetings, formalize key decisions and coordinate follow-up actions.

• Support the setup and follow-up of regional company rhythms and align with relevant internal stakeholders.

• Stakeholder Management and Cross-cultural Communication

• Support communication and coordination between the President, Greater China Management Team, Group functions and Swiss / European stakeholders.

• Act as a cultural and business bridge between Greater China and European stakeholders.

• Establish and maintain effective working relationships with executive assistants, business leaders and relevant stakeholders at Group and regional levels.

• Support preparation for senior stakeholder visits, customer visits or Group representative visits from a business and cultural integration perspective.

• Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment on key business topics and follow-up actions.

• Executive Communication and Presentation Support

• Draft, review and polish executive-level documents, presentations, meeting materials and formal communication.

• Prepare concise briefing notes before important meetings, stakeholder interactions or business reviews.

• Translate complex business information into structured, clear and actionable management insights.

• Support the President in preparing communication materials for internal management meetings, external engagements and Group-level discussions.

• Ensure quality, consistency and professionalism of documents and presentations.

• Strategic Project and Follow-up Management

• Support selected strategic projects on behalf of the President, including project tracking, research, coordination and follow-up.

• Engage with the Greater China Management Team on regional and Group-level strategic projects.

• Coordinate cross-functional inputs and ensure timely completion of agreed deliverables.

• Identify potential risks, bottlenecks or misalignments in project execution and escalate when necessary.

• Maintain structured documentation of key projects, meeting outcomes and action plans.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree or above in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Industrial Engineering, Management, Strategy or related disciplines.

• Master's degree, overseas education background, or combined business and engineering education is preferred.

• 5+ years of experience in management consulting, strategy, business analysis, corporate development, investment / M&A or project management.

• Consulting firm background is highly preferred; M&A, investment advisory or cross-border project experience is a strong advantage.

• Solid business analysis capability, including market research, industry analysis, competitor analysis and business case preparation.

• Experience in strategic planning, market entry, management reporting or executive-level decision support is preferred.

• Experience in preparing professional presentations, executive summaries, business reports, strategy documents or information memoranda is required.

• Prior exposure to China-Europe business environment, manufacturing, industrial technology, supply chain or B2B industries is preferred.

• Fluent Mandarin Chinese and English, both written and spoken.

• Able to prepare professional business documents, reports and presentations in English.

• Confident in communicating with senior stakeholders in a multicultural environment.

• Excellent MS Office skills, especially PowerPoint, Excel and Word.

• Proficient in using AI tools for research, document drafting, executive summaries, presentation refinement, translation and data interpretation.

• Able to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure accuracy, confidentiality, professionalism and business relevance.

• Strong structured thinking, problem-solving capability, business acumen and strategic sensitivity.

• Strong project management and follow-up skills; able to manage multiple priorities and drive tasks to closure.

• Strong stakeholder management capability; able to coordinate cross-functional, cross-cultural and senior-level stakeholders.

• Mature, reliable and highly professional, with strong discretion when handling confidential information.

• Proactive, accountable and learning-agile, with strong ownership and interest in business topics, strategy and organizational development.

• Resilient, adaptable and positive in a complex and fast-changing environment; willing to take this role as a career development opportunity.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: Service Head of COPC GCR
jobs.description:
Aufgaben:
Develop a step-by-step roadmap to build up the capabilities for various use cases (e.g. RemoteCare (24/7), Connectivity & Digital service delivery, etc.) aligned with regional and global service strategies.
• Build-up, manage and develop the organization, implement processes and tools (e.g. service cloud ticketing) for the COPC business cases operations.
• Be a key member of the global COPC Initiative to shape and implement global standards, processes and tools.
• Own the COPC China business case, including budget, cost responsibility and profitability.
• Work and interface closely with existing operations teams of different functions in CS, Sales and PE (e.g. automation, field service, parts operation, and service workshops.)
• Support customers across all disciplines (automation, mechanical, digital etc.) and ensure a seamless customer experience by coordinating appropriate escalation per Business Unit.
• Build and sustain a high knowledge level, continuously enriching it in line with development roadmaps and regional CS business plan.
• Maintain close contact with customers and Customer Relationship Managers to ensure a seamless experience, coordinate escalation, and identify new business opportunities.
• Provide timely feedback to the businesses to improve the service product offering and digital solutions.
• Implement security training to use all the communication tools according to the valid regulations.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree or above, major in Engineering, STEM, or related disciplines.
• Solid experience in project management, customer service business, or automation engineering.
• Good exposure to customer operations or maintenance personnel, with a strong understanding of customer needs and service operations.
• Proven people leadership experience, with strong passion for service business and people development.
• International working experience is preferred.
• Effective and convincing communication skills, both verbally and in writing.
• Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.
• Strong project management skills, with basic knowledge of financial planning.
• Strong interest in digital solutions and service innovation.
• Demonstrated capability to communicate in a matrix organization across multiple businesses and industries on a regional scale.
• Strong problem-solving skills, with proven track record to lead the organization under pressure.
• Customer-focused, with entrepreneurial thinking and strong business ownership.
• Hands-on and pragmatic, with strong execution and delivery mindset and proven track record.
• Excellent stakeholder manager, able to manage different perspectives and drive alignment.
• Fast learner with strong interpersonal skills.
• Able to synthesize complex topics, motivate people, and inspire teams.
• Comfortable with agile working methods, agile organizations and agile teams.

jobs.description:
Provide the required engineering services including all deliveries within the time schedule, with the required quality, while ensuring compliance with Bühler related directives and EHS stand-ards. Managing of all technical interfaces with customer including specifications for sub sup-plies.

Aufgaben:
• Is responsible for small projects on all technical belonging related with his specialization, approves deliverables to ensure that design will meet the customers expectation

• Support Project Managers in more complex overall projects by executing sub-systems

• Manage the allocated project in technical belongings to achieve the project goals and objectives

• Manage all relevant internal and external interfaces to suppliers, partners and clients

• Participate in Project Reviews as support of the Project Manager/ Director if required

• Arrange and lead internal and support external reviews

• Actively participate in project meetings with cross - functional team members, suppliers, and/or customers

• Support Project Manager to ensure a proper project execution according the Bühler Project Management process and provide technical support to Claim and Deviation Management

titleByLocale.en: Head of Market Segment Management Coffee

jobs.description:
Aufgaben:
• Portfolio & Strategy: Responsible for the complete coffee processing solution portfolio (research, automation, training, engineering, marketing). Drive the implementation of the Flavor Creation strategy to strengthen market leadership.

• Sales & Business Development: Accountable for achieving sales targets within the segment. Support global sales org in building trust and closing deals. Identify new business opportunities and drive innovation by bridging knowledge gaps.

• Technical Leadership: Formulate the future technology roadmap in collaboration with R&D. Set up and maintain process technology standards. Proactively assist with trials in RTC/ATC.

• Team Management & Training: Manage, coach, and develop the local sales and service organizations. Identify training needs, develop content, and lecture customers on coffee processing topics.

Anforderungen:
• University Degree: In Engineering or Food Technology.

• Postgraduate Education: Continuing education in Business Administration (e.g., MBA, NDS, etc.) is required.

• Experience: Minimum 5 years of professional experience in international sales of capital goods.

• Industry Background: Preferably in technology-based industries, processing, or plant engineering (specifically coffee or food processing is a strong plus).

• Language: Fluent English (written and spoken) - mandatory. Mandarin (or other Chinese languages) is highly preferred. Additional languages are an asset.

• Leadership: Ability to lead a team as well as work collaboratively as a team member. Strong assertiveness and powers of persuasion.

• Strategic Thinking: Ability to formulate technology roadmaps and assess business ideas.

• Conflict Management: Ability to manage conflicts effectively..

• Personality: Business-minded, proactive, creative, and highly customer-driven with a competent appearance.

• Work Style: High level of autonomy, independence, and above-average personal commitment.

• Cultural Fit: Receptiveness to other cultures and preparedness for international travel.

titleByLocale.fr: Chaîne d'approvisionnement Spécialiste / Produktionsplanung (m/w/d) mit Perspektive Teamleitung

jobs.description:
Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien und Wachstum. Als Teil der globalen Bühler Group mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden sind wir führender Hersteller von Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren entwickeln wir Lösungen für Architekturglas, Brillengläser sowie optische Komponenten in Smartphones, Fahrzeugen und der Medizintechnik.

Für unseren Standort Leipzig suchen wir einen motivierten Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) im Bereich Supply Chain. Sie planen und steuern unsere Supply Chain und tragen so zu einem reibungslosen Projektablauf bei. Wenn Sie Einsatzbereitschaft, Freundlichkeit und Freude an neuen Herausforderungen mitbringen, freuen wir uns auf Sie.

Lassen Sie uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Sie verantworten das Supply Chain Management für unseren Standort Leipzig und stellen einen reibungslosen Auftragsdurchlauf sicher. • Sie planen und koordinieren Montage- und Fertigungsaufträge unter Berücksichtigung von Terminen, Kapazitäten und Materialverfügbarkeiten. • Sie arbeiten eng mit den Bereichen Produktion, Logistik und Projektmanagement zusammen und steuern die relevanten Schnittstellen. • Sie analysieren Kennzahlen, erkennen Optimierungspotenziale und treiben die kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer Supply-Chain-Prozesse voran. • Sie pflegen und optimieren Planungsparameter, Forecasts, Arbeitspläne und Bestandsstrategien. • Sie übernehmen im Laufe Ihrer Entwicklung zusätzliche Verantwortung und gestalten die Weiterentwicklung unseres Supply-Chain-Bereichs aktiv mit. Anforderungen: • Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Supply Chain Management oder über eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. • Sie bringen Berufserfahrung in der Produktionsplanung, Produktionssteuerung, Disposition oder im Supply Chain Management mit. • Sie besitzen fundierte Kenntnisse in ERP-Systemen, idealerweise SAP, sowie gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse, insbesondere in Excel. • Sie überzeugen durch analytisches Denkvermögen, eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und eine hohe Lösungsorientierung. • Sie kommunizieren sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und arbeiten gerne bereichsübergreifend mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartnern zusammen. • Sie möchten Verantwortung übernehmen und können sich perspektivisch die Weiterentwicklung in eine Führungsrolle vorstellen. Wir bieten: Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung Wir bieten ein breites Spektrum an Lernmöglichkeiten, wie Videos, Online-Schulungen, Präsenzschulungen und Webinare mit kurzen, relevanten, ansprechenden, personalisierten und mobilen Formaten. Vielfältiger und integrativer Arbeitsplatz Wir fördern eine inklusive Kultur, die unsere globale Vielfalt wertschätzt. Respekt und Empathie sorgen dafür, dass sich alle sicher fühlen und ihr Bestes geben können. Öffentliche und private Anbindung Unser Standort bietet eine hervorragende Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel und bequeme Parkplätze, die Ihnen das tägliche Pendeln erleichtern. Learning Plattform Willkommen in einer Welt von über 16.000 Möglichkeiten, sich weiterzubilden! Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden.
